GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the Role

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer to pioneer and scale autonomous, agentic SDLC capabilities across GitLab. Distinguished Engineers are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the most senior level of technical leadership within and across divisions at the company.

In this role you will deeply immerse in GitLab's product and internal engineering workflows to identify classes of problems that can be wholly or largely addressed by AI agents, validate them through rigorous experimentation in production-adjacent environments, and codify patterns that can be productized for our millions of users. You will act as a bridge between Architecture, Product, Infrastructure, and Data and ML teams, ensuring that agentic capabilities deliver durable value internally first and then scale reliably and securely to our customers.

The level for this role will be determined through the interview process and may be scoped as either Distinguished Engineer or Fellow Engineer based on the depth and breadth of experience demonstrated.

What You'll Do

  • Define and continuously refine a company-wide technical vision for autonomous, agentic SDLC that aligns with GitLab's product strategy and Engineering job architecture
  • Identify and prioritize non-linear productivity opportunities across the SDLC, from planning and coding to review, security, compliance, and operations, targeting 10x step changes rather than incremental gains
  • Translate ambiguous problem spaces into concrete, iterable roadmaps in partnership with Product, AI and ML, and Architecture teams
  • Lead hands-on experiments and prototypes to validate where agentic workflows can fully own or materially reshape engineering tasks, including autonomous MR authoring, test creation and triage, security remediation, release readiness, and incident response
  • Design and implement reference architectures for agentic SDLC inside GitLab, including orchestration patterns, safety guardrails, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls
  • Define evaluation frameworks using offline benchmarks and online experiments to measure correctness, latency, safety, cost, and productivity impact of agentic workflows
  • Select and own a small set of high-impact internal use cases as pathfinders and drive them from concept through adoption to measurable productivity gains
  • Work directly with engineering teams to embed agentic workflows into day-to-day development, ensuring they are trusted, observable, and resilient
  • Define and track core productivity metrics such as cycle time, MTTR, and MR throughput, and link agentic interventions to real business outcomes
  • Capture and codify reusable patterns, libraries, and playbooks that other teams can adopt with minimal friction
  • Work with Product Management and Engineering leadership to convert proven internal patterns into product capabilities that can be safely and reliably offered to customers
  • Ensure designs respect multi-tenant, compliance, and data governance requirements across GitLab.com and self-managed customers
  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex technical and architectural decisions related to agentic workflows, AI safety, and large-scale systems integration
  • Mentor Principal and Staff Engineers working on AI and agentic efforts, raising the overall bar for technical execution, experimentation rigor, and cross-team collaboration
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that help teams make aligned, high-quality decisions independently
  • Represent GitLab in the broader ecosystem at conferences, standards groups, and open source communities on topics such as AI-assisted development, autonomous agents, and productivity measurement
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to define guardrails, review processes, and monitoring for agentic features, ensuring responsible use of AI and protection of customer data
  • Work with Reliability and SRE teams to ensure that agentic services are observable, debuggable, and resilient, and that failure modes degrade gracefully

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior technical leadership role
  • Deep expertise in AI and ML systems, including large language models, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflow design at production scale
  • Proven track record of leading hands-on technical experimentation, including defining evaluation frameworks, running benchmarks, and translating findings into scalable architecture decisions
  • Strong background in scalable, multi-tenant distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience
  • Experience designing and implementing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for production systems
  • Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Data and ML teams on complex, ambiguous technical challenges
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or divisions without direct authority
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization with excellent written and asynchronous communication skills
  • Familiarity with GitLab's DevSecOps platform, CI/CD primitives, and the software development lifecycle is a strong plus

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. jobs.description:

National Parks Conservation Association (NPCA) is the nation's oldest and largest national parks nonprofit advocacy organization. NPCA has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Development Coordinator on our Development team.

SUPERVISOR’S SUPERVISOR: Vice President, Development

INCUMBENT / NEW POSITION: Incumbent

PRIMARY PURPOSE:

The Senior Development Coordinator plays a central role in keeping the Development team organized, connected, and moving forward by providing executive, administrative, and project coordination support to the Vice President of Development (VP), Deputy Vice President of Development (DVP), and Development Management Team (DMT).

This position supports executive fundraising efforts for the VP and DVP by assisting with portfolio strategy discussions, tracking donor activity in the fundraising CRM, and coordinating event planning and execution. The Coordinator supports departmental planning processes, including the Development Operating Plan (DOP) and quarterly priority setting, and keeps project management systems like Asana current so deadlines and priorities stay visible to the team. This role also supports recurring DMT meetings, including AI-assisted meeting documentation and action-item follow-up, to ensure decisions, priorities, and next steps are clearly captured and tracked.

Additionally, the Coordinator supports Executive Office coordination, including travel, scheduling, and logistics, as well as preparation for Board and Philanthropy Committee meetings. The Coordinator also supports broader department operations, including staff onboarding and offboarding, and maintenance of shared systems, templates, and resources across the team. Working across Development teams and the Executive Office, the Coordinator helps ensure successful execution of key departmental initiatives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

% of Time

Development Executive and Leadership Support

  • Provide administrative and operational support to the Vice President (VP) and Deputy Vice President of Development (DVP).
  • Conduct and capture notes for bi-weekly portfolio strategy meetings and quarterly portfolio reviews with the VP and DVP. Track donor activity and communication and upload into fundraising CRM.
  • Assist in preparing donor meeting materials, prospect summaries, background research requests, and fundraising strategy documents.
  • Support event management and logistics, including annual signature dinner and smaller donor events.
  • Assist with special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned.

25%

Development Planning, Operations & Team Coordination

  • Support coordination and administration of the annual Development Operating Plan (DOP).
  • Schedule, take notes and track quarterly team check-ins and progress reviews related to departmental goals and objectives.
  • Support development, tracking, and reporting of departmental 90-day priorities.

  • Manage AI-assisted meeting documentation for DMT and other Development meetings, including automated note-taking, takeaway summaries, action-item capture, and tracking of carry-over items between sessions.
  • Support adoption and effective use of department technologies, including Asana, SharePoint, AI-enabled tools, and collaboration platforms.
  • Support and maintain departmental systems, tools, and processes that enhance communication, transparency, and operational efficiency.

35%

Executive Office, Board & Committee Coordination

  • Serve as a point of contact for Executive Office staff regarding development-related logistics and scheduling.
  • Coordinate follow-up activities and task management resulting from Development Executive Office meetings, travel, and donor engagement activities.
  • Coordinate executive travel planning, preparation, and follow-up processes for Development.
  • Maintain travel workflows and task management systems within Asana.
  • Coordinate preparation for Philanthropy Committee and Board meetings, tracking timelines and deadlines.
  • Assemble meeting materials, briefing documents, presentations, agendas, and supporting resources.
  • Track committee recommendations, action items, and follow-up responsibilities.
  • Support communication and coordination between Development leadership and Executive Office stakeholders.

25%

Department Operations & Administration

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes for Development staff.
  • Maintain SharePoint organization and structure for Development-wide operational and administrative resources.
  • Maintain department templates, guides, and operational documentation.
  • Coordinate department meetings, retreats, and other internal activities as assigned.
  • Support department administration like ordering department supplies, coordinating cards/gifts for staff milestones, etc.
  • Support special projects and department-wide initiatives.
  • Promote effective communication, collaboration, and information sharing across Development teams.

15%

OTHER FUNCTIONS: Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

On occasion, some of the 32 hour workweek may need flexibility for rare nights and weekends that may be required, in exception of the four-day work week ethos, as dictated by event scheduling. Your manager will always work with you to provide latitude for work-life balance around events/donor experiences which may require you to work outside the four-day work week.

MINIMUM SCOPE OF POSITION: This position requires the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of NPCA staff both in the Washington, D.C. office and regional offices.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, COMPETENCIES, SKILLS, EDUCATION AND TRAITS:

The ideal candidate will have:

jobs.excerpt: About DynatronDynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that drive measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments.
jobs.description:
About Dynatron

Dynatron is transforming the automotive service industry with intelligent SaaS solutions that drive measurable results for thousands of dealership service departments. Our analytics, automation, and AI-powered workflows help service leaders improve profitability, increase operational efficiency, and make smarter business decisions.

As Dynatron expands its AI and machine learning capabilities, building models is only part of the challenge. We need the infrastructure, engineering discipline, and operational rigor to deploy those capabilities reliably, monitor them continuously, and scale them confidently.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps) to own the production infrastructure and operational lifecycle behind Dynatron’s growing AI and machine learning capabilities.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role focused on turning models into reliable production services. You’ll build and own the pipelines, infrastructure, monitoring, governance, and deployment practices that allow our Data Science team to move from experimentation to production safely and repeatedly.

You’ll support both traditional machine learning and modern generative AI/LLM workloads, including retrieval-based and agentic applications. You’ll be responsible not simply for getting models into production, but for ensuring they remain performant, observable, secure, cost-effective, and maintainable once they get there.

You’ll work closely with our U.S.-based Data Science team. Because many of Dynatron’s data pipelines and model workloads run overnight in U.S. time, they align naturally with the India workday. You will have significant ownership of the production environment during this critical operating window.

What You’ll Do

Build & Own the ML Production Lifecycle

  • Design, build, and maintain deployment pipelines that move models reliably from development through validation and into production.
  • Establish model versioning, lineage, registry, and automated promotion practices.
  • Define repeatable production-readiness standards and deployment patterns across ML and AI workloads.
  • Partner with Data Scientists to make model handoffs efficient, consistent, and production-ready.

Drive ML Reliability & Observability

  • Own production monitoring across model performance, drift, data quality, inference health, latency, and availability.
  • Establish alerts and operational thresholds that identify degradation before it materially impacts downstream products or customers.
  • Diagnose production failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.
  • Build operational practices that improve reliability as Dynatron’s portfolio of production models grows.

Operationalize Generative AI & LLM Workloads

  • Deploy and support production LLM applications, including retrieval-based and agentic architectures.
  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, and performance of generative AI capabilities.
  • Monitor token consumption, inference costs, and cost per interaction to ensure AI capabilities remain economically sustainable.
  • Implement appropriate controls around model access, usage, safety, and production behavior.

Build Training & Retraining Infrastructure

  • Design and operate infrastructure supporting model training, validation, and retraining.
  • Build automated retraining pipelines triggered by appropriate performance, data, or business conditions.
  • Ensure training environments and workflows are reproducible, scalable, and observable.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science to ensure reliable movement of data throughout the ML lifecycle.

Establish AI/ML Governance

  • Implement model access controls, auditability, lineage, and governance standards.
  • Support model risk classification and appropriate controls based on use case and business impact.
  • Produce documentation and technical evidence required to support security, compliance, and internal governance requirements.
  • Help establish responsible production practices as Dynatron expands its use of AI.

Own Production Operations

  • Take meaningful ownership of the operational health of Dynatron’s production ML and AI services.
  • Respond to incidents, troubleshoot failures, and coordinate resolution across teams when necessary.
  • Build runbooks and operational procedures that reduce dependence on tribal knowledge.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and automate them away wherever practical.

What You Bring

MLOps & Production ML Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience deploying and operating AI/ML systems in production.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting both traditional machine learning and LLM-based workloads in production.
  • Strong understanding of the complete model lifecycle from development and validation through deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.

Generative AI & LLM Expertise

  • Production experience with LLM-powered applications and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience with retrieval architectures, evaluation methodologies, and production monitoring for generative AI.
  • Understanding of LLM performance, latency, token utilization, and cost-per-interaction management.
  • Ability to establish practical operational and governance controls around generative AI systems.

Cloud & MLOps Engineering

  • Deep experience with a major cloud platform and its managed AI/ML services; AWS strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with model registries, pipeline orchestration, ML CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.
  • Strong Python engineering skills.
  • Experience with containerization and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience designing reliable, repeatable, and automated production environments.

Production Operations

  • Experience operating production services with meaningful ownership for reliability and availability.
  • Strong incident response, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to distinguish symptoms from underlying system failures and implement long-term solutions.
  • Comfortable making sound operational decisions independently when immediate U.S.-based support may not be available.

Communication & Documentation

  • Strong written technical communication skills.
  • Experience creating runbooks, architectural documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Proactive communication style suited to distributed, asynchronous teams.
  • Ability to work effectively across Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, and other technical functions.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience implementing AI governance, model risk tiering, or access-control frameworks.
  • Experience with modern data warehouse and orchestration technologies in production analytics environments.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data and ML workloads within an AWS ecosystem.
  • Experience working successfully on distributed global teams with U.S.-based colleagues.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Senior Machine Learning Engineers at Dynatron:
  • Make deploying a model to production repeatable rather than exceptional.
  • Build production AI and ML services that are observable, reliable, secure, and cost-effective.
  • Identify model degradation and operational issues before they become significant customer or business problems.
  • Create clear standards for how ML and AI capabilities move from experimentation into production.
  • Build governance into the ML lifecycle rather than adding it after deployment.
  • Reduce manual intervention through automation and strong engineering practices.
  • Create documentation and runbooks that allow knowledge to scale across the organization.
  • Operate independently while maintaining strong partnership with U.S.-based Data Science and Data Engineering teams.

Why Dynatron

  • Help build the production foundation behind a rapidly expanding portfolio of AI-enabled SaaS products.
  • Work across traditional ML, generative AI, LLMs, and emerging agentic technologies.
  • Solve meaningful MLOps challenges against large-scale automotive datasets and real-world customer applications.
  • High-impact senior IC role with meaningful ownership of Dynatron’s production AI infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, and technology leadership as Dynatron continues its evolution toward an AI-first organization.
  • Remote environment offering autonomy, ownership, and significant technical responsibility.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation: Competitive and market-aligned for India
Employment: Full-time through Dynatron’s Employer of Record partner
Benefits Include:
  • Competitive local benefits provided through our Employer of Record
  • Remote working environment
  • Ongoing professional development opportunities
  • Opportunity to work directly with U.S.-based Data and Technology teams

Ready to build the engineering foundation that turns AI experimentation into reliable, scalable production capabilities? Join Dynatron and help us operationalize the next generation of intelligent automotive software.

Location: Remote (Europe/Africa time zones)

OpenFn is a Digital Public Good for public service automation and AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and workflows, helping governments and NGOs connect fragmented systems and deliver essential services across health, humanitarian response, and government programmes.

Open Function Group, the platform’s primary steward, is a small, fully remote team of engineers, integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 15+ countries.

We build infrastructure that helps governments function, clinics operate, and people access the services they depend on.

The role

Connecting two government systems should get easier every time. Today, it often means starting again: negotiating access, configuring environments, and deciding who can trust whom. Each new connection becomes another project.

We’re hiring a Staff Back-End Engineer to help change that. You’ll join our Connections squad, with a clear mission: make it dramatically cheaper for government departments to collaborate.

Your work will turn the hard parts of each integration into capabilities teams can use again and again. You’ll define how organisations connect their systems and share credentials, and build the workers that execute their workflows reliably at scale. As OpenFn grows to support everything around those workflows, from setup to monitoring and reporting, you’ll contribute significantly to the architectural direction of our backend.

You’ll have the opportunity to make substantial technical contributions and the responsibility to see them through. Most of your time will be spent in the codebase, with design discussions, code review, and written proposals helping the team build on your work. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities.

Our stack is Elixir/Phoenix and Node.js. You’ll need Node.js experience; you can learn Elixir here.

What you’ll do

Ship production features

  • Deliver features end to end, from technical proposal to production.
  • Build the squad’s core capabilities: connected-system registration and governance, credential ownership and sharing, and high-performance workers that execute workflows reliably at scale.

Shape OpenFn’s backend architecture

  • Set architectural direction across OpenFn’s backend, including module boundaries, service interfaces, naming, and conventions.
  • Establish consistent patterns that help engineers navigate and extend the codebase, including when using AI development tools.
  • Set engineering conventions through code review, documentation, and your own work.

Strengthen platform security

  • Translate security findings into architectural changes and carry them through to production.
  • Strengthen trust boundaries, isolation, and credential handling.

Requirements

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years of experience building and operating backend services for customer-facing products.
  • Experience designing backend service architectures, not only extending existing ones.
  • Experience building backend services with Node.js.
  • Experience operating services where reliability and scale have direct consequences for users.
  • The ability to work independently and collaborate across time zones in a small, distributed team, using GitHub, Slack, and written proposals.
  • Clear, professional communication in English and the ability to work effectively across cultures.

Useful additional experience

  • Elixir/Phoenix or other languages and frameworks designed for functional programming or concurrency.
  • Developer tooling or large migration programmes.
  • Securing production systems.
  • Work in health, humanitarian response, government digital transformation, or the wider social impact sector.
  • Working proficiency in Spanish or French.

Benefits

Compensation and benefits

  • Compensation based on experience, following OpenFn’s Equal Pay for Equal Work framework. Our NGO and government customer base means we don’t offer Silicon Valley pay scales; we aim to provide fair, transparent, and competitive pay.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote work, with team meetups across Europe and Africa. Our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar.
  • Significant influence on the platform’s architecture and the opportunity to help shape our technical strategy.
  • The opportunity to build open source software that helps ensure everyone worldwide can get access to great digital public services.

Industry: Investment Management / Alternative Investments

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

The company operates a sophisticated investment platform that includes its own investment funds as well as customized fund-of-funds solutions for financial partners. With assets under management growing rapidly and additional investment products in development, the firm is expanding its operational infrastructure to support its next stage of growth.

The organization combines the innovation and agility of a technology-driven company with the rigor, controls, and sophistication of institutional investment management.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Fund Operations Manager to take hands-on ownership of the operational processes that keep a growing investment fund platform running accurately and efficiently.

This is a specialized fund operations role with responsibility across the monthly NAV cycle, fund accounting, investor transactions, KYC/AML, capital activity, investor reporting, management-company accounting, fund launches, and external provider coordination.

You will work closely with the Head of Operations and serve as a trusted operational partner capable of independently managing critical fund processes from beginning to end.

This is not a traditional back-office role. You will have significant ownership, direct exposure to investors and leadership, and the opportunity to improve and automate fund operations as the platform scales.

What You'll Do

NAV & Fund Accounting

  • Own the monthly NAV process and drive the close through final review and sign-off.

  • Coordinate month-end activities with fund administrators and other external providers.

  • Prepare and review monthly NAVs, identifying and resolving discrepancies before leadership review.

  • Reconcile positions and cash across internal calculations, shadow records, and official administrator records.

  • Manage outstanding manager NAVs and help maintain an efficient and timely close process.

  • Maintain accurate fund performance records, including returns, positions, and expenses.

  • Ensure fund accounting records remain complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Investor Operations

  • Process investor subscriptions, redemptions, and transfers accurately and on time.

  • Own KYC/AML onboarding processes and maintain an accurate investor register.

  • Coordinate capital calls, distributions, fee calculations, payments, and wire approvals.

  • Serve as a front-line point of contact for investors, handling operational questions with accuracy, professionalism, and discretion.

  • Coordinate directly with external administrators, managers, and service providers to resolve investor-related requests.

Investor Reporting

  • Produce quarterly fact sheets and investor performance reporting using fund control-book data.

  • Support quarterly fund-of-funds reporting and commentary processes.

  • Maintain complete and organized shadow and official NAV records.

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and data processes.

Management Company Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Manage the management company's books, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, and month-end close.

  • Prepare recurring management financial reporting, including KPIs, management-fee tracking, and expense reporting.

  • Coordinate invoices, payments, expense management, and financial records.

  • Help bring recurring bookkeeping and reporting processes in-house while improving and automating them wherever possible.

Fund Formation & Launch

  • Support the operational setup and launch of new funds.

  • Coordinate account openings, documentation, and required registrations.

  • Help establish the operational infrastructure for new funds and feeder structures.

  • Ensure new fund launches are executed accurately without disrupting existing fund operations.

Providers, Controls & Operational Infrastructure

  • Manage day-to-day coordination with fund administrators, transfer agents, prime brokers, and banks.

  • Maintain strong controls around operating accounts, fund accounts, and wire approvals.

  • Document fund operations procedures and build scalable operational playbooks.

  • Create reliable processes that provide operational continuity and reduce dependency on any single team member.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and automate fund operations.

Required Qualifications

  • C2 / Near-native English proficiency, written and spoken.

  • 5+ years of hands-on fund operations experience within a fund administrator, hedge fund, private markets manager, fund-of-funds, asset manager, or similar investment environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing the NAV cycle, investor transactions, and capital activity.

  • Strong fund accounting foundation, including NAV review, position and cash reconciliation, P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.

  • Ability to independently identify and resolve errors in monthly NAVs before final approval.

  • Hands-on experience with subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, KYC/AML, capital calls, distributions, and fee calculations.

  • Experience coordinating with fund administrators, transfer agents, prime brokers, and banks.

  • Hands-on accounting experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, month-end close, and financial reporting.

  • Experience communicating directly with investors or external financial partners.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong controls mindset.

  • High level of ownership, judgment, discretion, and follow-through.

  • Ability to work independently and manage critical financial processes from beginning to end.

  • Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within alternative investments or asset management.

  • Fund-of-funds or multi-strategy investment experience.

  • Experience working with multiple funds simultaneously.

  • Experience with feeder funds, holding-company structures, or onshore/offshore investment structures.

  • Experience supporting new fund launches and fund formation.

  • Experience working directly with founders, investors, and external financial service providers.

  • Experience using AI and automation to improve reconciliation, reporting, or recurring fund operations processes.

Tools & Systems

Experience with every platform is not required, but candidates should be comfortable learning sophisticated financial and operational systems quickly.

Relevant tools may include:

  • Fund administration and NAV platforms

  • Fund performance tracking systems

  • Prime brokerage platforms

  • Accounting and expense-management systems

  • SharePoint

  • Google Workspace

  • Slack

  • Notion

  • Linear

  • Claude, Codex, and AI automation tools

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate combines deep fund operations expertise with exceptional precision and ownership.

You are someone who:

  • Owns the close: You manage the monthly NAV cycle end to end, proactively resolve issues, and keep the close on schedule.

  • Operates with precision: You reconcile before approving, identify discrepancies others may miss, and build controls that prevent errors.

  • Can be trusted with investor capital: You handle sensitive financial and investor information with exceptional judgment and discretion.

  • Takes complete ownership: Once a responsibility is handed to you, leadership can trust that it will be completed accurately and on time.

  • Improves the system: You continuously look for opportunities to streamline, document, and automate recurring fund operations.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.

  • Fully remote opportunity.

  • Work directly with senior leadership at a growing U.S. investment management firm.

  • Significant ownership over critical fund operations.

  • Exposure to sophisticated alternative investment and fund-of-funds structures.

  • Opportunity to help build and scale the operational infrastructure behind a growing investment platform.

  • Technology-forward environment with opportunities to automate and improve traditional fund operations.

Important Notes

Please submit your CV in English.

Candidates should have direct, hands-on experience in fund operations and fund accounting. General business operations or accounting experience without meaningful exposure to investment fund operations will not be sufficient for this position.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Work in partnership with the organization-wide AI transformation program: adopt shared standards and toolkits, and feed your team's learnings back into them. Keep the team's ability to give AI systems clear, well-structured context as a durable core skill, alongside quality gates and human judgment on anything consequential.
  • Team leadership. Build, grow, and retain a strong engineering team, with genuine redundancy so no tool, vendor relationship, or piece of institutional knowledge lives with only one person.
  • Cross-team program delivery. Manage complex programs that span multiple teams and solution families, sequencing cross-team dependencies and holding a tight critical path to fixed launch and initial customer delivery dates. Surface schedule risk early, resolve competing priorities across teams, and keep delivery on track when dependencies slip elsewhere.
  • Reliability. Set clear ownership, escalation paths, and reliability standards, such as on-call, and incident postmortems, so operational excellence is managed within the team, not dependent on any one person.
  • Cost. Own cloud, vendor, and contractor cost accountability as a standing part of everyday engineering decisions, not a periodic report, and partner with Finance on budget and forecasting.
  • Change leadership. Lead the team through reorganizations, outsourced augmentation, or acquisitions while keeping delivery steady. Document clean handoffs, in and out of roles, so nothing depends on one person's memory.
  • Platform alignment. Partner with Product on release scope and with Platform to keep architecture aligned with the wider technology organization.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in software development, including managing engineering teams of 30 or more in a fast-paced, growing SaaS company, with 2+ years managing through engineering managers and leads.
  • Hands-on experience running iterative, evidence-based trials of AI-assisted development practices, and building a team's discipline around giving AI systems clear, well-structured context.
  • Experience managing complex, cross-team programs with interdependent workstreams against launch delivery deadlines, including holding other teams accountable to a shared critical path.
  • Experience with site reliability practices and working knowledge of FinOps principles.

● Conduct market and competitive research, with particular depth in oncology and

Oncology & Clinical Criteria

NCCN Guidelines and payer policies.

● Bring deep expertise in oncology PA workflows across chemotherapy,

immunotherapy, radiation oncology, and supportive care.

● Direct the translation of evolving NCCN Guidelines and payer policies into product

requirements.

● Partner with engineering, AI, clinical content, and support teams to build and

The AI Solution Architect designs scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions supporting the Baldwin Retail business unit. Working directly with product owners and technical teams, this role translates product requirements into technical designs, contributes to design standards and reference patterns, and ensures solutions align with enterprise architecture principles. Solutions increasingly include agentic AI and automation components alongside traditional application and integration work. The role operates as a technical individual contributor with meaningful autonomy on solution-level decisions, partnering across Product, Security, Data, and Enterprise Technology.

  • Design solution architectures for Baldwin Retail that are scalable, adaptable, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles and IT strategy.
  • Translate product requirements into technical designs, working with product owners to understand business processes and identify challenges.
  • Design agentic AI and automation solutions where appropriate, including agent orchestration patterns, LLM integration, human-in-the-loop workflows, and tool/API exposure for agent consumption.
  • Contribute to design standards, guardrails, and reference patterns used by engineering teams.
  • Evaluate third-party products, platforms, and cloud services; develop build-vs-buy recommendations for architecture leadership.
  • Review solution designs with engineering teams to surface risks and architectural gaps.

  • Collaborate with Data Platform teams on data processing patterns, integration strategies, and access boundaries.

  • Design and integrate cloud solutions across AWS and Azure, ensuring reliability and operational readiness.
  • Prototype new solutions, validating component compatibility and establishing reusable patterns.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and design sessions to drive alignment on solution choices.
  • Ensure solutions follow cloud best practices for reliability, cost efficiency, observability, and performance.
  • Assess emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI, for applicability to the Retail technology roadmap.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Strong technical expertise in solution and application architecture, including distributed systems, API design, enterprise integration patterns, and event-driven architectures.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Job Description: Chief Fraud Officer (CFO – Fraud)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) / Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Job Summary

The Chief Fraud Officer (CFO – Fraud) is responsible for leading the organization's fraud risk management strategy, including prevention, detection, investigation, and response to fraud-related activities. This role ensures robust controls are in place to safeguard the organization, its customers, and its assets from internal and external fraud threats.

The Chief Fraud Officer plays a critical role in minimizing financial losses, strengthening fraud controls, and enhancing trust across all business operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Fraud Risk Strategy & Framework

Develop and implement enterprise-wide fraud risk management strategies

Establish fraud prevention, detection, and response frameworks

Align fraud management with overall risk and compliance strategies

Continuously assess emerging fraud risks and threats

2. Fraud Detection & Monitoring

Oversee fraud detection systems and real-time monitoring tools

Implement advanced analytics and AI-based fraud detection models

Identify suspicious patterns and anomalies

Enhance fraud detection capabilities across channels (digital, transactions, payments)

3. Fraud Prevention & Controls

Design and implement controls to prevent fraud across operations

Strengthen internal controls and fraud risk mitigation processes

Collaborate with IT and operations to secure systems and processes

Reduce vulnerabilities in customer-facing and internal systems

4. Investigations & Incident Management

Lead investigations into fraud incidents and suspected activities

Coordinate with internal teams, law enforcement, and regulators

Ensure proper documentation and reporting of fraud cases

Manage incident response and recovery processes

5. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with fraud-related regulatory requirements

Oversee reporting of fraud incidents to regulators and authorities

Maintain audit-ready documentation and reporting frameworks

Support regulatory inspections and audits

6. Data Analytics & Technology

Leverage data analytics and technology to enhance fraud detection

Implement fraud management systems and tools

Utilize machine learning and predictive analytics

Continuously improve fraud detection efficiency

7. Awareness & Training

Develop fraud awareness programs for employees and customers

Promote a culture of vigilance and fraud prevention

Train teams on fraud detection and reporting procedures

Enhance organizational awareness of fraud risks

8. Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with risk, compliance, audit, IT, and operations teams

Engage with regulators, law enforcement, and industry bodies

Provide fraud insights and reporting to executive leadership and Board

Support cross-functional fraud risk initiatives

9. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop fraud risk and investigation teams

Establish performance standards and KPIs

Foster a culture of accountability and integrity

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CAMS, or similar are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in fraud risk management, financial crime, compliance, or risk roles

Proven experience in senior fraud leadership roles (e.g., Chief Fraud Officer, Head of Fraud, Financial Crime Leader)

Strong experience in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of fraud risk management frameworks and techniques

Expertise in fraud detection, investigation, and prevention

Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High integrity and attention to detail

Crisis management and problem-solving skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Reduction in fraud losses and incidents

Effectiveness of fraud detection systems

Speed and quality of fraud investigations

Compliance with regulatory requirements

Fraud prevention and control effectiveness

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Preferred Attributes

Experience in digital fraud, cybersecurity, and payments fraud

Exposure to AI/ML-based fraud detection systems

Strong collaboration with regulators and law enforcement

Ability to manage complex fraud risks in a dynamic environment

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Art Director – Performance Creative & AI

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative Post-Production
Reports To: Creative Director
Direct Report: Senior Editor/Designer
Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Creative
Experience: 5–8+ Years
Portfolio: Required

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Art Director to lead concept development and own the visual standard across paid and organic campaigns.

This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, performance marketing, and execution. You will define creative direction and ensure that the work produced delivers against that vision, from initial concept through final client-ready assets.

You will directly manage a Senior Editor/Designer, assign and prioritize work, review deliverables, provide actionable art direction, and maintain a consistently high creative standard.

Because the team works extensively with both traditional production and AI-generated creative (AIGC), you must have enough hands-on AI fluency to confidently direct generative work, evaluate output quality, identify artifacts or brand inconsistencies, and determine when AI or traditional production is the better approach.

You will collaborate closely with Client Partners and Media Strategists to translate performance insights into high-quality, scalable creative across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

What You'll Do

Creative Direction & Team Leadership

  • Directly manage and develop a Senior Editor/Designer, setting priorities and managing capacity across accounts.

  • Review video, motion, static, and AI-generated creative before it advances to the Creative Director or client.

  • Provide clear, actionable art direction across composition, typography, layout, pacing, color, motion, and brand consistency.

  • Identify whether creative challenges originate from craft, concept, or the brief and address them at the appropriate level.

  • Maintain a high creative standard without becoming a production bottleneck.

Concept Development & AI Creative

  • Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign ideas, and visual narratives across multiple client accounts.

  • Translate briefs, brand guidelines, and performance insights into clear creative direction.

  • Develop concept decks, storyboards, briefs, visual references, and prototypes, primarily using Figma.

  • Use AI tools to develop visual references, storyboards, creative examples, scripts, and ad copy aligned with each client's brand.

  • Direct AI-generated work by evaluating generation quality, identifying artifacts and off-brand outputs, and improving prompt and reference strategies.

  • Stay hands-on when necessary by sketching, mocking, or prototyping creative directions.

Creative Production & Workflow

  • Own the creative process from brief through final build and delivery.

  • Guide production and revision rounds while balancing creative quality with efficient iteration.

  • Review both internally produced and creator-generated content.

  • Oversee final assets across static, video, and motion formats, ensuring they are complete, properly versioned, and platform-ready.

  • Improve briefing, feedback, documentation, and AI production workflows to reduce unnecessary revision cycles.

Performance Creative & Strategy

  • Partner with Client Partners and Media teams to turn campaign performance insights into creative direction.

  • Apply learnings from high-performing hooks, formats, visual systems, and concepts to future campaigns.

  • Make recommendations on whether creative directions should be scaled, iterated, or discontinued based on performance.

  • Build creative post-mortems to understand why concepts succeeded or underperformed.

  • Understand how creative should evolve across different stages of the marketing funnel.

Creative Systems & Scalability

  • Develop repeatable creative frameworks, templates, and design systems.

  • Create reusable art-direction standards that allow quality to scale across the team.

  • Maintain visual consistency across formats, campaigns, and channels.

  • Contribute to AI production workflows, prompt/reference libraries, and scalable creative processes.

  • Stay current on platform trends, emerging formats, visual styles, and generative creative tools.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Art Direction, Visual Design, or Performance Creative within an agency or brand environment.

  • Experience managing, mentoring, or formally directing at least one creative professional, such as a designer, editor, or motion artist.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating concept development and visual direction across paid and digital channels.

  • Proven ability to translate strategy and performance insights into compelling, executable creative concepts.

  • Experience with social-first and performance-driven creative across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Working fluency with AI creative tools such as Gemini/Nano Banana, Sora, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Seedance 2.0, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to evaluate and provide structured creative direction across video, motion, static, and AI-generated content.

  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, and priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong collaboration skills across creative, strategy, account, and media teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in performance marketing or direct-response creative.

  • Familiarity with UGC, creator-led, and platform-native advertising.

  • Working knowledge of After Effects and/or Premiere sufficient to effectively review post-production work.

  • Experience creating scalable creative systems, templates, or briefing frameworks.

  • Experience working with offshore teams or external creative partners.

  • Understanding of creative testing frameworks and iterative production workflows.

  • Experience establishing quality standards for AI-generated creative.

Ideal Candidate

You are a strong conceptual thinker who can transform strategy into creative ideas that are both visually compelling and realistically executable.

You know how to give specific, prioritized feedback that improves the work, and you genuinely enjoy developing other creatives.

You understand how to balance brand quality, performance, speed, and scalability, and you're comfortable leading the creative process while remaining hands-on when needed.

Most importantly, you have the judgment to distinguish between average and exceptional creative, including when that work is AI-generated.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be reflected in:

  • Consistently high-quality creative across client accounts.

  • Strong alignment between creative direction and campaign performance.

  • Effective leadership and development of the creative team.

  • Efficient production and revision cycles.

  • Successful translation of performance insights into new creative concepts.

  • Scalable creative systems that maintain quality as production grows.

  • Effective integration of AI into creative workflows without compromising brand standards.

Why Join Us?

  • Own creative direction across a diverse portfolio of performance-driven campaigns.

  • Work at the intersection of creative strategy, performance marketing, and generative AI.

  • Direct both traditional and AI-powered creative production.

  • Influence creative systems, workflows, and quality standards.

  • Collaborate closely with experienced creative, strategy, account, and media professionals.

  • Help shape how AI is integrated into modern performance creative production.

Important Notes

  • A strong creative portfolio is required.

  • This is a senior, hands-on Art Direction role with direct responsibility for creative quality.

  • Candidates must have previous experience directing or managing another creative professional.

  • Candidates should be comfortable reviewing static, video, motion, and AI-generated creative.

  • Practical familiarity with modern generative AI tools is required; theoretical knowledge alone is not sufficient.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director, LATAM Carrier Relations.

About the job

Twilio is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director to spearhead our Carrier Relations team across Latin America. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless communication services, driving a localized supply strategy, and fostering strategic partnerships with regional carriers. Working closely with cross-functional partners—such as Sales, Product, Commercial Legal, Regulatory— you will align market demand with local carrier capabilities to power Twilio’s growth in the region. The ideal candidate brings a robust background in telecommunications, deep expertise in LATAM regulatory environments, and a track record of building high-performing teams.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of carrier relations specialists across LATAM, fostering a collaborative, high-performance, and region-aware culture.
  • Sales Alignment & Demand Strategy: Partner closely with Sales and Product teams to analyze market trends, understand customer demand, and co-develop country-specific supply strategies tailored to individual LATAM markets.
  • Carrier/Supply Partnerships & Negotiation: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with regional and local carriers and other suppliers to secure cost-effective solutions, expand coverage, and optimize service delivery.
  • Regulatory & Market Intelligence: Navigate complex local telecommunications regulations and upcoming policy changes to proactively adapt Twilio's supply strategy and maintain strict compliance across all LATAM territories.
  • Performance & KPI Management: Implement and monitor localized KPIs to assess supplier performance, route quality, and cost efficiency in alignment with regional business goals.
  • Operational Execution: Act as an escalation point to resolve regional carrier/supplier service issues, minimizing operational disruption and maintaining high service reliability.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Minimum of 10 years in the telecommunications services industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing carrier relations.
  • Deep expertise in LATAM telecommunications markets, local carrier ecosystems, and regional regulatory environments.
  • Proven experience collaborating with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to align infrastructure/supply strategy with revenue demand.
  • Strong negotiation, influence, and communication skills in complex multi-country environments.
  • Data-driven, analytical approach to decision-making and route optimization.
  • Fluency in Spanish, English and Portuguese.

Desired:

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Business Administration, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
  • Familiarity with core communication protocols and standards (e.g., SS7, ISUP, MAP, SIP).

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia or Brazil.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

jobs.description:
Seu bem-estar, nossa missão. Junte-se a uma empresa que torna o mundo mais saudável.

CONHEÇA A GENTE

Estamos revolucionando o bem-estar corporativo. Nossa plataforma conecta colaboradores do mundo todo aos melhores parceiros em exercício físico, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e rotina de sono – tudo em uma só subscrição. Com base em Nova York e equipe na Europa, América do Norte e América do Sul, nossa missão é fazer de toda empresa uma empresa de bem-estar.

A gente acredita que o trabalho deve ser gratificante, inspirador e equilibrado. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma equipe que valoriza bem-estar, colaboração e perspectivas diversas, em um lugar onde paixão e criatividade rompem limites para criar impacto de verdade. Suas contribuições vão ajudar a construir um mundo mais saudável, para você e milhões de pessoas globalmente.

Por que temos vagas afirmativas?

Essa é uma vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Porque a gente acredita em fomentar a diversidade e nutrir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todo mundo tenha acesso a oportunidades equitativas e possa atingir o seu potencial máximo.

Para alcançar a nossa missão, é essencial que existam diversas perspectivas aqui dentro e que todas as pessoas se sintam acolhidas, valorizadas e empoderadas no Wellhub.

A OPORTUNIDADE

Estamos contratando Business Operations Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Business Transformation em São Paulo!

Nossa missão é aprimorar a rotina operacional de nossas pessoas clientes, tornando nossos processos escaláveis e padronizados, buscando ser a área de referência dentro do Wellhub e garantindo a qualidade na execução, sempre em parceria com outros times internos.

O objetivo do time de Client Operations LatAm é garantir a eficiência, a qualidade e a execução correta dos processos dos clientes de RH, em alinhamento com os times de vendas e finanças.

Como parte do time, você atuará em contato com nossas pessoas clientes externas, prestando suporte na análise de dados, apoiando os times de vendas nos processos estabelecidos e trabalhando para assegurar o cumprimento dos alinhamentos operacionais.

SEU IMPACTO

  • Identificar e mapear oportunidades de melhoria para o time de Operações e para o pilar de clientes como um todo.
  • Liderar projetos e iniciativas, assumindo a responsabilidade pelas entregas e coordenando ações com outros times conforme necessário.
  • Organizar reuniões e sessões de treinamento com stakeholders para alinhar tarefas, solicitar suporte, comunicar melhorias e definir novos processos.
  • Criar documentações para formalizar melhorias em processos, políticas e outras definições, além de acompanhar projetos e iniciativas em andamento.
  • Colaborar com diversos times da organização, tanto técnicos quanto não técnicos, para garantir entregas bem-sucedidas.
  • Desenvolver soluções para aumentar a eficiência dos times operacionais parceiros, otimizando seu tempo e implementando controles para mitigar possíveis erros.
  • Gerenciar expectativas e contornar objeções de forma eficaz.
  • viva a missão: inspire e empodere Wellhubbers ao priorizar seu próprio bem-estar e de seus colegas. Faça parte de um ambiente de apoio, onde todas as pessoas se sentem à vontade para cuidar de si mesmas, tirar folgas e encontrar um equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal.

QUEM É VOCÊ

  • Conhecimento em Excel.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, extrair insights e elaborar apresentações corporativas.
  • Perfil proativo, com foco na resolução de problemas e na satisfação da pessoa cliente.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com ótimo relacionamento interpessoal e colaborativo.
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).
  • Conhecimento em SQL (intermediário/avançado) e ferramentas de BI (Looker, Tableau, Metabase) será um diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia em mapeamento de processos ou projetos de transformação de negócios será um diferencial.
  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente ou operações B2B será um diferencial.

Mesmo que você não corresponda a 100% dos requisitos da vaga, candidate-se! Teremos o maior prazer em receber a sua inscrição e analisar o seu fit em nossa equipe.

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

Criamos um ambiente de trabalho para você prosperar em todas as dimensões da sua vida. A gente faz isso por meio de benefícios bem pensados, recursos para o bem-estar emocional e uma cultura que empodera cada pessoa a realmente se conectar com seu papel aqui e ser dona dele, balanceando isso com o próprio bem-estar.

Nosso programa de benefícios flexíveis ajuda você a customizá-los de acordo com as suas necessidades!

Nossos benefícios incluem:

WELLHUB: Plano Gold+ gratuito, com acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios, programas fitness digitais e recursos online para meditação, nutrição, suporte de saúde mental, rotina de sono e mais. Você também pode adicionar até 3 familiares ao seu plano, garantindo que quem mais importa para você tenha acesso a bem-estar.

WELLZ: Um recurso único e completo para o bem-estar mental. O Wellz oferece jornadas personalizadas que combinam sessões semanais de terapia cognitivo-comportamental (52 por ano) e conteúdo à demanda.

SAÚDE E CUIDADO: Plano de saúde, plano odontológico e seguro de vida.

TRABALHO FLEXÍVEL: Com o regime de trabalho que prioriza flexibilidade, a gente oferece vagas híbridas e remotas, para que tenha a liberdade de trabalhar do jeito que funciona melhor para você. O modelo de trabalho desta vaga específica pode ser discutido com a pessoa recrutadora e com a liderança. Quando você entrar no Wellhub, também pode usar o nosso reembolso de home office para montar o seu escritório em casa!

DESCANSO REMUNERADO: Se desconectar e recarregar as energias é muito importante. Por isso, oferecemos férias após 6 meses de trabalho + 3 dias de folga por ano + 1 dia de folga a cada ano na empresa (somando até 5 dias) + 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário!

LICENÇA PARENTAL REMUNERADA: Receber um novo membro na família é um dos momentos mais especiais da vida. Queremos que cada pessoa colaboradora possa estar presente de verdade e aproveite esse tempo em família. Por isso, oferecemos licença parental 100% remunerada a todos os novos pais. Quem dá à luz também tem direito à licença estendida (Empresa Cidadã) e a um período de adaptação (ramp-back), em que pode trabalhar meio-período até se ajustar à nova rotina.

DESENVOLVIMENTO PROFISSIONAL: Tenha acesso a plataformas de aprendizado (incluindo linguístico), participe de sessões interativas e explore nossas oportunidades internas. No seu estágio, você também vai desenvolver um projeto todo seu, baseado na área e suas especialidades e ter apadrinhamento para ajudar no seu estágio. No Wellhub, a gente foca em aprendizado e feedback contínuos para apoiar seu caminho em direção ao sucesso – tanto pessoal quanto profissional.

CULTURA: Você vai se juntar a uma equipe de pessoas dedicadas, que se unem para romper limites, apoiar umas às outras e criar impacto duradouro no bem-estar corporativo. Nós vencemos em conjunto, cultivando relações de confiança por meio de comunicação transparente e de uma cultura em que cada perspectiva importa. Entenda mais sobre nossos valores e cultura.

Quer ver como é realmente trabalhar aqui? Siga a gente no Instagram @lifeatwellhub e assista ao vídeo do nosso time no YouTube!

Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento @ Wellhub

Buscamos criar um ambiente colaborativo, acolhedor e inclusivo, onde todo mundo sinta que faz parte.

O Wellhub é um empregador comprometido com a promoção de oportunidades equitativas. Todas pessoas qualificadas que se candidatarem serão igualmente consideradas, sem discriminação por raça, religião, cor, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência física ou mental não desqualificante, nacionalidade, condição de veterano ou qualquer outra base coberta pela lei apropriada.

Nosso compromisso com a inclusão também se estende à forma como reconhecemos e remuneramos nossas pessoas colaboradoras. Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa Syndio Fair Pay Certified, um certificado que reflete a nossa dedicação contínua a práticas de remuneração justas e equitativas em toda a nossa equipe global. Leia mais aqui.

jobs.description:
Campaign Director, Switzerland

📍 Location: Remote, DACH

⏳ Work Type: Full-time, flexible hours

Are you ready to lead national campaigns that defend life, protect the family, and safeguard fundamental freedoms in Switzerland?

CitizenGO is seeking a bold and strategic Campaign Director to lead our work in Switzerland. This is your opportunity to run high-impact national and global campaigns, mobilize thousands of citizens, and ensure that the voices of our supporters translate into real cultural and political change.

As Campaign Director, you will be at the heart of one of the most innovative and fast-growing advocacy movements in the world. You will not just write petitions. You will shape public debate, influence decision-makers, and represent CitizenGO in your country.

If you want your work to matter every single day, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

Campaign Directors are at the core of CitizenGO’s advocacy work. In Switzerland, you will take full ownership of your designated list, running national and global online campaigns that are read by millions of people each week.

You will track political and cultural developments, craft powerful campaign communications, and mobilize supporters to take action. You will also prepare or translate campaign messages from English, ensuring they resonate deeply within the Swiss context.

Beyond online campaigns, you will help organize offline actions such as petition deliveries and public stunts, build coalitions with like-minded organizations, and engage in legislative and electoral processes to highlight and defend our values.

In summary, you will serve as the public representative of CitizenGO in Switzerland.

This role reports to the Manager of Global Campaigns and offers a flexible schedule, provided all responsibilities are fulfilled on time and with excellence.

Why Join CitizenGO?

At CitizenGO, you will be part of a dynamic, mission-driven team committed to creating real change. Here are the top 10 reasons why working with us is a unique and rewarding experience:

  1. Make an Impact: Your work will directly contribute to defending life, family, and freedom on a global scale.
  2. We’re Winning: You will join a successful team! Our campaigning works, and we’re changing politics and policies across the world. Check out some of our recent victories here.
  3. Bold Tactics: From petitions to street rallies, we employ bold, effective strategies to win.
  4. Independent Strategy: Our actions are driven by our members, not large funders, ensuring we prioritize what’s best for the world.
  5. Fearless in the Face of Opposition: We thrive in challenging environments, fearlessly facing off against powerful adversaries without backing down.
  6. Inspiring Teammates: You will work alongside helpful, kind, motivated, and talented individuals who share your values.
  7. Remote Flexibility: You will enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, eliminating commutes and allowing you the flexibility to travel and live on your terms.
  8. Flexible Hours: You will benefit from adaptable work hours, ensuring you can be there for others and manage your day as you see fit.
  9. Connected Community: Though fully remote, our team fosters a strong sense of camaraderie.
  10. Results-Focused Culture: We prioritize efficiency and impact, ensuring a balanced work-life dynamic.

Seeour culture pagefor more!

What You'll Do

  • You will research, conceive, develop, and run campaigns on a range of national and global issues, helping to channel our members' time and donations in the most effective ways possible.
  • You will monitor local and global events to identify opportunities for strong and timely campaigns.
  • You will consult with experts and support the development of a strong strategy, policy, and messaging.
  • You will draft, proofread, and edit campaign emails and other marketing communications.
  • You will draft, proofread, and edit prompts to be used with Artificial Intelligence to generate and enhance emails, communications, and other written materials.
  • You will look for and identify relevant, issue-specific supporting materials from the press, NGOs, and other credible sources.
  • You will send emails to CitizenGO’s supporters in your country to inform them about new campaigns and the results of ongoing efforts.
  • You will propose offline actions, from ad buys to public petition deliveries and other campaign-related initiatives.
  • You will coordinate materials in your country's language, including briefings to the Campaigns team, press releases, and research documents.
  • You will engage in public speaking and media activities when needed.
  • You will establish and strengthen connections with influencers, journalists, and activists on social media to enhance the reach of our campaigns.
  • You will translate CitizenGO’s global campaigns and emails from English into your country’s language, if applicable.
  • You will manage correspondence and consultation processes with members, including polling and feedback initiatives.
  • You will help shape the overall strategic direction of the organization and, when needed, support additional tasks such as recruitment, team building, management, and special projects.
  • You will establish coalitions with like-minded organizations to strengthen the mobilization and confrontational politics central to CitizenGO’s model.
  • You will propose, assist, and advise Media Campaigners on offline events and campaign-related performances, attending events and taking ownership of offline actions when necessary for logistical reasons.
  • You will review, manage, and support petitions published by members on the CitizenGO Petitions website.
  • You will monitor the CitizenGO website for functionality and language accuracy, including typos and grammatical errors.
  • You will train and support your Campaign Associate, if applicable, organize the strategy for your list, and collaborate to enhance growth, engagement, and brand visibility.

Who you are

  • You are based in Switzerland and speak German as a first language.
  • You have the availability to travel for offlines (on-site events) once a month.
  • You have at least a B2-level proficiency in English. (Duolingo English Test required for non-natives, minimum score of 100). Spanish and other languages are a plus.
  • You have enthusiasm for and broad experience with software tools, along with proven ability to quickly learn and adapt to new ones.
  • You possess strong strategic, creative, and innovative thinking skills, with the ability to analyze socio-political scenarios, develop complex ideas, and communicate them clearly.
  • You have a solid understanding of how civic advocacy, citizen mobilization, and grassroots campaigning function.
  • You are passionate about and deeply committed to defending life, family, and freedom.
  • You demonstrate high professionalism, self-motivation, efficiency, and results-oriented delivery, even on short timelines.
  • You have strong teamwork skills and are comfortable in a highly collaborative team culture within a hierarchical team structure.
  • You possess strong project and staff management skills.
  • You are able to adjust quickly to changing conditions and requirements.
  • You are willing and able to work autonomously on a variety of tasks and projects, prioritizing them efficiently.
  • You are proactive, take the initiative to get the job done, and contribute valuable projects and proposals that enrich the entire organization.
  • You have strong user-level computer skills; experience with Google Workspace is preferred, and proficiency in CRMs and project management tools is an asset.
  • You have a flexible schedule and are able to work under tight deadlines, including availability for evening and weekend work and occasional travel as needed.
  • You have previous experience in copywriting and producing marketing content, which is considered an asset.
  • You have proficiency in using Artificial Intelligence tools to generate emails, communications, and other written materials, which is considered an asset.

Benefits

  • Work from anywhere – Enjoy the flexibility of remote work.
  • Flexible hours – Manage your own schedule.
  • 24 vacation days per year plus local public holidays.
  • Tuition reimbursement – Up to €500 per year for professional development.
  • Language courses – Monthly allowance for English or Spanish iTalki lessons ($120 monthly).
  • One free book per month – Up to €30 each.
  • Home office setup allowance – €500 every two years to optimize your workspace.
  • Coworking membership support – Up to €200 per month.
  • Access to cutting-edge AI tools – Sora, ChatGPT, Grammarly, Fluently AI, and more!
  • Annual retreats and networking events – Team meetups, retreats, and networking events throughout the year.

How to Apply

Click the Apply for this job button, fill out the application, and include your resume. Successful candidates will proceed through the following steps:

  1. First interview with PeopleOps.
  2. Second interview with the Manager of Global Campaigns.
  3. Campaign drafting task to assess copywriting skills.
  4. Third interview with the Director of Global Campaigns.
  5. Duolingo English Test
  6. Offer extended to the final candidate.

Recruitment Process Timeline

The hiring process typically takes 2 to 8 weeks from the first interview to the final decision. Timelines may vary depending on holidays, the number of candidates, and the level and complexity of the role.

For information about our privacy practices in the recruitment process, please visit ourRecruitment Privacy Policy page.

As an Implementation Professional II supporting Deposit Solutions, you will lead implementation activities for new and existing clients from project kickoff through go-live. Experience you'll need to have:
