jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant
Soutron Global · Customer Delivery · United States or Canada (Remote)

About Soutron Global

Soutron Global builds and supports information management software for organizations whose value sits in their collections — corporate and law firm libraries, government agencies, national and corporate archives, museums, and public library consortia. The suite spans library services platforms, archival collection management, resource sharing, and discovery, deployed across North America, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
Our customers do not buy software so much as they buy the continuity of a catalog that has been built, in some cases, over a century. That makes implementation the moment the relationship is decided.

Why this role exists

Customer Delivery is moving from a "do everything for the customer" model to defined roles with clear ownership. This seat is the delivery half of that change: a hands-on implementation professional who takes a signed project from kickoff to signed customer acceptance, and who can be trusted with the two hardest categories of work in our book.
First, migrations. Legacy installations in this sector are heavily customized, with bespoke data constructs and workflows built up over years. Moving them onto a current platform is a data problem before it is a software problem, and feature-parity gaps have to be found in scoping rather than discovered at go-live.
Second, upgrades. Our library services platform is not multi-tenant. An upgrade is not a platform event; it is a project per customer, run against a live production catalog that the customer cannot afford to have offline. A release wave across an installed base is therefore a coordinated delivery program, and it is the work most exposed to being done badly.
You will carry a live project book from week one. You will not be building a function from scratch — the reporting, utilization view, and project governance already exist and are improving. You will be the person the hardest projects are given to.

What you'll own

  1. End-to-end project delivery. A concurrent book of implementation and services projects across the suite — our library services platform and our archival collection management products. Kickoff, discovery, scoping, configuration, data migration, integration setup, user acceptance testing, go-live, and signed customer acceptance.
  2. Data migration and reconciliation. Extract, profile, transform, map, load, and reconcile customer catalog and archival data. Own the mapping specification, the validation plan, and the reconciliation evidence the customer signs against.
  3. Legacy-to-current platform conversions. Scope conversions off highly customized legacy installations, produce an honest feature-parity gap assessment before the project is committed, and deliver the conversion with product and engineering.
  4. Upgrade delivery for the installed base. Own and improve the upgrade runbook, then execute the upgrade wave tied to each scheduled release. Sequence customers, agree windows, manage rollback, and land upgrades without production disruption or regression.
  5. Configuration and enablement handoff. Configure metadata models, cataloging templates, workflows, permissions, and reporting to the agreed specification — then hand off cleanly to the training and adoption team, who own post-go-live enablement.
  6. Delivery pace as a revenue control. Project revenue in this business is recognized on delivery, not on billing milestones. Slipped delivery is slipped revenue. You own the completion of what you committed, in the quarter you committed it, or you own the early and specific escalation that resets it.
  7. Operating discipline. Time logged weekly, project status current, risks raised in writing before they become escalations and estimates that hold up against your own actuals.
  8. Customer onsite delivery. Onsite discovery, data workshops, go-live support, and recovery visits — in North America, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.

Scope boundaries

AreaThis roleOwner and noteProject delivery and migrationOwnsEnd to end, through signed acceptance.Upgrade executionOwnsRunbook and per-customer execution for assigned accounts.Scoping and effort estimationOwnsYou produce the estimate and the parity gap assessment. Sales owns price.Training delivery and adoptionOwnsYou own the configuration and training of train the trainer. Support ticket queuesDoes not ownCustomer Support. Cross-charging delivery people into the support queue is a known capacity leak and is being closed, not continued.Commercial terms, quotes, change-order pricingDoes not ownSales and Sales Operations. You raise the change, they price and paper it.Renewals, retention forecast, account strategyDoes not ownCustomer Success and Renewals.Product roadmap and prioritizationDoes not ownProduct Owner. You supply the field evidence; they decide sequence.Custom code and platform engineeringDoes not ownEngineering. You write the specification and test against it; scripting for migration and configuration is yours.People managementDoes not ownNo direct reports. This is a senior individual contributor seat.

Your first 90 days

WindowWhat we expectDays 1–30Product and data fluency on the two platforms you will deliver on. Shadow two live projects. Read the open project book and give your manager an independent read on which commitments you believe are at risk and why. Take first ownership of two to three in-flight projects.Days 31–60Carrying a full assigned book. First migration mapping specification authored and validated by you. A written assessment of the upgrade runbook, naming the specific steps that make upgrades slower or riskier than they need to be.Days 61–90At least [two] projects taken to signed customer acceptance. Your assigned share of the release upgrade wave scheduled with dates and customer windows agreed. Time logging and status reporting clean for the full quarter, without reminders.

How success is measured

Targets are set with your manager on joining and reviewed quarterly. Utilization is deliberately paired with completion: high utilization with low completion means projects are being over-worked, and it is treated as a problem, not a result.

What we are looking for

Required

  • Five or more years implementing enterprise or specialist software for external customers, personally owning delivery from kickoff to acceptance.
  • Demonstrable hands-on data migration work: profiling messy source data, authoring mapping specifications, transforming and loading, and reconciling the result well enough that a customer signs against it. SQL, plus at least one scripting language you use for real work (Python, PowerShell, Perl, or equivalent).
  • Experience configuring a metadata-driven or catalog-driven application — data models, controlled vocabularies, templates, workflows, permissions, and reporting.
  • A track record carrying eight or more concurrent customer projects without losing status accuracy.
  • Experience with single-tenant, on-premise, or dedicated-instance deployments, where an upgrade is a per-customer project rather than a platform release. This is the single most important differentiator in this search.
  • Credibility under go-live pressure: you can hold a date when it should be held, and reset one early, specifically, and in writing when it should not.
  • Time-logging and forecast discipline as a habit, not an imposition.
  • Clear written English. Mapping specifications, status notes, and risk escalations are the artifacts of this job.
  • Authorized to work in the United States or Canada without sponsorship, and able to overlap with United Kingdom business hours for part of the working day.
  • A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally, including to the United Kingdom and Ireland.

Strongly preferred

  • Delivery experience in the GLAM sector — galleries, libraries, archives, and museums — or in special libraries, legal information services, or records management.
  • Working knowledge of cataloging and archival description standards: MARC 21, Dublin Core, EAD, ISAD(G), RDA, OAI-PMH, or Z39.50.
  • Prior work on an integrated library system, library services platform, archival collection management system, digital asset management system, or resource-sharing platform.
  • Public-sector or government contract delivery, including work under formal acceptance and security requirements.
  • Jira and Confluence as day-to-day delivery tooling.

What we are not asking for

You do not need to be a librarian or an archivist by training, and you do not need to have sold anything. Domain vocabulary can be learned in weeks by someone with genuine migration and delivery competence. The reverse is not true.

Compensation

Base salary range for this role, published by country. The range reflects the level, not the location within a country; there is no location differential applied within either country.

Antons Sapriko, Company Founder

How to become a PR & Media Hacker at scandiweb?

We are a very inclusive company with colleagues from over 30 countries across all continents. We welcome people from all walks of life who can complete a practical test by showing how they think, create stories, and turn an ordinary business topic into something people want to discuss.
This is not a traditional PR position where your main responsibility is to prepare press releases, upload them to distribution platforms, and send the same pitch to a long media list. We are looking for someone who knows how to direct people's attention.
Your job will be to find the tension, consequence, opponent, proof, or human angle that turns it into a story worth sharing.
Sometimes the story already exists and needs to be discovered. Sometimes you will help create the real event, benchmark, public challenge, experiment, debate, collaboration, or campaign that gives the media a reason to cover it.
We welcome previous experience in PR, journalism, communications, creative agencies, content, startups, or growth marketing. However, the strongest evidence of your ability will be how you approach the practical tasks.
We value your ability to deliver results, your curiosity, your persistence, and your openness to learn from feedback. Continuous learning and acting on feedback are among our core organizational values.

What are the responsibilities of a PR & Media Hacker?

As a PR & Media Hacker at scandiweb, your main responsibility will be to create public attention around scandiweb, internal ventures, company developments, and selected client projects.
You will work closely with company founders and business leaders to identify stories that deserve public attention. You will not wait for someone to hand you a finished announcement. You will proactively search for opportunities, develop the angle, shape the campaign, collect the proof, and bring the story to the right audience.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Finding PR opportunities inside scandiweb (e.g., projects, client work, internal discussions, product development, research, technical achievements, market changes, etc)
  • Turning complex or seemingly ordinary topics into stories worth sharing with a strong headline, tension, consequence, and reason for people to care;
  • Developing creative PR campaigns and stunts and making people speak about it;
  • Creating real newsworthy moments when a strong story does not yet exist, rather than just waiting for them to appear;
  • Building several media angles around the same core event for different audiences;
  • Researching journalists, editors, newsletter writers, podcasters, creators, analysts, and industry communities that are relevant to each story;
  • Preparing personalized pitches and reaching out directly through email, social media, calls, introductions, events, and other appropriate channels;
  • Building long-term relationships with media professionals by understanding what they cover and bringing them useful, timely, and credible stories;
  • Coordinating interviews, expert comments, supporting data, visuals, demonstrations, customer evidence, and spokesperson preparation;
  • Working with content, design, video, data, and development teams to create the materials needed to prove and distribute a story;
  • Monitoring public conversations, competitor activity, industry news, and cultural trends to identify moments when scandiweb can contribute a relevant point of view;
  • Responding quickly when an unexpected media opportunity appears and coordinating the required internal contributors;
  • Using AI and research tools to monitor media, find patterns, identify relevant contacts, develop angles, and improve outreach without turning communication into automated spam;
  • Measuring campaign results, documenting what worked, and improving future campaigns based on actual media response and business impact.
The number of press releases produced will not measure success in this role.
It will be measured by the quality and relevance of earned media coverage, the conversations your campaigns create, the relationships you build, the attention generated among the right audiences, and the business opportunities supported by your work.

What do we expect from you?

We are looking for a curious, persistent, and highly proactive person who naturally looks for the story behind what is happening.
You may come from PR, journalism, media, content, communications, creative strategy, startup marketing, or another relevant background. A traditional PR career can come in handy. Still, you should be able to demonstrate that you have previously attracted attention, earned coverage, built an audience, or created public interest around an idea.
The following qualities will help you succeed in the role:
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to understand why one story gets covered while another is ignored;
  • The ability to find a compelling angle in technical, commercial, or otherwise ordinary information;
  • Excellent headline, pitch, and short-form writing skills;
  • Confident written and spoken English, as you will be working with international media and clients;
  • The ability to understand technical and business topics and explain them in simple language;
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to contact people directly rather than waiting for inbound interest;
  • Persistence when pitches are ignored, rejected, or require several attempts before receiving a response;
  • Comfort working with incomplete information and developing a campaign while the underlying project is still evolving;
  • The ability to manage several stories, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time;
  • Confidence when communicating with founders, executives, technical experts, clients, journalists, and creators;
  • The ability to work independently, make decisions, and take responsibility for campaign outcomes;
  • Curiosity about media, business, technology, eCommerce, culture, and the reasons people share information;
  • A practical understanding of social media, online communities, podcasts, newsletters, creator channels, and other forms of media beyond traditional publications.
Existing relationships with journalists, editors, creators, or industry media will be considered an advantage. However, we value your ability to identify and build the right relationships more than the size of an existing contact list.
Experience in eCommerce or technology will also be considered an advantage, but it is not mandatory. We will help you understand our industry, projects, services, and technical context.

What do we offer?

  • Monthly salary of 4200-5000 EUR NET, depending on experience and execution level.
  • Opportunity to gain stock options within the company
  • Support for hardware upgrades;
  • Core health insurance coverage and sports bonuses;
  • A diverse multinational team of experts to learn from;
  • Legendary online and onsite events to celebrate our success together.

Zu wem passt diese Position?

Du musst kein Steuerfachangestellter sein. Vielleicht kommst du aus einer Steuerkanzlei - oder du hast in einem Unternehmen gearbeitet, das mit DATEV arbeitet. Beides passt.   • 100 % Homeoffice, deutschlandweit: Du brauchst nicht umzuziehen und nicht zu pendeln.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

  • Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong executive presence and professional communication style

  • Must be a Mac OS user

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

  • Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

  • Device Requirement: Mac OS required

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

jobs.description:
Location

The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityAI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them.
We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see.
You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec.
  • Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision.
  • Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
  • Full-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious - clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on.
  • API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.

Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end-to-end in production
  • Strong Go for backend services - APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them
  • Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented
  • Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface
  • Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery
  • Product-oriented thinking - you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built
  • AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others
  • Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far

Are you a Do'er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced Senior Strategic Communications & Operations Specialist to drive strategic communications and cross-functional communications operations across Product Management and the broader organization.

This role translates complex business and product priorities into clear communications strategies, core messaging, and executable plans, ensuring the right stakeholders are informed, aligned, and prepared to act. The successful candidate will independently lead high-visibility communications programs and recurring operating rhythms that require coordination across Product Management, Customer Success, Sales, Enablement, Product Marketing, and other functions.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a strategic communicator who is comfortable operating in ambiguity. You will need to understand the broader objective, ask the right questions to create clarity, develop the communications approach, and manage the stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and execution required to bring that strategy to life.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS - AND ISN'T

This role sits at the intersection of strategic communications and cross-functional operations, helping Product Management and stakeholders across the organization stay informed, aligned, and equipped to execute.

This is not a traditional marketing or product marketing role. The position does not own demand generation, brand marketing, campaign strategy, market positioning, or promotional content.

Success in this role starts with strong communications judgment: understanding the objective, developing core messaging, determining who needs to know or act, and creating the right communications approach. From there, you will operationalize the strategy across multiple stakeholders, timelines, channels, and dependencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Communications Strategy & Execution

• Develop and execute strategic communications plans for high-priority product, business, organizational, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Develop clear core messaging and translate complex product and business information into concise, audience-appropriate communications for internal teams, customers, partners, and other stakeholders.

• Serve as a communications lead for high-visibility, product-led initiatives, coordinating messaging, stakeholder alignment, communications timelines, dependencies, and execution.

• Ask thoughtful questions to bring clarity to ambiguous or evolving initiatives and help stakeholders align around what needs to be communicated, to whom, when, and why.

• Partner closely with Product Management, Customer Success, Sales, Enablement, Product Marketing, and other functions to ensure communications are coordinated, accurate, and actionable.

Cross-Functional Communications Operations

• Turn broad strategic direction into structured communications workstreams, milestones, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

• Manage complex cross-functional communications programs from planning through delivery, proactively identifying risks, gaps, and dependencies and driving them toward resolution.

• Coordinate and influence stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority, creating clarity and maintaining momentum as priorities evolve.

• Establish lightweight processes, templates, and operating rhythms that improve the consistency, visibility, and scalability of communications work.

• Provide strategic communications and execution support for adjacent initiatives where teams need help developing and operationalizing an effective communications approach.

Product Management Engagement & Operating Rhythms

• Own internal Product Management engagement and communications programs that keep teams informed, connected, and aligned around priorities.

• Own the planning, agenda development, coordination, and follow-through for the bi-weekly internal Product Management team meeting.

• Develop and manage complementary communications that reinforce key updates, actions, priorities, and follow-ups for Product Management teams.

Roadmap, Customer & Partner Communications

• Own end-to-end communications operations for the quarterly Customer and Partner Roadmap Webinar, including communications strategy, planning, content coordination, speaker readiness, timelines, dependencies, and execution.

• Take a proactive, data-informed approach to roadmap communications by considering previous content and engagement, major product releases, business priorities, and customer needs when recommending future topics and messaging.

• Partner across Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to align roadmap communications with broader product and business priorities.

• Maintain the quarterly Product Roadmap presentation used by Go-to-Market teams, coordinating with Product Management and other stakeholders to ensure content is current, accurate, aligned, and ready for field use.

Reporting & Executive Communications

• Develop clear, executive-ready presentations, communications, and updates for senior stakeholders.

• Produce concise reporting based on core Product Management KPI dashboards, highlighting meaningful movement, trends, risks, and areas requiring attention.

• Analyze available data and context to identify meaningful insights and inform communications recommendations rather than simply reporting activity.

• Synthesize information from multiple sources into clear executive narratives that help stakeholders quickly understand what changed, why it matters, and where action or follow-up may be needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 5-7 years of experience in strategic communications, corporate communications, business communications, communications program management, or related roles.

• Demonstrated experience developing communications strategies and plans and independently leading complex, cross-functional communications initiatives with multiple stakeholders, timelines, dependencies, and competing priorities.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise, and audience-appropriate messaging.

• Strong program and project management fundamentals, including planning, prioritization, risk and dependency management, stakeholder engagement, and follow-through.

• Proven ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, ask the right questions, and translate broad objectives into practical, achievable communications plans.

• Experience creating executive-ready presentations, communications, and status updates for senior stakeholders.

• Comfort working with business metrics, dashboards, and engagement data and translating information into meaningful narratives, insights, and recommendations.

• Strong judgment, intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to influence and build trust across functions without direct authority.

• Experience in SaaS, technology, or another fast-moving environment is preferred but not required.

KEY SUCCESS FACTORS

• Independently turns broad direction into a clear communications strategy, core messaging, executable plan, and measurable next steps with limited day-to-day oversight.

• Operates effectively in ambiguity, asking the right questions and creating clarity even when processes, priorities, or requirements are still evolving.

• Anticipates stakeholder needs, risks, and dependencies early and proactively creates alignment before issues become blockers.

• Builds strong cross-functional partnerships and becomes a trusted communications and operations partner to Product Management leaders and stakeholders across the organization.

• Balances strategic communications thinking with hands-on execution, moving comfortably between developing the communications approach and driving the work required to deliver it.

• Uses data, business context, and audience needs to make informed communications recommendations rather than relying solely on stakeholder direction.

• Consistently delivers clear, accurate, high-quality communications and recurring programs on time, with the appropriate level of stakeholder alignment and readiness.

• Demonstrates flexibility and change agility in an environment where priorities and processes may evolve quickly.

• Improves communications operations over time by simplifying processes, creating repeatable approaches, and reducing friction for stakeholders.

The Commercial Special Servicing Analyst administers a wide range of tasks associated with an assigned portfolio of geographically diverse, non-performing, commercial/business purpose mortgage loans secured by investor owned commercial use, mixed use, SFR/multifamily rental and/or SFR/multifamily transitional properties. The role duties include analysis of collateral property information, loan accounting, loan document review, vendor administration, market research, direct investor communication, reporting, and assisting Special Servicing Asset Managers as needed. The position will frequently engage with Company offshore resources. The position may also support Primary Commercial Servicing representatives with property and/or market analysis, borrower interaction, and investor inquiries, as appropriate.

Job Functions and Responsibilities:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily:

  • Review loan accounting and prepare/verify calculations for legal demands.
  • Manage inbound calls and correspondence received from borrowers and internal groups as appropriate.
  • Review property valuation reports from appraisers, brokers, market sources, etc.
  • Review collateral property inspections.
  • Review property operating information received from borrowers and/or property managers.
  • Review commercial loan documents for borrower requirements and covenants.
  • Review performing loan reports to identify commercial loans at risk of transfer to special servicing.
  • Monitor property tax and insurance status for all assigned loan collateral.
  • Serve as main point of contact and liaison with external special servicers.
  • Administer requests from external special servicers.
  • Administer external special servicer and Asset Manager instructions for all posting and disbursement transactions as needed.
  • Maintain system data and reports as needed to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Regularly interact with Company resources in various departments, including offshore.
  • Review servicing agreements for servicer responsibilities, authorities and deadlines.
  • Administer invoices and reports from third-party vendors, including attorneys, inspectors, appraisers, property managers, investigators, receivers, brokers, contractors, title agents, insurance adjusters, etc., as needed.
  • Support Commercial Primary Servicing representatives in borrower outreach efforts, market analysis and investor inquiries, as needed.
  • Comply with all Company requirements for training, compliance, audits and reporting.
  • Anticipate/identify issues that could impact Company/client operations and suggest solutions.
  • Complete other activities and duties as may be assigned.

Key Result Areas:

  • Acknowledge/respond to external special servicer requests with 24 hours.
  • Provide daily updates to external special servicer for requests outstanding for more than 24 hours.
  • Process posting instructions from external epectial servicers with 24 hours.
  • Process invoices within three (3) days of receipt
  • Maintain 100% accuracy for all accounting calculations.
  • Provide appropriate instructions to other departments within agreed upon servicing level standards.
  • Successfully complete Company annual training requirements of not less than 40 hours.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience with defaulted commercial loans.
  • Demonstrated understanding of commercial loan document provisions, including interest accrual, tax and insurance administration, lender advances, etc.
  • Demonstrated understanding of commercial loan covenants and covenant compliance.
  • Demonstrated understanding of CRE income property operating documents such as rent rolls and income statements.
  • Demonstrated effective communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated effective problem solving and decision making skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to comply with detailed reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines and adjust to changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated skills with Microsoft 365 Suite, Adobe applications
  • Demonstrated skills with loan servicing applications (such as MSP, REALSynergy, Strategy, Enterprise, etc.).
  • Demonstrated teamwork skills to collaborate with associates in multiple departments.

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

Our Values

Best Life

Growth Mindset

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Consulting, professional services, or client-services background where managing bespoke deliverables was part of the job.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • Every top-20 client request is captured, triaged, and visible — no more requests living only in someone's inbox.
  • Faster, more predictable turnaround from request to delivery for strategic accounts.

What can you expect in an Associate Data Engineer role with TaskUs:

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Spain

Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in Spain.

About The Role

Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.

The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
  • Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
  • Own the developer experience end-to-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
  • Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
  • Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
  • Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.

Who You Are

  • Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
  • Deep knowledge of API-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
  • Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
  • Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi-currency payment platform is a strong plus.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A Panel interview session with two of our VPs of Engineering
  • A Technical Assessment with our Group CTO / Co-founder
  • A Behavioral and technical interview with our Group CEO / Founder
  • Technical Workshop with our Group CTO / Co-founder

Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with

  • Java (latest versions)
  • Spring and Spring Boot
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elastic search
  • Microservices architecture on AWS

What we can offer you

  • Own the payments infrastructure that thousands of businesses and developers build on, at a company processing hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually.
  • Work in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment at the core of how money moves in high-growth markets.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

What does a Lead Software Engineer at CoderPad do?

As a Lead Software Engineer at CoderPad, you’ll design, build, and ship features across our full stack — taking ownership of complex technical problems end to end and raising the engineering bar for the EMEA team. You’ll combine hands-on coding with technical leadership: driving architecture decisions, backlog grooming and planning with the Product Manager, making sure what we ship is reliable, scalable, and a pleasure for developers to use.

As the global leader in the technical interview space (4,000+ customers in 165+ countries) it is our goal as a Engineering team to build and scale the products that power millions of technical interviews and assessments worldwide.

This role is located in France and works standard CET / CEST hours, collaborating asynchronously with our distributed EMEA and US teams.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design and develop new full-stack features (React / TypeScript on the frontend, Java, Node.js, or Ruby on the backend) in collaboration with the Product Manager and the designer.

  • Use AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a core part of your workflow — to accelerate feature delivery, automate repetitive engineering tasks, and offload boilerplate so you can focus on design and review.

  • Contribute to architectural and technical design decisions within the team.

  • Write automated tests and ensure code quality through code reviews.

  • Deploy and monitor your own features in production (GitLab, AWS, Kubernetes).

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

  • Partner with Product and other teams to scope, prioritise, and deliver impactful work.

What you should bring

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including senior or lead-level ownership

  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (Java, Ruby, Node.js), a modern frontend framework (ideally React), and SQL. You don’t need to master all technologies from day one.

  • Solid experience designing scalable, reliable systems and conducting thorough code reviews.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a distributed, remote-first environment.

  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to ship faster — code generation, agentic workflows, scripting/automation, or building internal tooling on top of LLMs. We care about how effectively you use these tools, not which ones.

The Samsara Security team is looking for an Enterprise Security Technical Program Manager (TPM) to help drive key strategic initiatives across Samsara’s Security organization. As part of Samsara’s rapidly expanding Enterprise Security organization, you will support key strategic priorities and drive cross-functional initiatives. You will partner closely with a diverse set of teams—including Product Security, Platform Security and Compliance, Detection and Response, Biztech, and Engineering—to execute on critical security goals.   • 1-3 years Project or Program Management in a fast paced, technical company.
  • Experience with managing priorities across multiple teams, building processes, and coordinating tight schedules.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication- you can relay technical or analytical work to non-technical partners without losing the important details.
  • Strong sense of ownership, collaboration, curiosity and attention to detail. You learn quickly and can navigate ambiguity with ease.
  • A proactive self-starter with a proven track record for leveraging data and technology to improve processes and drive impactful decisions.
  • Experience using AI tooling and methods to drive efficiencies in workflows and team processes.
  • Experience using Agile practices and utilizing tools to drive insights, such as JIRA, Confluence, Tableau, and other reporting tools.

An ideal candidate also has:

But what truly sets us apart is our culture — relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.

If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here.

Virtualitics is seeking a quota-carrying Sales Account Executive to own the Manufacturing & Munitions ecosystem across the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base market. This role will build revenue-generating relationships with major primes, specialized suppliers and integrators, and emerging defense-technology companies supporting munitions production, energetics, industrial-base capacity, supplier resilience, depot and factory operations, and materiel readiness.

The successful candidate will execute five coordinated growth motions within strategic accounts: Sell-To, Sell-Through, Sell-With, Embed/OEM, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS). This is a hunter role for a seller who understands how defense companies capture, win, deliver, productize, and expand mission solutions in the United States and with eligible allied customers.

Ecosystem & Candidate Relationship Profile

We are looking for candidates with active, credible relationships across a mix of company types. The examples below are illustrative, not an assigned account list.

Major primes & OEMs

General Dynamics OTS, Northrop Grumman, RTX, Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control, BAE Systems, and L3Harris Aerojet Rocketdyne

Specialists & integrators

Day & Zimmermann, Nammo, Rheinmetall, American Ordnance, Chemring, and other critical suppliers

Emerging companies

new production, propulsion, energetics, and advanced-manufacturing defense companies

Relevant market signals include capacity expansion, production throughput, supplier risk, indentured bill-of-material visibility, quality, schedule, and allied replenishment demand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the ecosystem: Develop and execute a focused account and partner strategy across the Manufacturing & Munitions market, from executive relationship mapping through opportunity qualification, negotiation, and close.

  • Build qualified pipeline: Create new opportunities across major primes, specialized companies, and emerging providers; maintain disciplined account plans, deal stages, next actions, and forecast accuracy.

  • Sell-To: Position Virtualitics for the company’s internal AI, analytics, engineering, program, production, supply-chain, and delivery workflows.

  • Sell-Through: Join active U.S. Government pursuits early and work with capture and program teams to specify Virtualitics in proposals, architectures, contract vehicles, and funded programs.

  • Sell-With: Co-develop repeatable mission offerings that combine Virtualitics software with the partner’s domain expertise, integration, platform, and delivery capabilities.

  • Embed/OEM: Structure embedded and OEM licensing relationships in which Virtualitics capabilities become part of a partner platform or branded solution at scale.

  • Foreign Military Sales: Identify exportable solution opportunities with U.S. primes and eligible allied customers; navigate the FMS case lifecycle from pre-LOR shaping through Letter of Request (LOR), Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA), contracting, delivery, and expansion in coordination with internal export and legal resources.

  • Map mission use cases: Translate partner and government needs into credible AI opportunities across Class V and Class IX materiel visibility, production and depot analytics, supply-chain illumination, program intelligence, budget and audit support, and mission readiness.

  • Multi-thread relationships: Build trusted access across executive leadership, business development, capture, program delivery, technical, security, contracts, international, and FMS organizations.

  • Lead the internal team: Orchestrate solutions engineering, customer success, marketing, product, contracts, capture, executive advisors, and FMS/export specialists around the highest-value opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of success in a quota-carrying Federal sales, strategic accounts, channel, alliances, or business-development role.

  • Demonstrated relationships and revenue experience within the Manufacturing & Munitions market.

  • Experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, decision intelligence, or other complex mission technology solutions.

  • Evidence of net-new hunting, executive access, opportunity creation, multi-stakeholder qualification, negotiation, and closing.

  • Working knowledge of U.S. federal acquisition and FSI capture, including teaming, NDAs, IRAD, RFIs/RFPs, IDIQs, OTAs, task orders, and partner commercial structures.

  • Ability to communicate a complex technical and mission value proposition to executives, capture leaders, program teams, operators, and technical audiences.

  • Willingness to travel 40–50% and operate independently in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record executing two or more of the five growth motions, with strong preference for candidates who have built sell-through, OEM/embedded, or FMS revenue.

  • Experience with the FMS ecosystem and stakeholders, including U.S. primes, DSCA, Department of State, implementing agencies, Security Cooperation Organizations, and partner-nation customers.

  • Understanding of exportability, technology releasability, ITAR/export controls, data sovereignty, cybersecurity, cloud authorization, and classified or controlled mission environments.

  • Experience with MEDDPICC, Challenger, or another disciplined enterprise-sales methodology.

  • Active security clearance and bachelor’s degree, or equivalent relevant experience.

    • Clearance Requirement

    This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (interim and/or final). Continued employment is contingent upon successful adjudication; failure to obtain or maintain the required level of access may result in rescission of the job offer or termination of employment.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Establish ecosystem credibility, build the relationship map, qualify the initial account portfolio, and create a focused pipeline across the five motions.

  • First year: Convert new partner relationships into direct, program, joint-solution, embedded, and qualified international revenue paths while meeting or exceeding annual quota.

Compensation

    Competitive base salary based on experience and a lucrative 50/50 commission plan

What we offer you

At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

We offer highly competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents. Our benefits also include unlimited PTO and flexible work arrangements, with remote flexibility and hybrid options for team members based in the Los Angeles or Washington, DC areas.

  • Strong operational coordination skills with the ability to translate complex program needs into internal action plans.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving abilities. Demonstrated ability to manage escalations and drive resolution across cross-functional teams.

Product Marketing at Levanta is a growing, high-leverage function, and this is our second PMM hire. You'll work directly with the Director of Product Marketing to turn positioning, market and customer research, and enablement into programs and assets that sales, marketing, CS, and leadership rely on every day.

This is an execution-forward role for someone who enjoys taking ownership of key initiatives and driving projects end-to-end. You'll spend meaningful time getting close to Voice of Customer, on customer and sales calls, learning how Levanta actually wins and loses. You'll turn that into sharper messaging, better sales tools, and content that helps the business grow, including our expansion into non-Amazon marketplaces.

You should be comfortable moving between strategic thinking (how do we position to a different segment or buyer persona) and hands-on production (build the deck, write the one-pager, ship the battlecard), and you should be excited to use AI tools to do both faster and better.

What You'll Own

Messaging & Content Development. Turn the team's positioning and messaging frameworks into finished assets, including product copy, web pages, one-pagers, case studies, and sales narratives, each mapped to a specific audience, funnel stage, and channel (Amazon vs. non-Amazon).

Sales Enablement. Build and maintain enablement materials such as battlecards, objection-handling guides, discovery guides, and demo narratives. Support training and certification so sellers pitch consistently and confidently, especially as we build out GTM motions beyond Amazon.

Competitive Intelligence. Develop and maintain competitor teardowns and battlecards for our main competitors in the creator, influencer, and affiliate marketing space. Keep the CI repository current, and regularly capture and distribute insights surfaced by field-facing teams..

Launch Support. Partner with the Director of Product Marketing and the Product team on launch planning and coordination, GTM readiness, and internal and external launch communications.

Voice of Customer & Win/Loss. Help run structured customer and prospect interviews, synthesize themes, and feed insights back into messaging, personas, and roadmap conversations.

AI-assisted Production. Use AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, content generation, and ongoing maintenance of enablement content, freeing up time for higher-judgment work like positioning and stakeholder alignment. We expect AI to multiply this role's output quality, not replace judgment, so you should be comfortable reviewing, evaluating, and refining AI-generated output to a high bar.

Cross-functional Coordination. Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Marketing to keep messaging and enablement materials current, findable, and actually adopted, not just published.

  • Enablement and content stay current without becoming a manual, ad hoc scramble.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience in product marketing, or a closely adjacent function (content marketing, sales enablement, growth marketing), with exposure to positioning, messaging, or GTM content.
    • Experience building scalable, repeatable launch frameworks and formalizing product marketing operations is a plus.

We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to serve as the operational lead for the Informed Design & Industrialized Construction Marketing portfolio. You Are:

The ArcGIS Utility Network Consultant will support the design, configuration, and implementation of ArcGIS Utility Network solutions for electric and gas utility clients. Working alongside senior solution architects and project leadership, this role will help clients modernize legacy GIS environments while supporting the transition from traditional geometric network models to the ArcGIS Utility Network platform.

The Consultant will contribute to functional design, business process analysis, application configuration, testing, and implementation activities while partnering with client stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams. This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale utility transformation programs focused on improving grid operations, asset management, field mobility, and enterprise GIS capabilities.

The Work:

  • Support the implementation of ArcGIS Utility Network solutions for electric and gas utility clients.

  • Participate in requirements gathering, business process analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment activities.

  • Assist in translating utility business requirements into ArcGIS Utility Network capabilities and functional workflows.

  • Support the migration from legacy GIS environments (including ArcGIS Geometric Network) to ArcGIS Utility Network using industry best practices.

  • Collaborate with senior solution architects, technical teams, and client stakeholders to deliver high-quality GIS solutions.

  • Contribute to workshops, design sessions, system demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and end-user training activities.

  • Support integration efforts between GIS and enterprise platforms including Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Work Management, Outage Management Systems (OMS), Customer Information Systems (CIS), and field mobility solutions.

  • Develop project documentation, functional specifications, process flows, and client-ready deliverables.

  • Collaborate across business and technology teams to help clients modernize GIS capabilities and improve operational performance.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

We are open to hiring in most major cities in the US, that are near to an Accenture corporate office.

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience implementing ArcGIS Utility Network solutions within electric or gas utilities.

  • Experience supporting GIS implementation, business analysis, functional design, configuration, testing, or deployment activities.

  • Strong understanding of utility operational processes including engineering, asset management, field operations, construction, maintenance, or outage management.

    • ArcGIS Enterprise

    • ArcGIS Pro

    • ArcGIS Workforce

    • ArcGIS Survey123

  • Understanding of Utility Network concepts including:

    • Network topology

    • Asset and device modeling

    • Network rules

    • Network tracing

    • Branch versioning

  • Experience supporting integrations between GIS and enterprise systems.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience

Bonus Points If:

  • You have experience working for a utility, consulting firm, or Esri implementation partner.

  • You have experience supporting ArcGIS Utility Network migrations from ArcGIS Geometric Network.

  • You have exposure to Digital As-Builts, Field Mapping, Mobile Workforce Management, or Utility Engineering workflows.

AgelessRx is seeking a hands-on, highly organized IT Administrator to own the day-to-day operation of our internal technology environment. As a fully remote telehealth company, our employees rely heavily on company devices, cloud-based applications, identity and access systems, and secure technology infrastructure to do their work effectively.

This role will serve as the primary owner of employee-facing IT operations across AgelessRx, including company devices, SaaS applications, account provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, technical support, and IT asset management. This person will be responsible not only for resolving issues as they arise, but also for building scalable, well-documented systems and processes that make our technology environment easier to manage as the company grows.

The IT Administrator will work closely with our Senior Security Engineer to ensure that IT systems and processes support AgelessRx's security, privacy, and compliance requirements. While the Senior Security Engineer owns the broader security program and technical security strategy, the IT Administrator will be responsible for implementing and maintaining many of the day-to-day administrative controls that keep our workforce and systems operating securely.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys being both a builder and an operator: someone willing to troubleshoot an employee's device one moment and then improve an organization-wide device management, access, or SaaS administration process the next.

What you'll do

IT Systems & SaaS Administration

  • Own administration of AgelessRx's company-wide technology platforms, including Google Workspace, Anthropic, and other SaaS applications.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, permissions, licenses, application configurations, and administrative settings across company systems.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory of company applications, administrators, licenses, users, and system owners.
  • Partner with business teams to evaluate, configure, implement, and support new software and technology solutions.
  • Monitor SaaS utilization and licensing and identify opportunities to consolidate, remove, or optimize applications.
  • Maintain clear documentation for IT systems, configurations, administrative processes, and recurring procedures.

Identity, Access & Employee Lifecycle

  • Own IT provisioning and deprovisioning for employee and contractor onboarding, offboarding, and role changes.
  • Ensure employees have appropriate system and application access based on their roles and responsibilities.
  • Execute access changes and administrative controls in partnership with the Senior Security Engineer and company leadership.
  • Maintain accurate records of system access, administrative privileges, and company-issued technology.
  • Support recurring access reviews and promptly remediate identified access issues.
  • Develop scalable onboarding and offboarding processes that provide employees with the technology and access they need while protecting company systems and data.

Device & Endpoint Management

  • Own the lifecycle of company-issued laptops and other technology, including purchasing, imaging, configuration, deployment, inventory, support, recovery, and replacement.
  • Implement and administer AgelessRx's mobile device management (MDM) and endpoint management environment.
  • Maintain device configuration standards and ensure required applications, updates, and administrative controls are consistently deployed.
  • Coordinate shipping and retrieval of equipment for a fully remote workforce.
  • Maintain an accurate asset inventory and clear ownership records for company devices.
  • Partner with the Senior Security Engineer to implement endpoint security requirements and remediate device-related security issues.

Employee IT Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal technical support across AgelessRx.
  • Diagnose and resolve employee issues involving company devices, applications, accounts, permissions, connectivity, and other workplace technology.
  • Establish an organized system for receiving, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT requests.
  • Identify recurring employee issues and implement systemic solutions rather than repeatedly addressing the same problems.
  • Create clear employee-facing documentation and self-service resources for common technology needs.
  • Provide responsive, thoughtful support to employees working across a fully remote environment.

IT Infrastructure, Data & Operations

  • Support and maintain AgelessRx's internal technology and data infrastructure.
  • Manage file storage, sharing, permissions, and collaboration systems across the organization.
  • Lead technology migrations and implementations as business needs evolve.
  • Maintain appropriate backup, recovery, retention, and administrative processes for company-managed systems in partnership with Security and other stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks, gaps, or inefficiencies within the company's technology environment and proactively recommend solutions.

Security & Compliance Partnership

  • Work closely with the Senior Security Engineer to maintain a secure and compliant technology environment.
  • Implement and maintain IT controls established through AgelessRx's security and compliance programs, including identity, access, endpoint, and device-management requirements.
  • Support access reviews, audits, evidence collection, incident response, and other recurring security or compliance activities.
  • Escalate suspected security incidents, vulnerabilities, inappropriate access, or other technology risks promptly.
  • Help ensure approved company applications and devices are configured and used in accordance with AgelessRx policies.
  • Support implementation of controls governing company-approved AI tools and other emerging technologies.

During the first several months, this role will be expected to help lead foundational IT initiatives, including:

  • Complete AgelessRx's migration from OneDrive to Google Drive, including departmental files, permissions, ownership, and employee transition.
  • Implement and deploy a company-wide MDM solution and establish an ongoing process for device configuration, inventory, security, maintenance, and recovery.
  • Assess the current SaaS and IT environment and establish a centralized inventory of applications, licenses, administrators, system owners, and access.
  • Standardize IT onboarding and offboarding processes across employees and contractors.
  • Establish a scalable internal IT support process, including documentation, request tracking, prioritization, and employee self-service resources.
  • Support Zendesk administration and technical integrations, including AI-related integrations, as business ownership requires.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in IT administration, systems administration, corporate IT, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting a distributed or fully remote workforce.
  • Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace in a business environment.
  • Experience administering SaaS applications, user accounts, permissions, groups, and licenses across an organization.
  • Experience implementing or administering MDM and endpoint-management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management fundamentals, including SSO, MFA, least-privilege access, and account lifecycle management.
  • Experience managing employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT perspective.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across devices, operating systems, SaaS applications, accounts, permissions, and connectivity.
  • Experience managing company hardware, asset inventory, device deployment, and remote equipment logistics.
  • Strong documentation and process-development skills.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously and prioritizing competing needs in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly when supporting non-technical employees.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field or equivalent relevant professional experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience working in healthcare, telehealth, or another regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and the technology controls associated with protecting PHI.
  • Experience implementing or improving IT operations at a growing startup.
  • Experience with Google Workspace migrations, particularly Microsoft 365/OneDrive to Google Workspace/Drive.
  • Experience selecting, implementing, or migrating MDM platforms.
  • Familiarity with security tools, endpoint protection, access reviews, audit evidence collection, and incident-response processes.
  • Experience administering Zendesk or similar support platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise administration of AI tools and emerging SaaS technologies.

  3. Energy (“Vibes”). You’re the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

Skills, Knowledge and Traits

You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Here’s what we need from you:
  1. Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and don’t stop until things are finished properly.

  3. Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or don’t). You’re the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $30/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
