jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Field Verification
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Spain

Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Field Verification to join us in Spain.

About the role

Field Verification is how Moniepoint knows that the people and businesses on our platform are real. Every Moniepoint customer, retail and business, requires a completed field verification as part of KYC. The platform coordinates physical, in-person checks — verifying individuals, business owners, business addresses and loan guarantors — and it serves nearly every part of the company: onboarding, loans, compliance and the fraud team.

The system works today. A back office gives each business unit visibility and control over its own verification requests. A mobile-friendly web app puts the work in the hands of Field Verification Officers and the cluster leads who manage them across local government areas. An API layer lets other business units push verification requests in and receive results back by webhook, and an assignment algorithm routes each request to an officer close enough to carry it out.

We want to be straightforward about the rest. This domain has never had a dedicated engineering leader, and that is the single biggest constraint on it. The team is one lean, cross-functional squad — an Engineering Manager, four engineers and a QA — carrying verification volume for the entire customer base. They have done that impressively well, but running lean means running in keep-the-lights-on mode, and a long list of things that would make this platform substantially better has been waiting for someone to own it.

That list is the role. Trip and route management, so an officer can plan an optimal day across several sites rather than making a separate journey for each one — today we pay for a round trip per verification, and the logistics are nowhere near optimal. Capacity management. A native mobile app, wanted for a long time and never resourced. Liveness and identity verification tooling, exposed as APIs the rest of the business can build on. And as Moniepoint expands into markets where identity verification is as difficult as it is in Nigeria, Kenya among them, a platform that works beyond a single country.

There is a great deal of room to build here. Whoever takes this on will set the direction rather than inherit someone else's plan, on a system that already carries real weight for the business.

As Head of Engineering, Field Verification, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Field Verification platform end to end, and setting direction for a domain that has been running without dedicated engineering leadership.
  • Moving the platform from keep-the-lights-on operation to deliberate, prioritised development.
  • Leading and growing the existing cross-functional team, and building the organisation out as scope expands.
  • Building the operational efficiency layer — trip and route optimisation, task allocation and capacity management for field officers.
  • Owning the platform's client-facing surface: the APIs and webhooks that other business units integrate with, and the back office those units rely on.
  • Delivering a native mobile experience for field officers.
  • Ensuring verification data is structured, auditable and fit for compliance scrutiny.
  • Building for multi-country expansion as Moniepoint enters new markets.
  • Partnering closely with Product and with the business units that depend on the platform — onboarding, loans, compliance and fraud.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and hiring and developing engineers and Engineering Managers.

Who you are

  • You have built things yourself, and grew into leadership from there. We are explicit about this: we are not looking for someone who moved into management early and has led from a distance since. We want an engineer who became a leader.
  • You are capable across disciplines. Backend, web and mobile. This platform spans all three and you will need credibility in each — a specialist in one layer will struggle here.
  • You have built platforms, not just products. Systems used by several distinct groups of users and internal business units, with the flexibility to serve requirements you did not anticipate.
  • You are a problem solver first. We would rather have someone adaptable than someone with the exact domain experience. Having built across different industries — fintech, e-commerce, logistics or otherwise — is a positive signal, not a scattered CV.
  • You have 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on production engineering and strong backend depth. Our backend environment is Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have at least 5 years of engineering leadership, including managing Engineering Managers.
  • You collaborate well with product and business stakeholders, and can translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Experience working with location and geospatial data is a strong plus, including map integrations.
  • Experience with route, trip or delivery optimisation is a strong plus.
  • Experience building for compliance — where data must be structured to evidence what was done and when — is a strong plus.
  • Experience with identity, KYC or verification platforms is a plus. None of these four are requirements.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like

  • The domain has clear technical ownership and direction for the first time.
  • The team out of keep-the-lights-on mode and delivering against a prioritised roadmap.
  • Measurable improvement in field officer efficiency — more verifications per trip, lower cost per verification.
  • A native mobile experience shipped for field officers.
  • Verification data that stands up to compliance scrutiny across every business unit the platform serves.
  • The platform ready to support a new market.
  • A team grown beyond its current size, with a strong bench of engineers and managers.

Why Join Us

  • A genuinely greenfield mandate on a system that already matters. Every customer Moniepoint onboards passes through this platform.
  • A lean, capable team making outsized impact, and the remit to build the organisation around them.
  • Breadth: backend, web, mobile, location data, compliance and operational optimisation in one domain.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect in The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Job Description:

Data Governance Analyst

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Data Governance Analyst will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's data governance framework so that data is managed and protected as a strategic enterprise asset and to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. This role acts as a Data Standards Architect, defining and documenting data standards, definitions, and structures across systems, and works closely with legal, compliance, security, and business stakeholders to ensure data is handled in accordance with privacy, security, retention, classification, and regulatory requirements. This role also ensures alignment with Judiciary policies, practices, and the current Data Governance Roadmap, and fosters a data driven culture across the AO and local courts.

The Data Governance Analyst will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the CMM Data Governance framework, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models.
  • Serve as a Data Standards Architect, define, document, and maintain data standards, naming conventions, data definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain data governance standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, records management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models.
  • Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, security, privacy, legal, records management, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements.
  • Ensure data assets are appropriately classified and managed based on sensitivity, criticality, and business value.
  • Support compliance with data privacy, security, retention, classification, records management, and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate policies and regulatory requirements into actionable data governance controls and procedures.
  • Identify governance gaps, risks, and areas of non-compliance and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes.
  • Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data domain forums.
  • Develop governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, and supporting artifacts.
  • Monitor adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards.
  • Support governance-related assessments, audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Contribute to the development of data governance roadmaps, maturity assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support the data stewardship program by defining data ownership roles, responsibilities, and RACI models across business and technical teams.
  • Develop training materials and deliver awareness sessions on data governance policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Track, analyze, and report data governance program metrics, maturity, and compliance status to leadership and governance councils.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience translating governance policy into practical operational processes in delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of data quality management, metadata practices, and stewardship models.
  • Experience governing high-sensitivity or regulated data with clear compliance expectations.
  • Experience with data quality profiling and monitoring techniques and common tooling patterns.
  • Experience defining and governing enterprise data standards across multiple teams and delivery pods.
  • Strong background in data modeling, integration patterns, and change data capture concepts.
  • Experience with metadata and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, or Qlik.
  • Practical experience implementing glossary and lineage capabilities in modern data platforms.
  • Ability to translate technical metadata into business-friendly definitions and documentation.
  • Experience implementing data privacy controls in regulated or high-sensitivity environments.
  • Experience with access management and operationalizing privacy requirements.
  • Experience partnering with security, governance, and engineering teams to implement compliant data sharing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Federal Government or regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
  • Data management certification.

At Shakepay, we’re on a mission to usher in the Bitcoin golden age. We’re reimagining financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.

Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us!

About Shakepay

Since 2015, we've been on a mission to help Canadians build long-term wealth through bitcoin. Over the past few years, we've expanded beyond buying and selling bitcoin to offer a growing suite of everyday financial products - including the Shakepay Card, direct deposit, bill payments and Interac e-Transfer - making it easier to earn, save and use bitcoin every day. Today, more than 1.5 million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future as we continue to push the boundaries of what modern financial services can look like.

We’re regulated as an investment dealer across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with a funding of $44M. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we’re looking for people who want to help us build something truly special.

About the team

The Legal team sits at the center of some of Shakepay’s most important decisions. We partner closely with Product, Compliance, Operations, Finance, People, and leadership to bring new products to market, navigate complex regulatory questions and help the business move quickly with confidence. We believe ownership over hierarchy, practical judgment over perfection, and using technology and AI to rethink how legal work gets done.

About the role

As Senior Legal Counsel, you’ll help shape how millions of Canadians interact with money. You’ll work alongside product, compliance and executive leadership to solve novel legal questions at the intersection of crypto, payments and financial regulation. This is a hands-on role for someone who can navigate ambiguity, provide practical recommendations and wants to help build - not just protect - the business.

What you’ll be doing

  • Partner with Product, Compliance and business teams to help design and launch new products, translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical solutions.
  • Advise on a broad range of legal and regulatory matters across securities, AML/ATF, payments, consumer protection and other areas impacting Shakepay's business.

  • Support the team on a variety of other legal matters as needed, including commercial agreements, corporate governance, employment and strategic projects.

  • Canadian-qualified lawyer with 5+ years of experience, ideally in fintech, payments, financial services, crypto, or a fast-moving technology company.

  • Business-oriented legal judgment: you start from the product or business outcome, then help the team understand risk, options, and a recommended path.
  • Comfortable advising product and operational teams directly, including on ambiguous questions where there may not be a perfect answer.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex legal issues into clear, practical guidance for non-legal stakeholders.

Bonus points

  • Experience working across both a law firm and an in-house legal team.
  • Experience in a startup or scaleup environment where priorities change quickly and legal support needs to be pragmatic.
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin, crypto, securities, payments, AML, or regulated financial products in Canada.
  • Experience using AI, automation, or lightweight tooling to improve legal work product and team efficiency.

Job Description Summary

The Global Senior Director for Pharma Partnerships is responsible for building, leading, and delivering GE HealthCare’s strategic pharmaceutical alliances to advance both approved and pipeline radiopharmaceutical assets.
This role operates as the enterprise alliance manager for key pharma partnerships, owning senior executive relationships and ensuring delivery of joint strategic, clinical, and commercial objectives. The Director defines partnership strategy, shapes deal constructs, and establishes governance frameworks that enable efficient execution and value realization across the lifecycle.
Working cross-functionally, the leader ensures GE HealthCare assets—including FAPI and the Alzheimer’s disease portfolio—are embedded within pharma development programs, enabling CDx pathways, de-risking development, and ensuring successful global commercialization. The role is central to positioning GE HealthCare as the partner of choice for both pharma and providers. Success in this role is defined by embedding GE HealthCare assets into leading pharma programs, enabling CDx pathways at scale, and consistently delivering partnership value that translates into commercial leadership.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Partnership Strategy & Asset Integration

  • Define and lead the global pharma partnership strategy, aligned to priority assets and disease areas with initial focus on FAPI and AD portfolio
  • Proactively identify and secure opportunities to embed GE HealthCare diagnostics within pharma pipelines and clinical programs
  • Drive early “design-in” of assets to maximize probability of CDx adoption and downstream commercial success
  • Translate partnership insights into portfolio priorities and stage-gate investment decisions
  • Collaborate with CMC, supply chain, regulatory affairs and R&D to build capabilities that enables GEHC to deliver on key pharma partnership priorities

Deal Structuring, Governance & Value Delivery

  • Shape partnership structures, including scope, financial frameworks, milestones, and governance mechanisms
  • Ensure alignment between contractual commitments and operational delivery across all functions
  • Define and track partnership KPIs, ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and value realization
  • Oversee execution of partnership deliverables, including co-development, supply, and commercialization components

Alliance Management & Executive Engagement

  • Serve as the primary alliance manager across strategic pharma partnerships, with end-to-end accountability for outcomes
  • Own C-suite and senior stakeholder relationships, ensuring alignment on strategy, priorities, and value creation
  • Establish and lead Joint Steering Committees and executive governance forums
  • Drive clear escalation pathways, decision rights, and operating cadence to maintain execution velocity

Cross-Functional Integration & Execution

  • Lead cross-functional orchestration across Clinical, Regulatory, Medical, Market Access, Supply, and Commercial teams
  • Align development strategies to enable CDx labeling with efficient clinical and regulatory pathways
  • Coordinate global commercial strategy and launch readiness in alignment with pharma partners
  • Act as the internal integrator to ensure consistency of strategy, messaging, and execution across teams

Risk Management

  • Identify and proactively manage risks across clinical, regulatory, operational, and commercial dimensions
  • Establish structured feedback loops from partnerships to inform future deal-making and asset strategy
  • Drive disciplined, data-based stage-gate decisions based on partnership performance and emerging evidence

External Positioning

  • Reinforce GE HealthCare’s position as a preferred pharma partner through high-quality execution and credibility
  • Build long-term relationships across pharma development, BD, and product leadership teams
  • Expand partnership opportunities across priority assets and disease areas through proactive engagement

Ideal Profile

  • Significant experience in pharmaceutical partnerships, business development, or alliance management, including structuring and executing complex collaborations across development and commercialization
  • Experience shaping partnership strategy and translating it into deal structures, operational plans, and measurable outcomes
  • Strong external credibility, with experience engaging pharma partners, business development leaders, and scientific stakeholders
  • Demonstrated track record of managing strategic partnerships end-to-end, including governance, Joint Steering Committees, and executive-level stakeholder engagement
  • Strong understanding of drug and diagnostic development, with experience supporting or enabling CDx strategies, clinical development programs, and regulatory pathways
  • Proven ability to operate in complex, cross-functional global environments and influence without direct authority across R&D, clinical, regulatory, and commercial teams
  • Experience working across global markets, with appreciation of regional differences in clinical development, regulatory, and market access pathways
  • Track record of influencing C-suite stakeholders and driving alignment across organizations in high-stakes partnerships

jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges. Our services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, ensuring efficient and accelerated growth. Founded by industry professionals in IT, design, and data analytics, we address the market need for exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, we value people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and strong relationships. Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry-leading services and customer experiences.

﻿Role overview

The Video Editor / Motion Designer at CapsLock creates and edits high-performing video content with the primary goal of improving conversion rates. This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, motion design, and modern AI tooling — producing advertising videos that convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and landing pages.

You'll work closely with the Creative Director, marketers, and copywriters to develop, test, and iterate on video concepts, using AI tools alongside traditional post-production to accelerate output and raise the quality bar.

Responsibilities

﻿

Video Creation & Production

  • Develop video ads from concept to final delivery — funnel formats, YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Edit and enhance videos using dialogue, graphics, music, sound design, and visual effects, ensuring logical sequencing and strong storytelling
  • Create AI-generated advertising creative for paid social and landing pages, converting cold traffic into warm leads
  • Produce and refine photorealistic human characters in video, with attention to realism in motion, expression, and speech synchronisation
  • Enhance video quality through upscaling, smoothness improvements, and post-processing
  • Deliver polished final cuts optimised for advertising performance goals

Concept Development & Pre-Production

  • Craft clear storylines and narrative structures tailored to platform and audience
  • Prepare shoot guides and gather reference materials when collaborating with videographers
  • Research and propose multiple creative angles, selecting the best options based on data and research
  • Test different formats, calls-to-action, and visual approaches

AI Tools & Optimization

  • Research, test, and integrate new AI tools into the production workflow to improve efficiency and output quality
  • Experiment with AI-assisted editing techniques including avatar generation, voice synthesis, and automated post-production
  • Use AI tools to reduce production time without compromising quality

Analytics & Performance

  • Analyse video performance metrics and use insights to optimise creative
  • Run A/B tests on formats, hooks, CTAs, and creative elements — monitor and document results promptly
  • Build deep product knowledge and apply it to data-driven creative decisions

Collaboration & Trend Integration

  • Work closely with the Creative Director, copywriters, marketers, and designers to ensure creative alignment
  • Track and apply the latest video trends, viral formats, and platform-specific features
  • Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • Full post-production capability: cutting, titling, colour correction, After Effects, sound mixing
  • Strong command of video rhythm, pacing, transitions, typography, and sound design
  • Skills in improving video quality — sharpness, smoothness, upscaling
  • Hands-on experience creating AI-generated video from scratch or from references
  • Ability to produce realistic human characters in video, including lip-sync and speech-to-movement synchronisation
  • Deep enough understanding of video editing to speak the language and spot problems early
  • Ability to work from a detailed brief and proactively propose creative solutions
  • Comfort collaborating with a Creative Director on iterations and new concepts

Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in video editing, post-production, or motion design as a primary discipline
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Desktop-based editing is required — portfolios built on mobile-only tools such as CapCut will not be considered
  • Experience working within an agency or structured in-house team, with established workflows and reporting lines
  • Working experience with AI video tools: Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar
  • Experience with AI image generation tools: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar
  • Solid understanding of video formats for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
  • Comfortable reviewing performance analytics and iterating based on data
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

﻿Soft Skills

  • Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches
  • Adaptable to shifting priorities and fast-paced team dynamics
  • High execution speed without compromising quality
  • Consistent on-time delivery and strong attention to deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around compliance and brand guidelines
  • Critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset
  • Clear, professional communication and team collaboration skills
  • Initiative to find solutions even when processes are undefined

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

  • Perform essential user management tasks such as resolving access issues, processing name changes, and updating email information to facilitate system access.

  • Troubleshoot end user issues across designated platforms, triaging to identified resolver groups as needed.

  • Log all support requests from help desk inquiries into a ticketing system.

  • Work effectively with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve issues.

  • Implement various projects, develop work plans, and ensure timely completion as directed by the IT manager.

  • Assist new and existing users with acquiring access to systems and databases through email support and use of the Service Console.

  • Exceptional customer service skills are required.

  • Strong interpersonal skills for communicating with internal and external personnel of all levels.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Familiarity with Tableau and its functions.

  • Ability to multi-task and work independently with minimal supervision.

  • Ability to keep sensitive information protected.

  • Ability to take direction and remain detail oriented.

  • This position may require shift hours including weekends and holidays. Shift schedules are based on customer need and are subject to change.

Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As the Chief Financial Officer, you will play a critical role in supporting a diversified family office overseeing operating businesses, private equity investments, public equities, and real estate assets. You'll work closely with the principal to build a sophisticated strategic finance capability across the portfolio, providing the forecasting, financial modelling, investment analysis, and quantitative decision support needed to make informed capital allocation decisions.

This role is ideal for a senior finance leader who combines deep FP&A and financial modelling expertise with strong commercial judgment and an investment-oriented mindset. Rather than functioning as a traditional Controller or reporting-focused CFO, you'll act as the principal's senior financial thought partner—building the family's forward-looking finance capability, evaluating investment opportunities, challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and proactively uncovering opportunities to grow and optimize the portfolio.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Accountability

FP&A, Forecasting & Strategic Planning

  • Build and lead the FP&A function across the family office.
  • Develop integrated forecasts and financial projections across EGE Holdings and its underlying businesses.
  • Build scenario models around operating companies, investments, and portfolio decisions.
  • Establish forward-looking financial planning processes across a previously consolidation-focused finance function.
  • Develop sensitivity analyses to assess potential outcomes under different operating, market, and investment assumptions.
  • Translate forecasts and financial projections into clear recommendations for the principal.
  • Improve visibility into future liquidity, capital requirements, returns, and financial risks.

Investment Analysis & Capital Allocation

  • Serve as the quantitative lead supporting capital allocation decisions across the family office.
  • Evaluate prospective private equity, public market, real estate, and operating-company investments.
  • Build investment, valuation, and return models to assess opportunities and downside scenarios.
  • Perform quantitative risk analysis across existing and prospective investments.
  • Assess trade-offs between competing uses of capital.
  • Develop consistent analytical frameworks for evaluating investment opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve portfolio returns and deploy capital more effectively.
  • Provide objective financial analysis to support significant investment decisions.

Portfolio Risk Analysis

  • Develop a holistic view of financial risk across the family office portfolio.
  • Assess concentration, liquidity, leverage, and investment risks.
  • Model downside and stress scenarios across different asset classes and operating businesses.
  • Evaluate prospective investments in the context of existing portfolio exposure.
  • Identify emerging financial risks and recommend appropriate responses.
  • Provide the principal with clear quantitative insight into risk/reward trade-offs.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Act as the principal's senior financial thought partner on complex business and investment decisions.
  • Provide quantitative analysis for strategic questions across EGE and its underlying operating companies.
  • Translate financial information into commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Challenge assumptions and provide an independent financial perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, capital efficiency, and portfolio performance.
  • Proactively bring financial insights and opportunities to the principal rather than waiting for requests.
  • Support strategic decisions across new ventures, operating businesses, and investment activities.

Consolidated Financial Management

  • Own consolidated financial reporting across EGE Holdings and its underlying entities.
  • Ensure the principal has clear visibility into financial performance across the ownership structure.
  • Oversee entity-level financial reporting and consolidation.
  • Coordinate multi-entity tax requirements with external tax advisors.
  • Establish financial reporting standards that provide decision-useful insight beyond statutory and tax requirements.
  • Maintain appropriate financial controls and reporting standards across the portfolio.

Finance Leadership & Controller Management

  • Lead and develop controllers and finance leaders embedded within EGE's operating companies.
  • Establish consistent standards and expectations across entity-level finance functions.
  • Review the quality and usefulness of financial reporting produced across the portfolio.
  • Coach controllers toward stronger analytical and commercially focused finance capabilities.
  • Create greater connectivity between operating-company finance and family-office decision-making.
  • Build a scalable finance organization as EGE's portfolio grows.
  • Identify gaps in finance capabilities and determine where additional resources are required.

External Advisor & Financial Partner Management

  • Partner effectively with private banks, wealth advisors, tax professionals, legal counsel, and other external financial stakeholders.
  • Review and challenge external financial analysis where appropriate.
  • Determine which analytical capabilities should be developed and maintained internally.
  • Reduce unnecessary dependence on external advisors by strengthening internal financial capabilities.
  • Maintain productive external relationships while retaining internal ownership of financial analysis and decision-making.

AI-Enabled Finance

  • Use AI tools to accelerate financial analysis, research, modelling, reporting, and decision support.
  • Leverage Claude and other advanced AI tools within day-to-day finance workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to automate or improve recurring financial analysis and reporting.
  • Apply appropriate financial judgment and validation to AI-assisted outputs.
  • Help establish efficient, AI-enabled workflows across the broader finance organization.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with the principal, controllers and finance leaders across EGE's operating companies, private banks, wealth advisors, tax professionals, legal counsel, and other external financial partners. As the senior financial owner of the family office, you'll connect portfolio-level financial information with strategic decision-making and ensure the principal has the insight needed to allocate capital effectively.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

As a Chief Financial Officer, your vertical focus will be on strategic finance, FP&A, financial modelling, investment analysis, and capital allocation, while your horizontal focus will include portfolio risk, consolidated reporting, finance leadership, stakeholder management, and AI-enabled financial analysis.

  • Experience: Significant senior-level finance leadership experience, ideally as a CFO, VP Finance, Head of FP&A, Investment Finance leader, or equivalent strategic finance role within a sophisticated investment or multi-entity environment.
  • FP&A: Deep experience building and leading forecasting, planning, projection, and scenario-modelling capabilities.
  • Financial Modelling: Advanced financial modelling skills across forecasting, valuation, investment analysis, scenario planning, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Investment Analysis: Demonstrated experience quantitatively evaluating investments, returns, risk, and capital allocation decisions.
  • Strategic Finance: Strong commercial judgment with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Portfolio & Risk Analysis: Ability to assess liquidity, concentration, leverage, downside risk, and portfolio-level trade-offs across multiple asset classes.
  • Consolidated Finance: Strong command of consolidated financial statements and experience operating across complex, multi-entity ownership structures.
  • Finance Leadership: Experience managing or leading controllers, finance managers, or entity-level finance teams.
  • Stakeholder Management: Confidence partnering directly with principals, founders, executives, private banks, wealth advisors, tax professionals, and legal counsel.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating independently as a senior thought partner in an entrepreneurial environment where you are expected to identify questions, build solutions, and drive decisions forward.
  • AI Fluency: Strong proficiency with AI tools and a willingness to incorporate AI into financial research, modelling, analysis, and reporting workflows.
  • Communication: Executive-level written and verbal English with the ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly and persuasively.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Strategic Financial Leadership: Your ability to develop and lead financial strategy in alignment with broader business objectives and long-term growth plans.
  • Financial Planning, Forecasting & Modelling: Your ability to build financial plans, forecasts, and models that provide leadership with a clear view of performance and future scenarios.
  • Investment & Capital Analysis: Your ability to evaluate investments, capital allocation decisions, and financial opportunities using rigorous analysis and commercial judgement.
  • Business Performance & Profitability: Your ability to assess financial and operational performance, identify key value drivers, and recommend actions that improve profitability and enterprise value.
  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Your ability to communicate financial insights with clarity, influence senior decision-makers, and act as a trusted strategic partner to leadership.
  • Risk, Governance & Decision-Making: Your ability to identify financial risks, evaluate trade-offs, and establish sound financial governance while supporting informed business decisions.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

jobs.description:
Job Description:

ITW (Illinois Tool Works) is a Fortune 300 global manufacturer with approximately 44,000 employees across 51 countries. For over 100 years, we’ve delivered innovative, customer-focused solutions in industries ranging from automotive and aerospace to construction and electronics.

Our success is driven by our differentiated business model comprised of our unique core capabilities: our 80/20 approach, customer-back innovation, and our decentralized, entrepreneurial culture. These capabilities are unmistakably ITW and key to our longevity and strong performance. Our products and solutions are at work all over the world, and we are never more than a few steps from an innovative ITW solution.

ITW Commercial Construction North America (CCNA), a division of ITW, includes trusted brands like Buildex® (Teks®, Sammys®), Red Head (TruBolt®, Tapcon®), Ramset (Trakfast®), and PNA®, serving professional contractors since 1910. We design and manufacture innovative fastening, and concrete flatwork solutions for concrete, drywall, metal buildings, fire protection, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC applications.

We’re committed to operational excellence, responsive service, and continuous product innovation, and are always focused on meeting the evolving needs of the commercial construction industry.

We are currently looking for a Field Sales Engineer to join our team! This individual will identify and engage with top building owners, architectural, engineering, general contractor, and design firms targeted within chosen metro markets with the goal of adding CCNA products on the master specification and driving sales of specified products. This is a remote role, with preference for candidates to be located in major markets within the Eastern United States.

Primary responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key architectural, engineering, and design firms to influence product specifications and drive specification conversions.
  • Create, recommend, and execute specification programs across targeted markets to achieve annual conversion and growth objectives.
  • Provide technical training, product application guidance, and code-related support to architects, engineers, designers, building owners, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs).
  • Analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer insights to identify opportunities and drive specification growth strategies.
  • Support the sales team by providing technical expertise, interpreting engineering reports and building codes, and demonstrating design equivalency for key projects.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to develop and execute specification selling plans while providing Voice of Customer insights to support the CBI pipeline.
  • Measure program effectiveness, monitor results, and provide recommendations for continuous improvement and business growth.
  • Additional responsibilities as assigned

Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering required; Master's degree preferred.
  • 3+ years of technical sales or specification-selling experience; PE license or progress toward licensure preferred.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to effectively influence multiple decision-makers.
  • Ability to read construction drawings, analyze project specifications, and interpret building code requirements.
  • Results-oriented with strong organizational skills, the ability to manage multiple priorities, and excellent follow-through.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and willing to travel up to 50%, including overnight travel.

We do not accept unsolicited resumes. To be considered an applicant, please apply online to a specific job posting. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the online application system process due to your disability, please click here for information on how to contact us directly.

Compensation Information:

As part of our Core Commitments, we strive to be a great employer by attracting and developing top talent. We support career growth through continuous learning and advancement opportunities, while promoting an inclusive environment through Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).

The pay range for this position is $100,000 to $110,000. Base pay within this range is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant skills, experience, and education This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive plan/sales incentive plan.

In addition to a competitive salary, employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; disability and life insurance; a 401(k) plan with company match and additional employer contributions; flexible spending accounts. More details can be found on our ITW Benefits website .

ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.

As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Azure Cloud Solutions Architect - Remote in US to join our team in Chicago, Illinois (US-IL), United States (US).

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Solutions Architect to lead the design, architecture, and migration of enterprise solutions to Microsoft Azure. This role will be responsible for designing secure, scalable, and high-performing cloud solutions while providing technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Azure cloud services, cloud migration strategies, infrastructure-as-code, and modern application architectures.

jobs.title: Technical Solution Lead
jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Sureify we’re helping a large and critical industry -- life insurance -- modernize and innovate.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Sureify we’re helping a large and critical industry -- life insurance -- modernize and innovate. We have built a platform, enabling a core suite of digital solutions for some of the world’s leading insurance companies. We’re passionate about enhancing customer experiences and driving growth through cutting-edge technology.

Position Summary

We are seeking a client-facing Technical Solution Lead to join our Professional Services organization. This role serves as the day-to-day technical solution owner for enterprise SaaS implementations, partnering closely with clients to translate business objectives into implementation-ready solutions.

The Technical Solution Lead works alongside a Project Delivery Lead and is supported by Senior Architects, Business Analysts, and Technical Business Analysts. While Senior Architects provide architectural governance and make complex design decisions, the Technical Solution Lead owns the day-to-day technical solutioning effort throughout the implementation lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical analysis and client-facing consulting skills who aspires to become a Solution Architect.

What You'll Do

Client Solution Leadership

  • Serve as the primary, day-to-day technical leader for a client implementation. This role is dedicated to one client at a time, allowing you to focus 100%.
  • Facilitate technical discovery and solution design working sessions with client stakeholders.
  • Partner with the client's architects, business analysts, and technology teams to define implementation approaches. You'll be able to collaborate with a Sureify Senior Architect as needed.
  • Review and approve agile stories produced by Business Analysts and Technical Business Analysts to ensure business requirements are accurately translated for the engineering team.

Solution Design & Analysis

  • Decompose business requirements into implementation-ready user stories.
  • Define API integrations, data mappings, validation rules, and business processes.
  • Identify technical risks, assumptions, and dependencies early in the project lifecycle.
  • Produce high-quality solution documentation and implementation guidance.

Delivery Partnership

  • Partner closely with the Project Delivery Lead to ensure solution readiness throughout delivery.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and Technical Business Analysts to refine requirements.
  • Support engineering teams by clarifying functional and technical requirements.
  • Escalate complex architectural decisions to Senior Architects while independently driving day-to-day solution definition.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage consistent solution design standards for your implementation by consulting with Senior Architects on patterns established at other clients.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve documentation, requirements decomposition, and solution quality.
  • Contribute to Sureify’s best practices in the form of lessons learned and reusable delivery assets.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • 4–6 years of experience in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, technical business analysis, or solution architecture.
  • Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, data integration, and SQL.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Comfortable with facilitating working sessions with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience working in Agile software delivery environments.
  • Bachelor's degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the Life & Annuity insurance industry.
  • Experience working in Fintech, Insurtech, technology consulting, or at an insurance carrier or financial services firm.
  • Familiarity with policy administration systems, identity providers, data middleware, and digital servicing portals.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve solution design or delivery processes.

Success in This Role

Within your first year, you will:

  • Be the day-to-day technical leader for a major new enterprise client.
  • Build trusted relationships with the client's technical and program management staff.
  • Produce implementation-ready solution designs with minimal oversight.
  • Partner with a Senior Architect to focus on architectural governance and complex technical decisions.
  • Improve delivery quality through better requirements decomposition and solution clarity.
  • Help scale our delivery organization through consistent, repeatable leadership.

What Makes This Role Unique

Unlike a traditional Business Analyst or Solution Architect, the Technical Solution Lead owns the day-to-day technical solutioning effort throughout an implementation.

You will spend much of your time collaborating directly with clients—leading working sessions, solving technical challenges, defining APIs and client-side integrations, overseeing data mappings, and ensuring our engineering teams have everything they need to build successfully.

If you enjoy solving complex business problems, working closely with customers, and aspire to become a Solution Architect, this role provides an exceptional career path.

Base annual salary
$135,000—$170,000 USD

Our Guiding Principles

Our products are for nothing if their creators are not fulfilled in their work. We want our employees to flourish at Sureify. We do not fawn over status or titles, instead, we honor effort and intelligence. The best idea wins no matter which colleague proposed it. We do not shortcut our mission with overblown claims or false promises. Sticking to the truth is both a strategy and a principle for us.

Sureify is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. Job title: Medical Science Liaison - Rhino - Gastroenterology Southwest

About Job

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is field-facing role whose main objectives are to:

  • Be the trusted scientific partner to key external experts by conducting timely, appropriate and frequent scientific exchanges to enhance the understanding of the scientific and medical value of our products.
  • Execute on stakeholder engagement plans to gather data, develop and share medical insights that contribute to enhancement of Sanofi’s key medical messages, plans and future research.
  • Keep abreast of medical and scientific developments in the therapeutic field to help identify and critically assess research opportunities and to play a supportive role in the execution of evidence generation plans to enhance the value of our products in a real-world setting
  • Recognize, record and share insights that deepen our understanding of the needs of patients, consumers, regulators, payers, and healthcare providers and proactively contributes towards identifying unmet needs.
  • Maintain effective and appropriate communication among internal stakeholders (Medical Affairs colleagues, Medical Information and Commercial Operations) while maintaining full compliance with relevant company, industry, legal and regulatory requirements
  • Demonstrate operational understanding and risk management by ensuring excellence in execution of all governance processes.

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world.

About Sanofi
We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines thattreat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

Main Responsibilities:

Engages external stakeholders on medical and scientific information exchange for the therapeutic area during an one-on-one interactions and group settings, exhibiting excellent scientific and clinical knowledge

  • Uses strong knowledge of relevant diseases and disease management protocols, healthcare environment and competitors to articulate the medical and scientific value of our products with external experts.
  • Establishes robust, long-term peer relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and other stakeholder partners
  • Actively engages with appropriate stakeholders on medical, clinical, epidemiologic, and scientific topics to advance their understanding of the disease by sharing information and answering questions based on approved material within Regulatory guidelines.

  • Effectively utilizes the Scientific Engagement Model for attending and establishing a Sanofi Medical presence at relevant scientific congresses, symposia as directed.
  • Organizes educational meetings or local scientific advisory boards when requested.
  • Support speakers training to ensure continued scientific support in the field.
  • Responds to unsolicited request for medical information associated with supported products and disease state area.

Gathers data and generates insights from stakeholder interactions and provides feedback to the organization

  • Recognize and collect feedback/reactions from multiple data sources and various stakeholders.
  • Record/report insights and information appropriately, using available mechanisms and tools.
  • Critically and routinely evaluate and discern from the information gained from published studies, and stakeholder interactions to develop key insights that deepen our understanding of the market’s needs and opinions of external stakeholders and therefore contribute to enhancement of Sanofi’s scientific messages, plans, strategy, systems, and product development.
  • Maintain awareness of and assesses emerging evidence in disease area to educate and enhance discussions with key stakeholders.

Collaborates effectively with internal stakeholders

  • Contribute to the creation of material for internal and external stakeholders where applicable, following internal Sanofi policies, and Federal and National Policies as applicable.

Supports evidence-generation activities by aiding in data acquisition and identifying opportunities for further data collection clinical or investigator-led

jobs.title: Virtual Mental Health Therapist (Part-Time)
jobs.excerpt: The ProblemSevere mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States.
jobs.description:
The Problem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

Who We Are

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. We design and operate high-acuity, in-person clinics across the United States.

Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.

Leading health systems collaborate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health.

Why We Are Different

  • Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.
  • Practice at the top of your license. Manageable caseloads, meaningful clinical depth, and purpose-built tools designed for this population.
  • Continuous learning. Through our collaboration with Mass General Brigham, clinicians receive ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care.
  • Advancing the field. Our clinicians contribute to new outcomes frameworks and research shaping the future of severe mental illness care.
  • A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful—and sustainable over time.

The Role:

We are hiring a Part-Time Virtual Mental Health Therapist (Fully Licensed or Associate-level) to support our members across California. In this fully virtual role, you'll deliver personalized, compassionate, high-quality group therapy to individuals living with serious mental illness (SMI), working as part of an interdisciplinary care team.

The schedule for this role is three days a week, mornings and evenings, plus additional time for documentation and administrative work.

The Opportunity:

You'll lead virtual group therapy for a panel of complex SMI patients across California, delivering evidence-based, holistic, wrap-around care. You'll work side-by-side with fellow therapists, psychiatrists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers who share responsibility for the same patients, and you'll have access to ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care through Amae's academic medical center partnerships.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead virtual group therapy. Facilitate engaging, clinically effective virtual groups for adults living with SMI, creating an environment that supports participation, connection, skill-building, and recovery.
  • Provide individual therapy. Deliver individual psychotherapy when indicated as part of a member’s overall treatment plan.
  • Deliver evidence-based care. Integrate evidence-based approaches such as CBT, DBT, motivational interviewing, and other clinically appropriate interventions based on member needs.
  • Support members over time. Build therapeutic relationships and provide consistent support as members work toward recovery and functional goals.
  • Collaborate across disciplines. Partner closely with psychiatry, primary care, nutrition, community health workers, and other members of the care team to ensure treatment is coordinated and cohesive.
  • Practice whole-person care. Consider the social, behavioral, and environmental factors affecting each member’s health and partner with the broader care team to address barriers to treatment and recovery.
  • Maintain excellent clinical documentation. Complete timely, accurate documentation and uphold privacy, confidentiality, and clinical quality standards.
  • Contribute to clinical excellence. Participate in case consultation, interdisciplinary discussions, program development, and continuous improvement efforts across Amae’s clinical model.

About You:

You're an engaging, personable, high-energy clinician who knows how to hold a group's attention and build genuine connection in a virtual setting. You thrive in a collaborative team environment and build real relationships with other medical professionals. You have experience working with adults with severe mental illness and comfort with evidence-based interventions such as CBT, DBT, or MI. You're highly organized, technologically savvy, and able to work autonomously, with a thorough understanding of confidentiality and documentation standards. You navigate hard situations with professionalism, and you keep the member at the center of every decision.

What You'll Have:

  • Required: Experience leading virtual group therapy sessions: comfortable and confident managing group dynamics, well-versed integrating multiple evidence-based modalities and interventions (CBT, DBT, MI, etc)
  • Required: 1 year of experience working with adult patients with severe mental illness (SMI)
  • Available weekday mornings and evenings (Pacific Time) to meet client needs
  • Active license or registration to practice as a therapist in California (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, Licensed Psychologist, AMFT, ACSW, or APCC), with active NPI and Medicaid/Medicare enrollment. Both fully licensed and associate-level therapists are encouraged to apply
  • Committed to improving access to high-quality mental health services for the California SMI community
  • Ability to navigate challenging situations with professionalism
  • Thorough understanding of confidentiality and appropriate documentation standard.
  • Technologically savvy, comfortable using AI-based tools, and ability to learn and navigate new tools
  • Highly organized with the ability to work autonomously
  • Strong listening skills and excellent verbal communication

Compensation & Benefits

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Hourly base pay for this role is:

  • Associate-Level Therapist: $48–55/hour
  • Licensed Therapist: $58–68/hour

Pay will be adjusted to market, licensure, and experience.

Benefit packages (comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, parental leave, programs built around well-being) will be available if the part-time schedule is 24+ hours/week. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

If you want to practice at the top of your license, learn from the best in academic medicine, contribute to research that is defining a new field, and do it all inside a team that was actually built for this work, we'd like to talk.

What We Value

  • We center care in all we do. Empathy is not a brand value. It’s how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
  • We challenge convention. The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
  • We take the work seriously, not ourselves. High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
  • Your job isn’t done until the job is done. We close gaps, we follow through, and we don’t hide behind titles or org charts.
  • We win together and fail together. We own outcomes as a team. We learn fast. We don’t do blame.
  • We hustle with humility. Speed matters. So does integrity. We assume best intent and stay grounded in the mission.

jobs.title: Detection Focused Senior Cloud Security Consultant - JAPAC
jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a technically strong, self-directed cloud security professional to join our Professional Services team in the JAPAC region. This is a hands-on role for someone with genuine curiosity about cloud attack techniques and a drive to build the detection and defensive capability to counter them.

You'll work with complex, high-profile organisations across the region, helping them understand where they're exposed, sharpen their detection capabilities, and close the gaps that adversaries look for. The work demands both technical depth and client credibility, so you'll need to be effective at both.

What You'll Do:

  • Conduct cloud security assessments across a range of environments, focusing primarily on AWS and Azure: reviewing configurations, identity architectures, network exposure, and attack paths to surface the risks that actually matter.

  • Design and build detection logic and alerting for cloud control plane activity, identity-based threats, and misconfiguration-driven exposure across cloud-native and third-party security platforms.

  • Write automation to speed up assessment work, extract and correlate data across large datasets, and turn repeatable analysis into something the team can use again.

  • Partner with our Red Team during Purple Team exercises: testing customer detection and response capabilities and translating the gaps into concrete recommendations.

  • Collaborate with internal delivery teams to help turn assessment findings into detection content that's ready to deploy.

  • Produce clear, high-quality reports and presentations for technical and executive audiences.

  • Run client engagements from scoping through delivery, keeping stakeholders well-informed throughout.

  • Help push our service offerings forward through methodology development, tooling contributions, and public-facing thought leadership.

​What You'll Bring:

Cloud Platforms

  • Strong practical experience with AWS and Azure, including identity, compute, networking, storage, serverless, and logging and monitoring services.

  • A solid grasp of cloud architecture patterns and where security assumptions tend to break down in practice.

  • GCP experience is a plus, but not a requirement.

Detection Engineering

  • Experience building detection content that works: writing queries, developing alerting logic, and cutting through noise in cloud-native and third-party SIEM/XDR environments.

  • A working knowledge of how threat actors operate in cloud environments, and the ability to translate that into detections that actually fire on the right things.

Cloud Security Configuration Analysis

  • Experience tracing how misconfigurations chain together into realistic attack paths — analysis that tells a coherent story rather than producing a list of isolated findings.

  • Familiarity with common cloud attack patterns: privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and data exfiltration.

Automation and Tooling

  • Solid scripting ability in Python or equivalent, comfortable building tools to automate assessment tasks, work with large datasets, and extend existing frameworks.

  • Experience writing queries across platforms such as KQL, SPL, or cloud-native query engines.

  • Comfortable using AI tooling to sharpen and accelerate their work — whether for code generation, data analysis, query development, or documentation — with enough critical judgement to know when the output needs work.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Communication

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English. You can write a finding that prompts a CISO to act and explain a detection gap to an engineer without losing either audience.

  • Comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and managing client relationships directly.

  • Able to adapt your approach across different business cultures. The JAPAC region spans markets with very different expectations around communication, hierarchy, and directness, and working effectively across that range is part of the job.

  • Additional language proficiency is a strong advantage, particularly Mandarin, Japanese, Hindi, or Thai.

Bonus Areas

  • Detection engineering experience in traditional enterprise environments: on-premises Active Directory, Windows endpoint telemetry, and classic Wintel infrastructure.

  • Cloud incident response experience (AWS, Azure, or M365).

  • Kubernetes and container security.

  • CI/CD pipeline security and DevSecOps practices.

What You'll Need:

We care about what you know and what you can do, not the specific path you took to get here. Strong candidates will have built real depth in cloud platforms and security over time — whether through years in dedicated security roles, a background in cloud engineering or DevOps that shifted toward security, or any other route that got them to the same place. What matters is that the knowledge is solid and the skills are demonstrable.

A bachelors degree or higher and 10+ years of work experience.

Cloud security certifications are a useful signal of hands-on platform knowledge. AWS Certified Security Specialty, AZ-500, and similar practitioner-level credentials are relevant. Broad governance and management certifications (CISSP, CISA, CISM, and similar) are not a focus for this role.

Why This Role:

The work is technically demanding, the clients are high-profile, and the team is sharp.
