jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Monetization
jobs.excerpt: Rechat is the operating system for real estate.  Marketing, CRM, transactions, listings and AI in a single product, replacing the disconnected stack of tools most agents are forced to stitch together.
jobs.description:
Rechat is the operating system for real estate. Marketing, CRM, transactions, listings and AI in a single product, replacing the disconnected stack of tools most agents are forced to stitch together.

Some of the largest brokerages and networks in North America run their business on us, and tens of thousands of agents use Rechat every week. We have spent the last two years rebuilding the product to be AI-native, and we are growing quickly.

REMOTE (Work may be performed anywhere)

The Role

Tens of thousands of agents use Rechat. Their brokerage pays for their seat, and for most of them that is the entire commercial relationship we have with them.

We also build the premium products those same agents want: websites, AI-driven marketing, advertising and social. Those are worth many multiples of a seat, and almost none of our agents buy them today.

There is a second problem sitting next to the first. An agent cannot currently find Rechat, sign up, try it and start paying us on their own. There is no door. Every path in runs through a brokerage contract or a conversation with a person.

You are here to build both: the door, and the upgrade path behind it.

Any agent, anywhere, should be able to discover Rechat, sign up alone, reach something valuable quickly, and become a paying customer without ever speaking to us. And every agent already using Rechat should have an obvious, well-designed reason to pay us more.

Your remit is conversion, wherever it happens. Our demand team drives attention and traffic. From the moment an agent shows interest, it is yours: the landing page, the signup, the trial, the first valuable moment, the upgrade, the checkout. You own the percentage at every one of those steps.

And your other job is time to value. Every setup step between signing up and getting something useful costs us a percentage of the agents who signed up. Uploading a logo, choosing colours, configuring templates, importing contacts. Your job is to delete as many of those steps as possible, and to make the ones that remain fast enough that nobody abandons. An agent should reach something they would be sad to lose within their first session, not their first month.
Those two things, conversion and time to value, are what you are here to move. Everything below is in service of them.
That includes reaching agents proactively rather than waiting for them to log in. We have an AI assistant in the product, and one of the most interesting questions in this role is how much of the buying journey it can carry on its own.

This is the largest revenue opportunity in the company and nobody owns it today.

What You'll Own:

  • Touchless signup. Self-serve onboarding, trial mechanics, and the path from trial to paid. Engineers are working on this now and they need a product owner.
  • The conversion path outside the app. Pricing pages, plan comparison, signup and trial-start pages, and the experiments that improve them. Our demand team buys the traffic and runs campaign pages. You own the pages where interest turns into an account.
  • Checkout and billing. Card on file, self-serve purchase, upgrades, downgrades, failed payment recovery. Some of this does not exist yet and you will specify it.
  • The in-product upgrade path. Who sees a prompt, where in their workflow, what it says, what happens when they click, and how much completes without a human.
  • Seat-to-paid conversion. Turning agents on a brokerage-paid seat into agents paying us directly.
  • Proactive outreach that converts. Anything triggered by product behaviour: a trial ending, a limit reached, a feature explored, an account gone quiet. In-app, push, and behaviour-triggered email and SMS, including what our AI assistant does on its own initiative. Our demand team owns marketing and nurture campaigns; you own everything the product sends because of what someone did or stopped doing.
  • Reactivation. A large number of agents have access and are not using it, and you cannot sell to someone who never logs in. You own the loop: which dormant agents we pursue, what triggers the attempt, what they land on, and whether it worked.
  • Branded acquisition experiences. Agents identify with their brokerage brand long before they identify with ours. We want branded landing and signup experiences for the franchises and brokerages whose agents we are going after, built as a repeatable system rather than as bespoke projects, so launching a new brand takes hours and not weeks.
  • Brand-aware onboarding. An agent signing up should be able to select their brokerage and have the product configure itself around that brand immediately, with the right assets, templates and defaults already in place. Every setup step between signup and first value costs us signups, and this removes most of them. It shares a brand asset library with the acquisition experiences above.
  • Activation and time to value. Getting a new agent to something valuable in minutes rather than days. Smart defaults, imported and detected configuration, guided first sessions, and removing every step that can be removed. Something bought and then abandoned churns, and the first two weeks decide the next twelve months.
  • Pricing and packaging. Tiers, trials, bundles, and the experiments that tell us what an agent will actually pay. You will run price tests on a live base, including increases.
  • The measurement underneath all of it. Event instrumentation, funnels, cohorts, and experiments that hold up.

Your numbers: conversion at every step of the funnel, time to first value, attach rate (paying agents as a share of addressable agents), and revenue per agent.

You will not carry a feature roadmap. You will carry percentages.

What This Role Is Not:

We are being explicit because these jobs get confused and we are hiring for exactly one of them.

  • Not product marketing. You will not own positioning, messaging, competitive narrative, launch plans or sales collateral.
  • Not demand generation. You will not buy media, run ad accounts, manage campaign budgets or own brand campaigns. Our demand team drives attention. You convert it. You will make their spend go further by raising conversion, but the budget belongs to them.
  • Not enterprise sales support. Anything requiring a contract to be opened or a human to negotiate sits elsewhere. Your buyer is an individual agent paying with their own card.

What You Bring:

Be prepared to walk us through each of these in detail.

  • You have owned a conversion or monetization metric as your primary KPI for at least two years. The number your performance was judged on, not one input among several.
  • You have launched or rebuilt a self-serve signup and checkout flow, including trial mechanics and what happens when a card fails.
  • You have shipped a live monetization surface. A paywall, an upgrade prompt, an in-product trial, a plan comparison page. Something real users hit and that you measured.
  • You have run a pricing or packaging change on an existing customer base. Ideally an increase, because that is the harder one and it teaches you the most.
  • You have built a reactivation or lifecycle program that brought dormant users back and converted some of them.
  • You have owned landing page and signup conversion, with a real testing programme behind it rather than occasional redesigns.
  • You have instrumented a funnel from scratch. Defined the events yourself, got engineers to fire them correctly, built the analysis. Not read someone else's dashboard.
  • You have run an experimentation program where you chose what to test, sized the sample properly, and killed what did not work.
  • You have moved an activation or time-to-value metric and can show the retention effect. Templated setup, smart defaults, imported or detected configuration, anything that removed steps between signup and first value.
  • You have worked at a low monthly price point, selling to individuals or small businesses. Website builders, creative tools, SMB vertical software, marketplaces, or consumer subscription products with real upgrade mechanics.

You do not need real estate experience and we are not weighting it. We would rather hire someone who has run this playbook elsewhere and let them learn our industry, which takes about a quarter.

How You Work:

  • You can describe a test that failed and what you learned, without reframing it as a success
  • You have strong opinions about paywall placement and can defend them
  • You are uncomfortable with vague metrics and you say so
  • Engineers you have worked with wanted to work with you again
  • Clear, direct written communication. Most coordination happens in Slack and project tools, not meetings
  • Fluent with modern AI tools and using them daily to move faster

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote with flexible work/life balance
  • A diverse, inclusive, and highly collaborative culture
  • Meaningful work with a product used by real professionals every day
  • Flexible Paid Time Off

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics. Background and reference checks required.

Salary: $125,000 – $150,000 / year

As part of our growing team, your work will have a direct impact on the communities we serve, helping to remove barriers to care and improve lives. Our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and growth, giving you the opportunity to shape the future of our industry.

Why MTM Health?

  • Make a meaningful difference every day.

  • Join a team that values your ideas and contributions.

  • Be part of a company that exceeds NCQA standards for customer service.

  • Enjoy a supportive environment with multilingual services available 24/7, 365 days a year.

If you’re ready to transform lives and grow your career, apply today and join us as we break down community barriers—together!

Position Title: Bilingual Customer Care Representative

Location: Remote Texas

Hourly Rate: $16.00

What Will Your Job Look Like?

The Customer Care Representative is the frontline representative and image of MTM Health. The Customer Care Representative will handle a variety of tasks which will increase in complexity as the Customer Care Representative’s skills progress, but will consist primarily of handling inbound calls from Members, Clients and Facilities. Expect to handle 60 - 80 calls a day and higher volumes on Mondays.

All you need for the Customer Care Representative role is:

  • Must currently reside in Texas

  • 1 year of Call Center experience

  • 6 months Customer Service experience

  • Must be proficient in English and Spanish

  • Basic typing/computer experience with excellent navigational skills

  • High speed Internet access such as Cable, DSL or Fiber (a minimum upload speed of 3 mbps and a minimum download speed of 30 mbps). Use of wireless and WiFi “air cards” is prohibited

  • A quiet space within the home free of distractions including caretaking of any kind

Your Potential. Our Mission.

At MTM Health, you’re not just part of a team—you’re at the heart of a movement to remove community barriers nationwide. We’re all about breaking the mold with bold ideas, open conversations, and a relentless focus on what matters most: you. Here, collaboration sparks breakthroughs, learning fuels growth, and every voice shapes our future. Together, we thrive, push our limits, and work as team to help you reach your full potential.

We don’t talk about a better workplace – we make it happen.

Benefits without Barriers

To show appreciation for our staff’s hard work and dedication, MTM Health offers more than just a paycheck. Our Total Rewards program is all encompassing, offering a wide variety of enticing benefits to ensure our employees and their families are rewarded.

  • Health, Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life and Disability Insurance

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match

  • FSA and HSA Savings Plans

  • Wellness Program with Incentives

  • Voluntary & Ancillary Plans

Additional Perks

  • Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay

  • Birthday Holiday

  • Maternity/Paternity Leave

  • Continuing Education Reimbursement Program

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote Job Type: Full-Time Salary: [Competitive – Based on Experience] About the Founder Institute: TheFounder Institute (FI) is a global network of startup incubators, accelerators, and investors on a mission to activate and empower communities of entrepreneurs worldwide.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time
Salary: [Competitive – Based on Experience]

About the Founder Institute:

TheFounder Institute (FI) is a global network of startup incubators, accelerators, and investors on a mission to activate and empower communities of entrepreneurs worldwide.

Since 2009, we’ve helped launch over 8,000 companies in 200+ cities globally, which have raised nearly $2BN in funding. We are based in Silicon Valley and have remote team members across the United States, Europe, India, and Brazil. Our success has been documented in the New York Times, BusinessWeek, Forbes, TechCrunch, and more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Support & Marketing Associate with a passion for startups and entrepreneurship to join our team.

You will have the opportunity to see entrepreneurship and venture capital from many angles, and work for a company with a small and mission-driven team.

This role is 100% remote, and will require a Sunday-Thursday workweek.

Our Culture:

At the Founder Institute, we work a lot like the early-stage startups we support. That means things move fast, and we thrive on creativity, ownership, and a “let’s figure it out” mindset. Here’s what we look for in our team:

  • You’re naturally entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and enjoy tackling challenges head-on.
  • You prefer autonomy over hand-holding and don’t need a lot of oversight to get things done.
  • You love learning new things, and when you hit a roadblock, your first instinct is to dig in, research, and find a solution—Google is your best friend.
  • You’re open to feedback (even when it’s tough), and always looking to grow and improve—both personally and as part of the team.

If that sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you. If not, no hard feelings—this kind of environment isn’t for everyone.

Still with us? Great—read on for more details!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Support & Engagement: Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, offering personalized assistance and proactive support.
  • Assist with Program Admissions: Review applications to FI incubation and acceleration programs, and follow best practices for acceptance.
  • Improve the Customer Experience: As our “feet on the ground”, your ideas will play a critical role in our ability to improve our customer experience.
  • Host Live Q&A Calls: Host scheduled Q&A sessions with customers, addressing their concerns and providing expert guidance on our products/services.
  • Host Info-Session Webinars: Conduct and facilitate informative webinars to educate customers on key topics, program qualities, and best practices.
  • Improve Conversion & Retention: Coordinate with the design and product teams to improve the usability and conversion of the website and overall conversion rate optimization (CRO). Coordinate with the marketing team on initiatives to increase conversion and retention.
  • Improve Site and Email Copy: Update and improve copy across our marketing materials to properly address the changing needs of our customers.
  • Maintain Organized Documentation & Processes: Track customer interactions, document frequently asked questions, and provide feedback to improve processes.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required:

  • Willing to work a Sunday-Thursday schedule
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Business-level fluency in English
  • Comfort in hosting live calls and webinars
  • Internet and computer-savvy

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of startup accelerators and the startup/ venture capital industry
  • 2+ years of professional customer service and/or marketing experience
  • Experience using Google Suite, Powerpoint, Excel, Canva, Mailchimp, and various online CRM and marketing tool

What We Offer:

  • Great upward mobility into a larger, conversion-focused marketing role (all senior team members at FI have grown into their roles from inside the company)
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with the autonomy to drive results in your own style.

  • Ability to learn from top entrepreneurs, investors, and executives throughout FI’s global network and suite of acceleration programs.

IMPORTANT: In your Cover Letter please write two paragraphs, the first on why you would like to work in the startup accelerator industry, and the second on how your personality fits well with the FI culture described above. Applications without this Cover Letter will be ignored.

We're Jello. We run paid social for a small group of brands we actually believe in — we're a Meta and Google Premier Partner, and we've put more than $50M through ad accounts learning what makes people stop, click, and convert. We work with a handful of partners at a time, so there's nowhere to hide: every campaign has to perform. We're looking for a Meta buyer with experience on EU or USA markets to own the paid side of some of our sharpest work, someone who can take a target and a deadline and hit both.

Tasks

  • Own Meta campaigns end to end: build, launch, scale, and land them on target and on time
  • Optimise toward what actually matters: cost per lead, cost per acquisition, ROAS against real revenue
  • Run tight testing across audiences, angles, and formats and know when to kill and when to scale hard
  • Manage pacing and budget across short, high-tempo windows where timing is everything
  • Turn performance signals into creative direction, you tell the design team what the data wants next

Requirements

  • You know what's working on Meta right now, not what worked in 2023
  • Conversational English is mandatory, Italian nice to have, not mandatory
  • Experience with fast-turnaround campaigns or time-sensitive launches
  • Comfort working alongside an AI-native creative pipeline that tests more, faster

Benefits

  • Part-time or hourly-based, scaling with the workload
  • Fully remote, with flexible hours you manage yourself
  • Adaptable and supportive colleague
  • A lean team where your calls ship fast and you see the impact
  • Marketing Manager will provide you the guidance and maximum support you are not starting from scratch or alone

The Director, Client Services will work with clients to optimize financial and clinical performance using multiple client systems. The Director, Client Services will collaboratively identify, address and successfully resolve a broad range of topics and issues.

  • Initiate and direct plans to improve client profitability
  • Follow up on client feedback and issues as necessary and initiate/track plans for improvement
  • Serve as the liaison between the client and operations
  • Identify process improvement or other efficiencies related to improving the customer satisfaction
  • Conduct quarterly reviews with clients
  • Manage a team of client managers and analysts in servicing the clients and meeting goals and objectives
  • Act as an escalation point for the team base as needed
  • Model high customer service qualities and drive team accountability to do the same in delivery of service

Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionAt Galvanize, we ignite human potential with skills and knowledge.
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Galvanize, we ignite human potential with skills and knowledge. We produce outcomes-driven education for motivated adult learners & organizations to activate and propel technology-focused careers.
Galvanize is the leader in tech education. Our programs are designed so that anyone with motivation can succeed, regardless of education, experience or background. With 12,000+ graduates at 2,250 companies, we empower learners and leaders across industries to propel their careers and make an impact through tech.

SUMMARY

We are searching for an experienced curriculum design leader to join our Galvanize Academic Team as an individual contributor to our product successes. In collaboration with an Academic Team and Managing Lead Instructors across Galvanize programs, the curriculum designer will lead review, scope and sequence creation, template iteration, curriculum mapping, and other cross-organizational championing of big-picture curriculum efforts for all Galvanize technology programs. The curriculum design leader will endeavor to stay apprised of trends and critical research in curriculum design and technology (primarily software engineering) education, engaging with subject matter experts, outlining potential, meta-level learning objectives, and providing feasible timeframes in an audit and iteration cycle of the portfolio of Galvanize curricula. Additionally, the curriculum design leader will bring expertise to maintaining, informing, and intersecting with our Learning Management System (Learn).
To be successful as a Curriculum Design Leader, you should understand: principles of adult learning science and epistemology, how to effectively standardize design efforts sans homogenization of curriculum across products, effectively lead diverse subject matter experts and teams to contribute to design, auditing, and iteration efforts that ultimately impact our student outcomes and myriad professional successes. Outstanding candidates have strong project management abilities and excellent technical writing, research, and communication skills.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.

  • Conduct research and collaborate with external education professionals, instructors, Galvanize Career Services team members, software engineering subject experts, data scientists and analysts, technology industry experts, and other professionals to drive the design of quality curricula and learning resources.
  • Establish feasible and standardized timeframes and processes to audit, design, iterate, evaluate for efficacy, and champion curriculum models and planning processes across the Galvanize organization, effectively driving scope and sequence work in all curriculum mapping efforts.
  • Create stimulating lesson plan templates and design expectations; driving active learning and problem/project-based learning principles and innovative assessment and evaluation strategies to gauge learner progress.
  • Create a repository of supplementary instructor and student guides, as well as resource packs that extend curriculum assets among and across Galvanize products.
  • Expand networks of curriculum designers, industry trend setters, and other professionals internally and externally.
  • Cultivate a culture of feedback, reflection, and innovation from students, instructors, and other Galvanize stakeholders to consistently champion curriculum design and assessment efforts.
  • Monitor meta-level student progress and sentiment across products to make relevant and urgent changes to curricula in sync with evolving career opportunity trends.
  • Lead cross-organization engagement among team members, including active instructors, in an effort to “crowd source” auditing, review, and iteration of larger scale curriculum changes.
  • Collaborate with the Academic Team members and contribute to overall goals of the Academic Team.
  • Engage with product teams and the Galvanize Regulatory team to inform curriculum design with accommodations and accessibility practices and standards.
  • Contribute to supporting additional academic priorities at Galvanize in varied forms as needed (direct instruction/lesson delivery, observe and inform instructional quality, present professional development sessions, contribute to new product design efforts, etc.).

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-5 years of formal or informal education and curriculum design experience OR
  • Combination of education and experience
  • Alignment with Galvanize Values:
    • Learn & grow courageously
    • Create belonging with intention
    • Come together, build together
    • Win with integrity
    • Be fueled by our purpose

OTHER REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong familiarity with software engineering skills and relevant development tools.
  • Experience with industry-standard software development and project management practices and methodologies like Agile, Scrum, and Kanban.
  • Particular experience designing and measuring efficacy of curricula for adult learners (and experience with curriculum guide creation for non-professional educators preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating diversity, equity, and inclusion priorities into the curriculum and instructional design efforts in an organization.
  • Ability to clear required background check

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience in instructional design, content development, or instructional coaching is also preferred.
  • Capable of captivating students and staff with engaging curriculum, lessons, and activities.
  • Ability to analyze and model student progress and remove educational roadblocks through effective curriculum design and partnership with instructional design and professional development teams.
  • Motivated by and derives satisfaction from high-ownership work environments and has a passion for technology and education.
  • Highly collaborative, conscientious, reliable, self-motivated, solution-oriented, and growth-mindset savvy.
  • Strong digital and research skills.
  • Great networking and interpersonal abilities.
  • Strong planning skills, vision, and creative intelligence.
  • A passion for the art and science of adult learning.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionProjects Managers with experience in Dermatology and/or Rheumatology are crucial to the success of Clinical Trials managed by Indero.
jobs.description:
Description

Projects Managers with experience in Dermatology and/or Rheumatology are crucial to the success of Clinical Trials managed by Indero. They are the main point of contact internally as well as externally, ensuring all activities and deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and as expected.

Great project managers go further than creating project plans and following up on tasks. They show leadership to help project teams focus on objectives and deliver results.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 7 years of Global clinical project management experience (including but not limited to European regions), including management of all project’s phases from start-up to closure, management of all functional services, vendor management.
  • Wishes to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects.
  • Is looking to position themselves in an environment where you can grow your career alongside of a growing company.

IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Client interactions

  • Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
  • Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
  • Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

  • Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
  • Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.
  • Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).

Quality and risk management

  • Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.
  • Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.
  • Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.
  • Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.
  • Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

Project budget and timelines

  • Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.
  • Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
  • Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
  • Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
  • Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

  • Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
  • Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
  • Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research;
  • PMP or PRINCE2 certification is an asset

﻿Experience

  • At least 10 years industry experience including a minimum of 3 years in a CRO;
  • At least 7 years of clinical project management experience, including management of all projects phases from start up to closure, management of all functional services, vendor management. Experience with mid-size and large studies (>10-15 countries) in multiple regions (NA, SA, APAC, MENA, Europe)
  • Experience leading multi-centered, multinational phase III clinical trials including project budget financial tracking and forecasting
  • Experience in one or more of the following considered an asset: study start up, regulatory submission, resource management, supervisory experience, CRA, data management, medical writing, or vendor management;
  • Therapeutic experience managing dermatology, onco-dermatology, rheumatoid arthritis or oncology trials an asset

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, local country regulations;
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite;
  • Fluency in English with excellent oral and written skills, required
  • Bilingualism (English and local language) is an asset
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors;
  • Good problem-solving abilities;

jobs.description:
Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.

The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead enterprise-wide financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Provide executive oversight of financial performance across subsidiaries, business units, and investment platforms.

Drive Group-wide FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, and commercial finance.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, margins, cash flow, ROE, ROIC, and return on capital.

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability.

Provide financial leadership for investment and asset management businesses, including portfolio reporting, valuation, investment income, performance analysis, and cost management.

Lead strategic capital planning, capital allocation, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet optimization.

Provide executive oversight of treasury, funding, cash management, and liquidity planning.

Establish and strengthen Group-wide financial governance, internal controls, accounting policies, and risk-management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.

Lead financial evaluation and due diligence for M&A, acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and market expansion.

Partner with the Investment, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations functions on major strategic and financial decisions.

Drive enterprise-wide cost optimization, operational efficiency, and profitability improvement.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP modernization, automation, AI/data analytics, dashboards, and digital finance initiatives.

Maintain senior relationships with regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, rating agencies, and other financial stakeholders.

Provide high-level financial advice to the CEO, Group CFO, Board, and Executive Committee.

Build a strong succession pipeline and lead senior finance executives across the organization.

Support the development and execution of the Group's long-term growth and value-creation strategy.

Strategic KPIs

Group revenue and earnings growth

EBITDA / operating profit

ROE, ROIC, and return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Insurance underwriting profitability

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Liquidity and treasury performance

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

M&A and strategic investment returns

Regulatory and audit performance

Finance transformation and automation

Shareholder and enterprise value creation

Candidate Profile

18–25+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, reinsurance, pensions, or diversified financial services.

Extensive experience in enterprise-level, Group, regional, or multi-entity finance leadership.

Previous experience as EVP Finance, Executive Vice President Finance, Group Finance Director, Group CFO, CFO, SVP Finance, Finance Director, Deputy Group CFO, or equivalent.

Strong understanding of insurance finance, investment finance, capital management, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements.

Demonstrated experience managing complex organizations with multiple subsidiaries, business lines, and jurisdictions.

Strong commercial understanding of investments, financial markets, capital allocation, and enterprise performance.

Proven track record in M&A, capital raising, strategic investments, restructuring, or major transformation initiatives.

Extensive experience engaging with Boards, CEOs, regulators, investors, auditors, and other senior stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead large, geographically dispersed finance organizations.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investments, risk, actuarial science, or financial management are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Enterprise Finance Strategy | Group Financial Management | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Allocation | Treasury | Solvency | Balance-Sheet Management | M&A | Financial Modelling | Risk Management | Governance | Regulatory Compliance | Cost Optimization | Finance Transformation | Executive Leadership

Leadership Characteristics

Exceptional strategic and commercial judgment

Strong executive presence

Enterprise-wide perspective

High integrity and governance orientation

Strong analytical and decision-making capability

Excellent Board and stakeholder communication

Results-driven and financially disciplined

Transformational and innovation-oriented

Strong talent-development and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multinational environments

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Communications Manager
REPORTS TO: Chief Executive Officer; upon hire, this position will work closely with and may receive day-to-day operational supervision from the Chief Operating Officer consistent with organizational needs.
FLSA STATUS: Exempt
LOCATION: Remote (U.S Based)
SALARY: $75,000 – $85,000

Since 1999, WomenHeart: The National Coalition for Women with Heart Disease has been the nation’s only patient-centered organization solely devoted to advancing women’s heart health through patient support, community education, and advocacy. WomenHeart is both a coalition and a community of thousands of members nationwide, including women heart patients and their families, health care professionals, health advocates, all committed to helping women live longer, healthier lives. This organization is poised for rapid expansion and leadership in the field.

Position Summary:

The Communications Manager manages the day-to-day execution of WomenHeart's communications strategy, amplifying the organization's mission, programs, advocacy efforts, events, and partnerships across external audiences. This role owns WomenHeart's organizational content calendar, website, email communications, social media presence, and digital storytelling efforts. The Communications Manager serves as the organization's primary social media lead, responsible for developing and executing platform-specific strategies, creating engaging content, growing online audiences, fostering community engagement, monitoring trends, and analyzing performance to advance organizational goals.
Working collaboratively across departments, the Communications Manager develops and executes content that engages patients, supporters, healthcare professionals, corporate partners, funders, and other key stakeholders. The position brings in-house responsibilities currently performed by an external communications consultant and works closely with WomenHeart's Strategic Communications Consultant, who provides strategic brand, messaging, and positioning guidance.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Content Strategy and Editorial

  • Own the organizational content calendar, coordinating across programs, development, corporate relations, and advocacy so campaigns, awareness moments, and program milestones are sequenced and resourced
  • Write, edit, and publish content across WomenHeart’s external channels, including web copy, email, social posts, newsletters, blog posts, and program collateral
  • Copyedit and proofread outgoing external materials
  • Draft select executive thought leadership communications, including CEO remarks, statements, and blog posts, in coordination with the Strategic Communications Consultant
  • Maintain editorial workflows that support timely approvals, publication schedules, and organizational priorities.
  • Serve as the communications liaison across departments, helping staff translate organizational priorities into clear, audience-focused communications.
  • Manage multiple communications projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Support communications needs for organizational events, including promotional campaigns, registration communications, onsite materials, and post-event communications.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of WomenHeart's mission.

Digital Communications

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize content for WomenHeart.org using the organization's content management system.
  • Create, schedule, publish, and monitor social media content across a variety of formats that advances WomenHeart's strategic priorities, programs, advocacy initiatives, fundraising efforts, events, and community engagement.
  • With Strategic Communications Consultant, develop integrated, multi-channel communications plans supporting organizational initiatives, including the Science & Leadership Symposium, Champion engagement and recruitment, fundraising
campaigns, advocacy priorities, corporate partnerships, and public awareness efforts.
  • Ensure digital content follows best practices for readability, accessibility, SEO, and user engagement.
  • Maintain digital asset archives and content libraries for future organizational use.

Media Relations and Public Awareness

  • Support media relations activities, including drafting press releases, responding to media inquiries, and coordinating interviews.
  • Monitor media coverage and identify opportunities to increase WomenHeart's visibility and thought leadership.
  • Coordinate external announcements, organizational statements, and public communications as assigned.
  • Maintain and augment master national and regional media lists.

Storytelling and Program Communications

  • Collaborate with program staff to elevate program milestones, research, advocacy initiatives, and organizational impact across communications channels.
  • Identify, develop, and publish Champion and patient stories while ensuring appropriate consent, privacy, and sensitivity when sharing personal health experiences.
  • Develop sponsor, partner, and funder recognition stories that accurately reflect their support and impact.
  • Maintain a library of stories, testimonials, photography, program outcomes, and impact data for use across communications, fundraising, advocacy, and grant reporting.
  • Track and document communications metrics required for grant reporting and provide data to program and development staff.

Brand and Message Consistency

  • Ensure consistent messaging, voice, tone, and visual identity across all external communications.
  • Apply WomenHeart's brand standards, including logo usage, typography, color palette, and editorial style.
  • Partner with the Strategic Communications Consultant to implement organizational brand and messaging guidance.
  • Maintain brand templates, communications resources, and shared asset libraries.
  • Manage co-branding requirements with corporate sponsors, coalition partners, and other external organizations.
  • Produce simple graphic assets using Canva or similar tools and coordinate external designers, photographers, videographers, writers, printers, and other communications vendors.
  • Ensure messaging consistency across all external channels

Analytics and Continuous Improvement

    • Track, analyze, and report communications performance across website, email, social media, and digital campaigns.
    • Develop regular communications dashboards and provide recommendations to improve audience engagement and campaign effectiveness.
    • Monitor emerging communications trends, technologies, and best practices to strengthen organizational communications.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Three to five years of progressively responsible experience in communications, marketing, digital engagement, or public relations.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for diverse audiences, from patient-facing communications to corporate partners and funders.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing and implementing social media strategies
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated, cross-channel communications campaigns with measurable results.
  • Hands-on experience managing digital communications across email marketing platforms, content management systems, and social media channels.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, identify communications opportunities, and independently manage projects from concept through execution.
  • Excellent judgment and attention to detail, particularly when communicating about sensitive health topics and patient experiences.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing as part of a collaborative remote team.
  • Working proficiency in Canva or similar design tools.
  • Commitment to advancing women's cardiovascular health and patient-centered advocacy.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in nonprofit, healthcare, patient advocacy, or public health communications.
  • Familiarity with EveryAction/Bonterra or a comparable nonprofit CRM.
  • Experience with Google Analytics (GA4), SEO, and website performance reporting.
  • Experience supporting media relations or public relations initiatives.
  • Experience producing or tracking grant-funded communications deliverables.
  • Experience using social media management and analytics tools such as Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Buffer, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive communications best practices.
  • Experience coordinating communications for conferences, fundraising campaigns, advocacy initiatives, or national awareness campaigns.
  • Experience managing communications vendors or freelancers.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite or similar creative software.

jobs.description:
Copilot Developer/AI Engineer - Entry-Level

Hands-on development and technical architecture for Copilot agents, automations, and integrations

Role Overview

The entry-level Copilot Developer/AI Engineer turns strategic blueprints into working agents, workflows, and integrations, while also providing architectural guidance for complex implementations. They develop Copilot agents, Power Automate flows, reusable prompt “skills,” and locally-run AI solutions using tools such as Claude, ensure solutions are scalable and secure, and support the team through technical standards, mentorship, and escalation handling. A strong working knowledge of modern AI tools — particularly Microsoft Copilot and Claude (and related tools) — is central to the role, as is the curiosity to continually seek out and evaluate new AI platforms while operating responsibly within a regulated environment with strict data controls.

Description

We are seeking a Microsoft Power Platform Developer who is also familiar with Microsoft Copilot Studio to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, implement, and optimize AI-powered productivity and automation solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients.

You will partner closely within an internal team to identify opportunities where the Power Platform, Power Automate, and Microsoft Copilot Studio — as well as other AI tools and technologies, including Claude used locally outside of the Microsoft 365 environment — can deliver transformative business value, ensuring that solutions are strategically aligned, technically sound, and effectively adopted. Engagements allow you to take ownership from solution development through implementation, optimization, and adoption. Throughout, you will work within a regulated environment governed by strict data controls, balancing rapid AI experimentation with rigorous compliance and data protection.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Development

Develop application in PowerApps using Dataverse, Power Automate, Excel, Forms and SharePoint online. Use multiple Out-of-The-Box connectors with Power Apps, Power Automate. Develop and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio solutions that integrate seamlessly with Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps), and other enterprise systems. Build and run AI-assisted solutions using Claude locally — outside of the Microsoft 365 environment — for development, prototyping, and automation, while keeping data handling compliant with organizational and client controls. Incorporate adaptive cards, variables, triggers, connectors, and API integrations into Copilot Studio solutions to maximize functionality.

Collaborate in prompt engineering: crafting effective prompts, skills, and grounding/context strategies across both Copilot and Claude (and related tools). Participate in solution testing, validation, and quality assurance Technical feasibility analysis, solution design documentation, and user guides Ensure solutions comply with Microsoft security, compliance, and governance standards, including Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Purview, and DLP (Data Loss Prevention) policies. Apply strict data-control practices to all AI tooling — including locally-run models such as Claude — ensuring sensitive and regulated data is handled, stored, and transmitted in accordance with policy. Mentor teammates, provide technical guidance, and handle escalated issues from deployed solutions

Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Develop supporting documentation, user guides, and enablement materials to encourage effective adoption and continuous improvement. Optimize development efforts based on user feedback. Stay current with emerging Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot features. Proactively seek out, evaluate, and pilot new AI tools and platforms, assessing their fit, value, and — critically — their compatibility with the organization's regulated environment and data-control requirements before adoption.

Technical Troubleshooting & Support

Diagnose and resolve technical challenges related to Copilot Studio implementations, working closely with internal engineering teams when necessary. Ensure data security in all Power Platform and Copilot-enabled solutions.

Required Qualifications

This is an entry-level position. Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 1-2 years of professional experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience. Proven success in Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio solution design, development, and deployment. Strong, hands-on working knowledge of modern AI tools — specifically Microsoft Copilot and Claude (and related tools) — including their use for development, automation, and prompt engineering. Experience using Claude locally (outside the Microsoft 365 environment) for AI-assisted development and automation.

Strong familiarity with Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, and their integration points. Familiarity with Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and third-party system integrations Skilled in identifying AI-driven optimization opportunities. Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing AI experimentation against compliance, governance, and data-protection obligations.

A genuine desire to explore, test, and adopt emerging AI tools and platforms. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills. Experience with data integration from multiple sources while maintaining accuracy, quality, and compliance. Understanding of prompt engineering principles and LLM behavior; experience with RAG-based architectures preferred Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including presentation development and delivery. Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining strong coworker relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. Prior experience working for Microsoft or a Microsoft Gold/Cloud Solutions Partner. Certifications in Microsoft Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties. Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models for enterprise technology projects. Knowledge of AI prompt engineering and LLM (Large Language Model) optimization techniques. Experience deploying and governing AI tools — such as Claude and other non-Microsoft models — in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Work Environment & Travel

Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone Travel: None required. Work Hours: This role is for a United States company. Work will be conducted in English, and can be done asynchronously with the US time zones, though some overlap will be required for meetings and collaboration.

About the Role

This is a strategic consulting role where you will be part of a high-performing, client-focused team dedicated to unlocking the full potential of Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, and a broader set of AI tools including Claude. You will work with organizations to reimagine productivity, streamline workflows, and empower teams with AI-driven insights and automation — always within a regulated environment where strong data controls and responsible AI adoption are non-negotiable.

  • Comprehensive Benefits - Medical, Retirement, Holidays, PTO etc.

  • Opportunity to develop and advance within a growing organization

Junior Backend Software Developer

About Trilogy Innovations

At Trilogy Innovations, we are committed to driving meaningful change for our customers and communities through smart, innovative technology that solves real problems. As a growing systems and software engineering company, we partner across public and private sectors to modernize enterprise systems, strengthen security, and deliver high value solutions. We are scaling with purpose, investing in our people, processes, and platforms as we expand. We work hard, think creatively, and value every perspective as we push boundaries and build systems that matter.

Who you are

Trilogy Innovations is looking for a talented Junior-level Software Developer to support a high-visibility federal modernization program — all while working 100% remotely. This is your chance to join a fast-growing, collaborative team and play a direct role in transforming large-scale, mission-critical government IT systems.

You’ll work on impactful projects that modernize legacy platforms, introduce cutting-edge cloud technologies, and deliver solutions that make a real difference for end users across the country. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges and want your work to have purpose and scale, this role is built for you.

This role requires at least a Secret Security Clearance, and primary work location is remote.


On-Call Expectations

To support critical system needs, this role participates in a rotating on-call schedule for one week out of every four. During your on-call week, you’ll be part of a responsive support team that helps ensure system reliability and continuity.

  • Acknowledge on-call contacts (phone, text, or email) within 15 minutes
  • Remain within reasonable access to your secure work laptop while on call
  • Log in and begin assessing or troubleshooting requests within 60 minutes of notification

The on-call rotation is structured to provide balance while ensuring our federal partners receive timely, dependable support when it matters most.

What you will do:

  • Develop, create, and modify computer applications software or specialized utility programs.
  • Develop microservices in a cloud native environment.
  • Operates an enterprise scale production system. Identifies, troubleshoots, and resolves system issues.
  • Analyze user needs to develop robust software solutions aligned with business and mission goals.
  • Analyze and design databases within an application area, working individually or coordinating database development as part of a team.
  • Applies principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis, and distributed system design.
  • Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior developers to promote engineering excellence.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams including DevOps, QA, Security, Product, and Architecture.

High-level objectives include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Migrate all current-system functionality from the mainframes and operate within a cloud-based environment (AWS GovCloud)
  • Transition investigative search capabilities to Elasticsearch or similar technologies to improve speed and analytical capabilities for law enforcement users.
  • Build new microservices using OpenShift based container platforms following scalable, cloud native patterns.
  • Implement full stack components where applicable, supporting UI integration layers using modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Support integration with event driven architectures and high throughput data processing systems.

What you bring:

We require:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 3 years of work experience or Associate’s Degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience.
  • Active Tier 3 Secret clearance (or higher).
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Object-Oriented.
  • Experience developing microservices, REST APIs, and cloud native applications.
  • Hands on experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and automated deployments.
  • Experience designing, developing, and operating solutions in AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience with event driven architectures and two or more of the following:
    • Apache Kafka
    • Pub/Sub patterns
    • Streaming
    • Event sourcing
  • Experience operating within GitOps practices (GitLab, GitHub, Bitbucket, ArgoCD, etc.).
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks, including participation in Scrum/SAFe ceremonies.
  • Familiarity with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket).

Nice to have:

  • Demonstrate a positive, collaborative attitude and a commitment to team success
  • Take pride in delivering high-quality, reliable software that supports a mission-critical system
  • Demonstrate accountability for assigned work and shared team outcomes
  • Engage constructively in Agile ceremonies and technical discussions
  • Maintain a strong work ethic, professionalism, and respect for teammates, stakeholders, and mission priorities
  • Adapts to change and approaches challenges with a solution-oriented mindset

Work Environment: Remote with occasional travel as required.

Compensation and Benefits:

Salary range: $84,000 - $87,000

  • Performance bonus eligibility
  • 401k with company match
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health Savings Account

Why Trilogy Innovations

At Trilogy Innovations, we believe strong teams build meaningful solutions. We deliver high quality systems and software engineering services across public and private sectors, supporting complex and mission critical environments with integrity, collaboration, and care.

Since 2010, our talented team has partnered with organizations such as the FBI, U.S. Air Force, NASA, Department of Education, Department of Energy, DHS, SOCOM, and leading private sector clients. We are known for combining technical excellence with a thoughtful, people first approach.

At Trilogy, you will work alongside smart, committed professionals in a supportive, learning oriented environment. We value innovation, accountability, and continuous growth, and we encourage our people to bring both expertise and humanity to the work they do.

If you are looking to contribute to impactful work while growing your skills in a collaborative and forward-thinking organization, Trilogy Innovations is a place where you can do just that.

Department Name:

Pharmacy careers are better at Banner Health. We are committed to developing the careers of our team members. We care about you, your career today and your future. If you’re looking to leverage your abilities – apply today.

In this role of Pharmacist Intern, you will support CMS pharmacy stars measures. Responsibilities include working on medication adherence member outreach calls. This opening has a commitment of 8 hours per week during business hours Monday - Friday (between 7:30AM - 5:30PM,) 4 or 8 hour shifts. Flexible schedule. This is a remote, work from home position.

Banner Pharmacy Services is a recognized leader in healthcare and trusted partner in proactively providing innovative pharmacy services through excellence in integration, care coordination, medication management and services to make a difference in people's lives. Clinical Pharmacy Services is responsible for the management of the Banner formulary, development of standardized system wide clinical pharmacy services, and management of adverse drug event preventions. Clinical Pharmacy Services provides collaborative drug therapy management and educational interventions in patient care to optimize medication therapy, improve outcomes, promote wellness, and disease prevention. As a division, Banner Pharmacy services provides excellent patient care across our entire continuum through convenient access, improved medication outcomes and innovative pharmacy practices.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position will work under the supervision of the pharmacist. Performs routine duties in packaging, distribution and record keeping of pharmaceutical supplies. Assists in preparing compounded and intravenous medications, total parenteral nutrition products, and chemotherapeutic agents. Consistently demonstrates an ability to assess a situation, consider alternatives, and choose the appropriate course of action. May work with the Pharmacist in processing physician orders for medications by entering information in to the medication management system in an unverified status. Under the supervision of the pharmacist, assesses and formulates potential recommendations to physicians and provides information to physicians, nurses, and others regarding topics relating to the medication use system. Must demonstrate the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients being served.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Selects and/or prepares medications, under direct supervision, as indicated on the patient medication orders. Places medications in patient boxes or in designated area for pharmacist to review, sends/delivers medications to nursing units as required. Investigates missing medication requests Charges/credits patients for medications and intravenous solutions as appropriate. Restocks unused and credited returned medications.

2. Attends to customers and answers telephones in a courteous and timely manner. Serves as a liaison between the customer and the pharmacist.

3. Using automated dispensing technology or requisition, restocks medications to nursing and ancillary areas after checked by a pharmacist. Restocks medications to all areas outside automated dispensing technology which may include but not be limited to trays, code carts and emergency boxes. Adds users to the automatic dispensing technology database as per policy. Investigates discrepancies in automated dispensing technology. Troubleshoots automated technology malfunctions.

4. Identifies medications and other items for reorder as necessary to maintain a continuous inventory of medications and supplies. Receives, checks-in, and restocks medications ordered through wholesaler and other vendors.

5. Compounds specialty drug products. Repackages bulk medications into unit of use packaging. Completes accurate documentation of items compounded and repackaged.

6. Assists in preparing and labeling of intravenous medication orders including total parenteral nutrition products and chemotherapy products using proper sterile and aseptic technique.

7. Under the supervision of a pharmacist, utilizes education and pharmacy skills in assessing and formulating potential recommendations to physicians to help ensure quality and economical drug therapy, and positive patient outcomes. May provide information (under pharmacist supervision) to physicians, nurses, and others regarding medication therapy, medication systems, drug product guidelines, laws and regulations, medication formulary, and other topics related to the medication use system. Medication assessments may be performed with special consideration given to medication safety and the needs of the specific patient age groups served.

8. Performs quality control activities such as monthly nursing unit checks and pharmacy section checks in a timely manner. Completes documentation on refrigerator temperatures, intravenous hood cleaning, and equipment maintenance activities as required.

9. Participates in all aspects of medication use, including (1) selection, procurement and storage, (2) dispensing, (3) monitoring of all medications utilized. Internal customers may include Patients, Nurses, Licensed Independent Practitioners, Nursing Directors, Department Directors, Administrators and other health care team members for the purpose of integrating services, improving patient care and ensuring effective communication systems. External customers may include local, state, and national pharmacy organizations, Joint Commission, state Board of Pharmacy, colleagues and peers, educational institutions and pharmaceutical representatives.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must be attending an accredited school of Pharmacy.

Requires current and unrestricted pharmacy intern licensure in the state of practice.

Incumbents in Arizona are also required to provide the AZ Board of Pharmacy Wallet Card at time of hire.

Must possess good organizational, problem solving and computer skills. Must have good written and verbal communication skills for interfacing with all levels of Staff, physicians, patients and other contacts. Must have knowledge of computer software, particularly medication management information system software, Microsoft applications and Automated dispensing systems.

Employees working at Banner Behavioral Health Hospital must possess an Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card at the time of hire and maintain the card for the duration of their employment. An Arizona Criminal History Affidavit must be signed upon hire.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Pharmacy technician experience preferred. Additional training in specialty areas (such as automatic dispensing technology, controlled substances and satellite pharmacy) preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Estimated Pay Range:

$25.00 - $25.00 / hourBanner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting.This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained.

jobs.title: PR & Media Hacker
jobs.excerpt: “For every person joining us for any position, there is a path and an opportunity to reach an executive role and become a company partner.
jobs.description:
“For every person joining us for any position, there is a path and an opportunity to reach an executive role and become a company partner.”
Antons Sapriko, Company Founder

How to become a PR & Media Hacker at scandiweb?

We are a very inclusive company with colleagues from over 30 countries across all continents. We welcome people from all walks of life who can complete a practical test by showing how they think, create stories, and turn an ordinary business topic into something people want to discuss.
This is not a traditional PR position where your main responsibility is to prepare press releases, upload them to distribution platforms, and send the same pitch to a long media list. We are looking for someone who knows how to direct people's attention.
Your job will be to find the tension, consequence, opponent, proof, or human angle that turns it into a story worth sharing.
Sometimes the story already exists and needs to be discovered. Sometimes you will help create the real event, benchmark, public challenge, experiment, debate, collaboration, or campaign that gives the media a reason to cover it.
We welcome previous experience in PR, journalism, communications, creative agencies, content, startups, or growth marketing. However, the strongest evidence of your ability will be how you approach the practical tasks.
We value your ability to deliver results, your curiosity, your persistence, and your openness to learn from feedback. Continuous learning and acting on feedback are among our core organizational values.

What are the responsibilities of a PR & Media Hacker?

As a PR & Media Hacker at scandiweb, your main responsibility will be to create public attention around scandiweb, internal ventures, company developments, and selected client projects.
You will work closely with company founders and business leaders to identify stories that deserve public attention. You will not wait for someone to hand you a finished announcement. You will proactively search for opportunities, develop the angle, shape the campaign, collect the proof, and bring the story to the right audience.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Finding PR opportunities inside scandiweb (e.g., projects, client work, internal discussions, product development, research, technical achievements, market changes, etc)
  • Turning complex or seemingly ordinary topics into stories worth sharing with a strong headline, tension, consequence, and reason for people to care;
  • Developing creative PR campaigns and stunts and making people speak about it;
  • Creating real newsworthy moments when a strong story does not yet exist, rather than just waiting for them to appear;
  • Building several media angles around the same core event for different audiences;
  • Researching journalists, editors, newsletter writers, podcasters, creators, analysts, and industry communities that are relevant to each story;
  • Preparing personalized pitches and reaching out directly through email, social media, calls, introductions, events, and other appropriate channels;
  • Building long-term relationships with media professionals by understanding what they cover and bringing them useful, timely, and credible stories;
  • Coordinating interviews, expert comments, supporting data, visuals, demonstrations, customer evidence, and spokesperson preparation;
  • Working with content, design, video, data, and development teams to create the materials needed to prove and distribute a story;
  • Monitoring public conversations, competitor activity, industry news, and cultural trends to identify moments when scandiweb can contribute a relevant point of view;
  • Responding quickly when an unexpected media opportunity appears and coordinating the required internal contributors;
  • Using AI and research tools to monitor media, find patterns, identify relevant contacts, develop angles, and improve outreach without turning communication into automated spam;
  • Measuring campaign results, documenting what worked, and improving future campaigns based on actual media response and business impact.
The number of press releases produced will not measure success in this role.
It will be measured by the quality and relevance of earned media coverage, the conversations your campaigns create, the relationships you build, the attention generated among the right audiences, and the business opportunities supported by your work.

What do we expect from you?

We are looking for a curious, persistent, and highly proactive person who naturally looks for the story behind what is happening.
You may come from PR, journalism, media, content, communications, creative strategy, startup marketing, or another relevant background. A traditional PR career can come in handy. Still, you should be able to demonstrate that you have previously attracted attention, earned coverage, built an audience, or created public interest around an idea.
The following qualities will help you succeed in the role:
  • Strong news judgment and the ability to understand why one story gets covered while another is ignored;
  • The ability to find a compelling angle in technical, commercial, or otherwise ordinary information;
  • Excellent headline, pitch, and short-form writing skills;
  • Confident written and spoken English, as you will be working with international media and clients;
  • The ability to understand technical and business topics and explain them in simple language;
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to contact people directly rather than waiting for inbound interest;
  • Persistence when pitches are ignored, rejected, or require several attempts before receiving a response;
  • Comfort working with incomplete information and developing a campaign while the underlying project is still evolving;
  • The ability to manage several stories, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time;
  • Confidence when communicating with founders, executives, technical experts, clients, journalists, and creators;
  • The ability to work independently, make decisions, and take responsibility for campaign outcomes;
  • Curiosity about media, business, technology, eCommerce, culture, and the reasons people share information;
  • A practical understanding of social media, online communities, podcasts, newsletters, creator channels, and other forms of media beyond traditional publications.
Existing relationships with journalists, editors, creators, or industry media will be considered an advantage. However, we value your ability to identify and build the right relationships more than the size of an existing contact list.
Experience in eCommerce or technology will also be considered an advantage, but it is not mandatory. We will help you understand our industry, projects, services, and technical context.

What do we offer?

  • Monthly salary of 4200-5000 EUR NET, depending on experience and execution level.
  • Opportunity to gain stock options within the company
  • Support for hardware upgrades;
  • Core health insurance coverage and sports bonuses;
  • A diverse multinational team of experts to learn from;
  • Legendary online and onsite events to celebrate our success together.

Our executive advisory programs are an important part of how Stripe captures the perspectives of executive buyers. The portfolio includes our global Customer Advisory Board as well as regional, segment, and emerging advisory programs.
