jobs.title: Head of Accounting
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As the Head of Accounting, you will play a critical role in building and owning the accounting function for a growing fractional CFO and financial operations consultancy. You'll manage accounting delivery across a portfolio of clients, overseeing everything from bookkeeping, AP/AR, and general ledger management through month-end close, financial reporting, cash flow, controls, compliance, and financial systems.

This role is ideal for a senior accounting professional who combines strong technical expertise with a hands-on execution mindset and the ability to build structure where it doesn't yet exist. Rather than functioning as a traditional accounting manager, you'll act as the functional owner of accounting—establishing scalable processes and controls, maintaining high-quality financial operations across multiple client environments, and serving as a trusted finance partner to founders and leadership while helping build the accounting service line from the ground up.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Accountability

Client Portfolio & Accounting Delivery

  • Own accounting delivery across a diverse portfolio of client accounts and entities.
  • Manage the full accounting lifecycle from client onboarding through recurring bookkeeping, close, reporting, and ongoing support.
  • Maintain visibility across multiple client engagements and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Serve as a trusted finance partner to client founders and leadership teams.
  • Translate financial information into clear, actionable insights for clients.

Core Accounting & Bookkeeping

  • Own day-to-day bookkeeping across client accounts.
  • Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes.
  • Maintain accurate general ledgers and supporting financial documentation.
  • Review and appropriately code financial transactions.
  • Ensure accounting records remain accurate, complete, and current.
  • Remain hands-on with transactional accounting while maintaining senior oversight of the broader function.

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes across client engagements.
  • Perform and oversee account and bank reconciliations.
  • Prepare and review accurate financial statements in accordance with applicable GAAP and/or IFRS requirements.
  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, inconsistencies, and risks.
  • Present financial information and insights clearly to client leadership.
  • Establish repeatable close and reporting procedures that can scale across the client portfolio.

Controls, Compliance & Audit

  • Establish and maintain effective internal controls across accounting operations.
  • Develop accounting policies, financial procedures, and governance standards.
  • Ensure appropriate application of GAAP and/or IFRS accounting principles.
  • Coordinate tax compliance, regulatory filings, and external audit requirements.
  • Work with external tax advisors and auditors to provide accurate financial information and supporting documentation.
  • Identify control weaknesses and implement practical improvements.
  • Maintain strong financial governance as the accounting service line grows.

Cash Flow & Working Capital

  • Monitor cash flow and liquidity across client accounts.
  • Oversee banking processes and bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor working capital requirements and short-term liquidity.
  • Identify potential cash flow concerns and proactively surface them to leadership.
  • Support clients with cash management and related financial decisions.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

  • Own and optimize cloud accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online and Xero.
  • Evaluate accounting and finance systems as client requirements evolve.
  • Select and implement new accounting or ERP solutions where appropriate.
  • Develop scalable workflows, SOPs, and operating procedures.
  • Identify inefficient or manual processes and implement practical improvements.
  • Maintain consistency, accuracy, and data integrity across financial systems and client engagements.

AI & Automation

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve accounting and finance workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, documentation, and repetitive finance processes.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring accounting activities while maintaining appropriate financial controls and judgment.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs and ensure financial accuracy before use.
  • Contribute ideas for improving technology-enabled finance workflows and proprietary financial tools.

Building & Scaling the Accounting Function

  • Establish the operational foundation for accounting as a core service line.
  • Develop accounting standards, SOPs, controls, and delivery methodologies.
  • Create processes that can support a growing client portfolio without compromising quality.
  • Bring proven accounting best practices rather than relying on established processes being handed to you.
  • Help determine future accounting team structure and resource requirements.
  • Mentor and potentially recruit and manage accounting team members as the function grows.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with client founders and leadership teams, the founder of the business, and other finance professionals and external advisors. You'll serve as the senior accounting owner across client engagements, ensuring accounting delivery is accurate, consistent, and aligned with client needs while helping establish how the broader accounting function operates.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

As a Head of Accounting, your vertical focus will be on accounting operations, financial reporting, controls, and financial governance, while your horizontal focus will include client advisory, finance systems, process improvement, AI-enabled automation, and functional leadership.

  • Experience: 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally including multi-client, multi-entity, fractional CFO, outsourced accounting, or professional services environments.
  • Accounting Expertise: Deep hands-on knowledge of bookkeeping, AP, AR, general ledger management, reconciliations, month-end close, and financial statement preparation.
  • Financial Reporting: Strong ability to prepare, review, and analyze financial statements in accordance with GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Financial Controls & Compliance: Experience establishing internal controls, accounting policies, financial procedures, and supporting tax, regulatory, and audit requirements.
  • Cash Flow & Working Capital: Strong understanding of cash management, banking, working capital, and liquidity oversight.
  • Accounting Systems: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Xero, or comparable cloud accounting platforms, with the ability to evaluate and implement finance systems.
  • Client Advisory: Confidence working directly with founders and senior leadership and translating financial information into clear recommendations and insights.
  • Process Improvement: Demonstrated ability to build accounting processes and SOPs from the ground up and continuously improve operational efficiency.
  • Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating independently, making sound financial decisions, and remaining accountable for outcomes without mature processes or constant supervision.
  • AI Fluency: Experience using AI tools to improve finance workflows, analysis, documentation, reporting, or automation.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English with the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Accounting Leadership & Financial Operations: Your ability to lead accounting operations, maintain financial accuracy, and ensure the accounting function operates effectively at scale.
  • Financial Reporting & Compliance: Your ability to oversee accurate financial reporting, apply relevant accounting standards, and maintain strong compliance and control practices.
  • Month-End Close & Financial Controls: Your ability to manage the close process, identify discrepancies, and establish controls that protect the integrity of financial information.
  • Technical Accounting & GAAP: Your ability to apply accounting principles and GAAP appropriately to complex transactions, reporting requirements, and business situations.
  • Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Your ability to lead and develop an accounting team while communicating effectively with senior stakeholders and other functions.
  • Process Improvement & Scalability: Your ability to identify weaknesses in accounting processes, implement improvements, and build scalable systems that support business growth.

jobs.description:
Senior React Native Engineer, AI Products & Mobile Platform

Reports To: VP of Engineering
Location: Remote

About inKind

inKind is transforming restaurant financing and customer engagement through an innovative fintech platform that provides restaurants with growth capital while helping consumers discover and enjoy dining experiences nationwide.

We're looking for a Senior React Native Software Engineer who has built and maintained large-scale, consumer-facing mobile applications. This role requires deep React Native expertise, strong native iOS knowledge, and an engineering-first mindset focused on quality, scalability, testing, and long-term maintainability.

Position Summary

As a senior member of our Engineering team, you'll own the development of high-quality React Native applications across iOS and Android. Beyond building features, you'll improve architecture, lead React Native upgrades, resolve complex native issues, and help shape engineering standards across our mobile platform.

You'll work within one of inKind's product pods alongside Product Managers, Designers, QA, Backend Engineers, and fellow Mobile Engineers to deliver customer-facing features used at scale.

This is not a UI-focused React Native role—we're looking for an engineer who understands the full mobile stack, writes production-quality code, owns testing, and is comfortable debugging native platforms when required.

What You'll Own

React Native Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance React Native applications.
  • Deliver scalable, maintainable TypeScript code following engineering best practices.
  • Improve application architecture, performance, reliability, and developer experience.
  • Own React Native version upgrades, dependency management, and framework migrations.

Native Mobile Development

  • Build, maintain, and debug native iOS modules using Swift and Kotlin
  • Integrate native platform APIs into React Native applications.
  • Diagnose and resolve native dependency issues and bridge failures.
  • Partner with Android engineers on native integrations when required.

Code Quality & Testing

  • Own automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Build reliable CI/CD pipelines that prevent regressions before release.
  • Champion code quality through reviews, mentoring, and engineering standards.
  • Reduce technical debt while improving long-term maintainability.

Mobile Platform Excellence

  • Develop systematic testing strategies across Android devices, screen sizes, and OS versions.
  • Improve release stability through automation, monitoring, and quality assurance.
  • Optimize performance, memory usage, rendering, and application responsiveness.
  • Investigate production issues using structured debugging techniques.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Backend Engineering, and QA within a cross-functional pod.
  • Help define technical solutions during product discovery.
  • Contribute to architecture discussions across Engineering.
  • Mentor engineers and promote engineering best practices across pods.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualification

  • 6+ years building production React Native applications.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, consumer-facing mobile apps with significant production usage.
  • Experience working within established engineering organizations (typically 50+ employees with mature engineering processes including code reviews, CI/CD, and structured release management).
  • Expert knowledge of React Native architecture and performance optimization.
  • Strong TypeScript experience.
  • Strong Swift experience with the ability to build and debug native modules and bridges.
  • Kotlin or Android native development experience.
  • Experience managing React Native version upgrades, dependency updates, and native package compatibility.
  • Experience using tools such as patch-package and resolving native library conflicts.
  • Strong understanding of React state management including Redux, React Query, Zustand, or Context.
  • Experience designing and maintaining automated test suites using Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, or equivalent.
  • Experience working with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, and Postman.
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience using AI development tools while maintaining strong engineering judgment.

Preferred

  • Experience building custom native bridges.
  • Experience publishing and supporting apps through the Apple App Store and Google Play.
  • Experience supporting applications with hundreds of thousands or millions of users.
  • Experience with monitoring and crash reporting tools such as Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry.

Success Looks Like

  • Leading React Native upgrades with minimal disruption to production.
  • Writing reliable, well-tested code with high automated test coverage.
  • Confidently debugging native iOS and Android issues without relying on third-party support.
  • Building mobile experiences that perform consistently across a broad range of Android devices and screen sizes.
  • Raising engineering standards through architecture, testing, code reviews, and mentorship.
  • Delivering high-quality features quickly while maintaining long-term maintainability.

Salary: $160,000 - $180,000 DOE

Who we are:inKind connects passionate diners with exceptional restaurants across the country. inKind partners with thousands of restaurants and has millions of users who want to discover great places, dine confidently, and earn meaningful rewards.

Through the inKind app, guests earn 20% back every time they dine, turning everyday meals into something more rewarding. From celebrated restaurant groups like José Andres and Michael Mina to beloved neighborhood favorites, inKind helps diners explore the best restaurants in town while supporting the restaurants and chefs who shape how their cities eat.

Rooted in hospitality and built on a win-win philosophy, inKind exists to help great restaurants thrive while inspiring guests to dine out more often. Every meal creates value on both sides of the table, empowering diners to savor more while strengthening the restaurant community.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
jobs.excerpt: About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas.

This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side — expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders — and you want the pager for it — you will feel at home.

You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed — escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced.

What you’ll do

Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines

  • Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss.

  • Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse.

  • Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse — partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it.

  • Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production.

Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership

  • Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back.

  • Own observability for what you build — meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise.

  • Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives.

Full stack engineering and technical leadership

  • Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents — including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations.

  • Contribute to the analytics front end — dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools — with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs.

  • Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation.

  • Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team.

Experience and education requirements

The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition.

Requirement

Mandatory minimum

8+ years of Backend software engineering experience

4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems

3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD

3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines

3+ years On-call and production ownership

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field

Required

A master’s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable.

Required qualifications

  • Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage.

  • Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system.

  • Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling.

  • Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations

  • Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular.

Desired qualifications

  • Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store — sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning.

  • Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms.

  • Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark.

  • Client-side instrumentation — web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling.

AI skills

Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 — it applies to how you build and to what you build.

  • Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other — catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready.

  • AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt.

  • Integrating LLM APIs into production features — and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus.

  • Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls.

  • Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components — retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints — and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer.

  • Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

jobs.description:
About BeInCrypto

BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone. Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events.

About The Role

We’re searching for a Head of Multimedia to lead and scale BeInCrypto’s global video presence across YouTube, X, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging media platforms. We’re looking for a credible editorial voice with a strong background in crypto, finance, or business media — someone who understands the industry deeply, has meaningful connections within the ecosystem, and can turn complex market narratives into engaging, high-performing video content.

Success in this role requires both editorial authority and industry credibility — you should already understand the key players, narratives, and dynamics shaping crypto and financial markets.

Tasks

  • Lead BeInCrypto’s end-to-end multimedia editorial strategy across long-form and short-form content.
  • Host interviews, analysis videos, and industry conversations with confidence and strong editorial presence.
  • Own the video editorial calendar and align it with market trends, product priorities, and audience demand.
  • Develop story angles, scripts, hooks, and video concepts optimized for retention and audience growth.
  • Work hands-on with editors, designers, and social media teams to deliver high-performing content.
  • Identify viral moments and shape short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and X.
  • Build relationships with founders, researchers, investors, and key voices across crypto and traditional finance.
  • Analyze performance metrics including watch time, retention, engagement, and subscriber growth to continuously improve content strategy.

Requirements

  • Have 4+ years of experience in financial journalism, crypto media, business media, or creator-led finance content.
  • Have a strong understanding of crypto, blockchain, financial markets, and the broader fintech ecosystem.
  • Bring an existing network of founders, investors, analysts, researchers, or media contacts within crypto, Web3, or traditional finance.
  • Have experience hosting, producing, or leading video-first editorial content across YouTube, podcasts, interviews, or social platforms.
  • Combine editorial thinking with hands-on execution — you are comfortable both shaping strategy and creating content yourself.
  • Understand what performs across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X, and can adapt content formats accordingly.
  • Are fluent in English (С2).

Nice to have:

  • Experience moderating panels, hosting live discussions, or representing brands publicly.
  • Personal audience presence on YouTube, X, LinkedIn, or newsletters.
  • Strong understanding of YouTube optimization, thumbnails, hooks, and retention strategy.

Benefits

  • 100% remote work with no location restrictions.
  • Flexible working hours with no time tracking and no mandatory meetings outside your timezone.
  • Paid time off to recharge.
  • Clear goals and freedom to define the ways to achieve them.
  • Access to major crypto events & conferences.
  • Internal learning programs & masterclasses.
  • Support for personal branding and industry visibility.
  • An inclusive workplace where everyone—regardless of background, nationality, gender, identity, abilities, or beliefs—can thrive.

Meet our team:

You’ll be working with the Multimedia Global Newsroom department. Your manager will be the Chief Global Strategy Officer. This team is the heart of BeInCrypto - reporting and original research on digital assets and institutional finance, published in 26 languages.

Ready to start your new journey with us?

At BeInCrypto, we value your ideas, curiosity, dynamism, adaptability, ownership mindset, passion for innovation and AI, awareness of industry trends, and ability to work autonomously and stay organized. If this approach resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team and achieve new heights together!

Recruitment process: HR interview → Interview with Chief Global Strategy Officer and Director of Institutional Growth & Partnerships → Interview with the CEO → Offer.

Apply now, and our Recruitment team will contact you with the next steps.

jobs.description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: This role is only available to residents of the United States. We are unable to employ anyone who is not physically located in the US, nor are we sponsoring Visas at this time. Please be aware that job offers are contingent upon a background check which includes identity & address verification and a criminal background check.

Who We Are

Akkadian Labs is a Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform that services some of the largest global enterprises and government agencies. Our platform currently reduces manual work by up to 90% and costs by as much as 50%, while improving accuracy and governance across leading Unified Communications platforms.

This ability to innovate at scale defines who we are: big enough to compete at the highest level, yet agile enough to stay ahead of a rapidly evolving market. Our culture is people-first, fully remote, and rooted in grit, clarity, trust and respect, because when our people thrive, so do our customers.

Who You Are

You are a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with deep experience designing, building, and strengthening the infrastructure that keeps platforms secure, compliant, and uncomplicated. You bring substantial experience maintaining production infrastructure and improving operational reliability through disciplined engineering practice. You have a track record of helping to scale systems with a focus on dependability, observability, deployment confidence, and repeatable processes that support long-term growth. You are energized by solving infrastructure challenges in complex enterprise environments and by building systems that reduce manual work, improve governance, and support operational accuracy at scale.

What You'll Do

This role supports Akkadian’s purpose to uncomplicate work by removing friction between people and their purpose — helping enterprise customers govern, automate, and continuously control complex collaboration environments across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises systems. You will design, implement, and maintain scalable and secure infrastructure and DevOps processes at Akkadian Labs. You will work closely with development, QA, and product teams to enable reliable deployments, automate workflows, and improve system observability across Rocky OS-based, AWS-hosted, and on-premises solutions.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on system-level execution, continuous improvement, and operational excellence within the DevOps function.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure and Environment Management

  • Deploy and maintain scalable infrastructure in AWS and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools.
  • Maintain Linux-based environments.
  • Design and implement containerization using Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes.

AI and Agent Infrastructure Implementation & Support

  • Design, deploy and manage AI agent workloads, including provisioning compute instances and managing resource scaling for inference-heavy tasks.
  • Build and maintain model deployment pipelines, including versioning, testing, and rollback of AI models in production environments.
  • Monitor AI API consumption and infrastructure costs, implementing alerting and controls to prevent runaway usage and support budget visibility.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to implement infrastructure-level security guardrails for AI systems, including access controls and data isolation for model inputs and outputs.

Observability and Reliability

  • Manage monitoring and observability efforts using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and contribute to incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Develop and execute strategies for improving system reliability, performance, and uptime.

CI/CD and Automation

  • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket CI/CD, or similar.
  • Automate routine operational tasks including builds, testing, deployments, and system updates.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate pipelines with Akkadian tools.

Security and Compliance

  • Follow secure DevOps practices and implement and maintain security controls.
  • Support compliance initiatives and vulnerability remediation efforts.

Collaboration and Documentation

  • Work closely with DevOps, engineering, QA, and product teams to support deployments and releases.
  • Maintain documentation for infrastructure, processes, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in collaborative team processes and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Cloud Expertise: Expertise with AWS (e.g., EC2, ECS, S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Expertise with infrastructure-as-code tools, including Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Linux Knowledge: Strong knowledge of Linux environments.
  • Containerization: Experienced with Docker and Kubernetes.

Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire an Account Executive, Corporate Sales, Public Sector for the Sales & Customer Experience team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?

At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.

What you’ll do

  • Identify and cultivate sales opportunities within the Corporate Public Sector segment.
  • Take full ownership of deal cycles & work with your extended account team to drive results in Sprout’s Public Sector business.
  • Manage a strong pipeline of qualified leads and begin the process of self-generating pipeline with key accounts and strategic stakeholders.
  • Own & exceed targets by consistently hitting or exceeding activity goals, such as prospecting and meetings, to build and maintain a strong pipeline that drives consistent quota achievement.
  • Develop strong, long-term relationships within your accounts by engaging at multiple levels, from executives and VPs to end users, ensuring broad and deep customer engagement across your portfolio.

What you’ll bring

Sprout Social is seeking a highly motivated, tech-savvy Account Executive with strong business acumen to join our growing Public Sector sales team. The ideal candidate will be equally passionate about delivering exceptional customer value and driven to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities.

These are the minimum qualifications that our hiring team is looking for in this role:

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record in hunting and closing full-cycle sales opportunities (SaaS experience is a plus).
  • Demonstrated ability to exceed sales targets and other performance metrics consistently.
  • Strong aptitude for managing a large number of transactions in a fast-paced environment.

Additionally, these are the preferred qualifications that would indicate a particularly strong candidate:

  • Experience selling to the Public Sector industry is a plus.
  • Strong experience in developing and nurturing relationships with key decision-makers across multiple functions, including executives, department heads, and cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with internal teams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive deal momentum and exceed expectations for both prospects and customers.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Participate in Sprout Social's new hire training & onboarding program alongside fellow team members to gain a comprehensive understanding of our products and the role you play within the organization.
  • Collaborate with your manager to define key success metrics for your position and establish how you will track and measure your performance.
  • Shadow Account Executives during live sales calls or through Gong recordings to learn effective sales strategies, techniques, and messaging.
  • Get hands-on with our platform to explore its unique features, understand its business impact, and grasp why customers love our solutions.
  • Familiarize yourself with relevant customer stories and case studies to support your value propositions with real-world ROI examples.
  • Complete a product demo and written certification to ensure a thorough understanding of our solutions and sales process.
  • Learn the existing customer sales process by shadowing your peers and actively participating in sales activities to build proficiency.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Managing a strong pipeline of qualified leads and beginning the process of self-generating pipeline with key accounts and strategic stakeholders.
  • Understand your customers’ language and needs, identifying opportunities to expand our offerings by either entering new personas or increasing platform adoption with existing teams.
  • Own and exceed your performance metrics, consistently meeting or surpassing activity goals to build a robust pipeline that drives reliable quota achievement post-ramp.
  • Conduct thorough research using available tools and data sources to understand your customers' brand, culture, KPIs, partners, and success metrics, enabling you to provide tailored insights and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Build a pipeline that exceeds 4X your monthly quota target for new logo acquisition, maintaining a strong focus on generating high-quality opportunities.
  • Become an expert in Sprout Social and the social media landscape, staying up to date on trends, product updates, and platform enhancements. Use this knowledge to help customers unlock the full potential of our solutions and achieve their business objectives.
  • Consistently meet or exceed your monthly and quarterly revenue targets, driving strong sales performance and contributing to overall business growth.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Take on a peer leadership role by sharing best practices and insights across the organization, helping colleagues grow and learn from your experiences.
  • Consistently surpass key metrics for monthly activity, pipeline growth, and new business acquisition, ensuring continuous progress toward team and organizational goals.
  • Actively seek and incorporate feedback from peers and customers, both solicited and unsolicited, to continuously improve performance, refine strategies, and enhance customer relationships.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

At MSQ DX, we love to share knowledge, nurture skills, and encourage you to challenge yourself. Our Business Analysts are organized, enthusiastic, engaged, consultative, and adaptable.

What You’ll Be Doing

On customer projects

  • Elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project sponsors and stakeholders
  • Gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflows, use cases, scenarios, and other methods
  • Translate conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team
  • Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards
  • Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team as needed
  • Review detailed requirements/user stories with the business stakeholders to ensure accuracy.

  • Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine, as necessary
  • Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood
  • Establish a solid relationship of trust and respect with the client stakeholders and internal team members from all departments.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail on each engagement
  • Leverage AI tools throughout the requirements lifecycle — from synthesizing discovery notes and drafting BRDs to generating user stories and acceptance criteria — to accelerate delivery without sacrificing quality

As a member of the Arke BA Team

  • Continuously look for ways to further enhance MSQ DX’s methods of requirements-gathering and documentation
    • Assist with developing standard templates to write requirements specifications accurately and concisely
    • Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members
    • Pilot and champion new AI-powered workflows and tools for the BA team, sharing prompts, templates, and lessons learned so the broader team can work more efficiently
    • Maintain a positive and productive working relationship with stakeholders, peers, and leadership

What We’d Love to See

  • 5+ years of web project lifecycle — discovery to design to implementation and release — ideally within a MarTech digital agency setting
  • 2 – 5 years of previous product management and/or project management experience
  • 5+ years of experience with CMSs (experience with any of the following is a plus – Contentstack, Contentful, Optimizely, Sitecore, WordPress Atlas, Uniform)
  • Understanding of web page structure (i.e. header, components, footer) and WCAG 2.1/2.2 accessibility requirements
  • Experience with Quality Assurance and testing, and the ability to work within an Agile or Waterfall environment
  • Ability to write well organized and easily digestible user stories/requirements
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills, with excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
  • Highly self-motivated, organized, and detail-oriented, with sound independent judgment, a strong customer-service orientation, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Proven ability to prioritize and manage 3 or more concurrent client engagements without sacrificing quality or timeliness
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university, with a preferred concentration in Business or Management Information Systems
  • Experience using Office 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, along with diagramming tools like Visio or Miro
  • Experience managing project requirements using Jira or Azure DevOps, with demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support requirements documentation and analysis

What is a BA at MSQ DX?

The BA role and expectations tend to vary from company to company. At MSQ DX, BA’s often find themselves in a leadership role on their projects – they own the act of requirements gathering, documentation and the transformation of those requirements into user stories and tasks – thus knowing every aspect of a project in more detail than most other members of the team. Because of this, they must seamlessly be able to work with clients/product owners, solutions architects, developers, designers, and quality assurance personnel. An MSQ DX BA must be highly organized, self-guided and have a sense of pride and ownership in the work they produce. BAs at MSQ DX typically balance multiple client engagements at once, and are expected to embrace AI as part of their everyday workflow — using it to work faster and more thoughtfully, and helping surface new ways the broader team can put it to use.

jobs.description:
About Zencore

Zencore is a premier Google Cloud pure-play consultancy and a four-time Google Cloud Partner of the Year. Founded by former Google Cloud leaders and engineers, we help enterprises modernize infrastructure, architect advanced data platforms, and deploy production-ready AI solutions - including our market-leading ZenAI Factory agentic frameworks.

With private equity backing from Superstep Capital and a rapidly growing global delivery footprint across North America, LATAM, and EMEA, Zencore combines the technical depth of a large consultancy with the agility, senior talent, and speed of an elite boutique.

About Superstep

    About Superstep

    Superstep Capital is a growth-oriented private equity firm established by experienced technology services operators and investors who partner with founder-led businesses to build category-leading services platforms. The firm’s investment approach centers on long-term value creation through close collaboration with management teams and targeted investment in leadership development, go-to-market capabilities, and delivery excellence, while preserving strong cultures and trusted client relationships.

About the Role

    Zencore is seeking a strategic, growth-oriented Head of Marketing to design, execute, and scale our global marketing strategy.

    In this senior leadership role, you will be responsible for three core pillars: setting overarching marketing strategy, building brand awareness across the Google Cloud ecosystem, and driving scalable customer acquisition pipelines. You will serve as the architect of our Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, positioning Zencore as the premier enterprise partner for cloud modernization and full stack AI on Google Cloud.

    This role requires a balance of high-level strategic vision, data-driven demand generation, and deep ecosystem marketing. You will work closely with executive leadership, sales, practice leads, and Google Cloud field marketing teams to turn Zencore’s technical capabilities into market demand.

Responsibilities

  • Define GTM Strategy: Build and execute an integrated, multi-year marketing strategy designed to accelerate revenue growth.

  • Budget & ROI Ownership: Manage the global marketing budget, allocating resources efficiently across brand, demand generation, events, and co-marketing to maximize pipeline ROI.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Sales, Alliances, and Delivery leadership to align marketing programs with sales targets, practice expansion, and enterprise account strategies.

  • Ecosystem Co-Marketing: Maximize joint marketing opportunities with Google Cloud - leveraging Partner Marketing Funds (MDF), RAMP programs, and co-branded campaigns to amplify reach.

  • Events & Event Strategy: Own Zencore’s presence at major industry and ecosystem events (e.g., Google Cloud Next, regional summits, and executive roundtables), driving high-touch executive engagement.

  • Thought Leadership & PR: Oversee content strategy, customer case studies, technical whitepapers, and PR initiatives to showcase Zencore’s technical wins and client outcomes.

  • Multi-Channel Pipeline Generation: Design and execute Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and inbound/outbound campaigns targeting enterprise C-suite buyers (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VPs of Infrastructure/AI).

  • Funnel Optimization: Build and optimize a predictable demand generation engine across paid media, LinkedIn, organic search, content syndication, and email marketing.

  • Commercial Solution Packaging: Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling, buyer-centric value propositions, sales playbooks, and solution sheets for our service practices.

  • Customer Success Advocacy: Partner with Delivery leads to capture and publish high-impact enterprise case studies, video testimonials, and ROI metrics that validate Zencore's market leadership.

Qualifications

  • 8–12+ Years of B2B Marketing Leadership: Proven track record in B2B enterprise marketing, with at least 4+ years in a senior leadership role within a cloud consultancy, professional services firm, or high-growth IT services company.

  • Hyperscaler / Google Ecosystem Experience: Direct experience working within the Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure partner ecosystems. Deep familiarity with co-marketing programs, MDF utilization, and hyperscaler field alignment is highly desirable.

  • Track Record in Demand Gen & Pipeline Growth: Demonstrated ability to own a pipeline target, build multi-touch ABM campaigns, and generate measurable enterprise pipeline.

  • Data-Driven & MarTech Savvy: Proficient with modern sales and marketing technology stacks (HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, ABM platforms, and web analytics). Strong understanding of the current AI tooling.

  • Exceptional Communication: Outstanding written, verbal, and visual storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical cloud/AI concepts into business outcomes for executive buyers.

Why Work at Zencore?

  • We Are Trusted Experts: Our teams bring deep, hands-on experience to solve the hardest cloud and AI challenges.

  • We Value Candor: We share unbiased opinions and aren't afraid of hard truths—our clients view us as true subject matter experts.

  • We Are the Missing Link: We connect our enterprise clients directly to Google Cloud innovation, moving with agility where larger consultancies stall out.

  • We Remove Uncertainty: We bring structured playbooks that eliminate risk from complex cloud migrations and AI deployments.

  • We Show Empathy: We build lasting client trust because we understand the real-world operational complexities of enterprise technology.

Zencore is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Zencore is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Your members run lean. Your donors expect impact. Your staff is juggling a dozen systems to make it happen. At Momentive Software, we build the technology that makes that easier.


We are the leading software platform for nonprofits and associations, serving more than 37,000 mission-driven organizations for over 40 years. Our portfolio covers every core need: association management (MC Trade, NimbleAMS, YourMembership, WildApricot, and more), event management (A2Z Events), learning management (Path LMS), fundraising (GiveSmart), accounting (MIP Accounting), certification management, career centers, volunteer management, and community tools — connected through one ecosystem. MomentiveIQ, our AI layer, automates workflows, personalizes engagement, and surfaces insights across every product.


We're remote-first, inclusive by design, and serious about the work because our clients' missions are serious.


WHO WE NEED

We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to join our Client Services team. You'll lead onboarding projects for new clients and deliver professional services consulting for existing ones. You combine the consultative instincts to guide an executive through a discovery session with the technical depth to configure a platform and validate that it works the way the client needs it to.


This role sits at the intersection of project management, technical configuration, and client relationship-building. You will work across our association management and learning management platforms, helping organizations go live, adopt best practices, and get full value from their investment.


WHO YOU ARE

You're an experienced implementation professional who learns new platforms quickly and explains them clearly — to a technical administrator and to an executive director in the same week. You manage competing priorities without dropping details, hold timelines without losing relationships, and push for quality without waiting to be asked.


You treat every client engagement as a consulting project: listen first, configure second, train third. You document what you build, share what you learn, and look for ways to make the next implementation better than the last.


HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Lead Client Implementations

  • Own end-to-end onboarding projects from kickoff through go-live, managing scope, timelines, milestones, and risks throughout.
  • Set and maintain client expectations — communicating changes proactively, surfacing issues early, and keeping projects moving through shifting priorities.
  • Hold clients and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed timelines without damaging the relationship.
  • Navigate changing requirements while maintaining project momentum and delivering successful outcomes.

Configure and Deliver Solutions

Conduct discovery to understand each client's business processes, then translate those requirements into platform configurations that fit how they actually work.

  • Configure application settings, workflows, and platform options to meet each client's functional and reporting needs.
  • Support data imports and validate data setup to ensure a clean, accurate go-live.
  • Define, execute, and document testing to confirm client requirements are met before cutover.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve configuration and system setup issues throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Guide and Enable Client Teams

  • Help clients understand how to get the most from the platform by sharing best practices, recommending workflow approaches, and connecting their business processes to platform capabilities.
  • Act as the primary point of guidance throughout the implementation — answering questions, clarifying how features apply to their specific context, and helping teams feel ready at go-live.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at every level, from day-to-day administrators to executive leadership.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor: surface risks before they become problems, help clients make informed configuration decisions, and set them up for long-term success.

Strengthen the Team

  • Collaborate across Client Success, Support, Sales, and Product to deliver clean handoffs and consistent client experiences.
  • Document client configurations, customizations, and key decisions so post-implementation transitions are smooth.
  • Help build and improve team assets — playbooks, templates, process guides — so our implementation practice gets more consistent and repeatable over time.
  • Share what you know: contribute to documentation, provide product feedback, and support teammates on the platforms and processes you know well.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30: Get grounded.

  • Complete onboarding on our platforms, internal systems, and implementation methodology.
  • Shadow active client implementations to understand how we run projects end to end.
  • Establish working relationships with cross-functional partners in Client Success, Support, and Product.

Days 31–60: Start executing.

  • Take ownership of straightforward implementation projects with support from the team.
  • Begin managing client communications, configuration tasks, and project milestones independently on simpler engagements.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in core platform configuration workflows and data setup processes.

Days 61–90: Build momentum.

  • Carry a small active portfolio with increasing independence across project types.
  • Identify at least one area where you can contribute to improving how the team works.

At 6–12 Months

  • Independently manage a full client portfolio from kickoff through go-live.
  • Consistently meet or exceed client satisfaction (CSAT) targets at implementation close.
  • Deliver implementations on or ahead of contracted timelines.
  • Identify and resolve implementation risks before they escalate to client-impacting issues.
  • Contribute at least one improvement to an existing team asset — a playbook, template, or process guide — that makes future implementations smoother.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical consulting, or software delivery.
  • Proven track record managing multiple concurrent implementation projects.
  • Experience with Association Management Software (AMS), Learning Management Software (LMS), or similar nonprofit or membership platforms preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, a technical field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Comfort configuring SaaS platforms — navigating admin settings, workflow tools, and configuration options to match client requirements.
  • Experience supporting data imports and validating data accuracy prior to go-live.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and validation.
  • Experience with project or development management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Trello.
  • Comfort using AI tools to improve day-to-day work — whether for drafting communications, researching solutions, or finding faster ways to get things done.

Professional Skills

  • Clear, direct written and verbal communication — including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong project management instincts: you prioritize well, track details, and keep work moving.
  • Client-first mindset with genuine investment in client outcomes, not just on-time delivery.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely across cross-functional teams.
  • Proactive approach to process improvement: you look for patterns, document what works, and share it.
  • Project management certification (PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent) is a plus.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

Why Work Here?

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

Medical, Dental & Vision Benefits

401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match

Flexible Planned Paid Time Off

Generous Sick Leave

Inclusive & Welcoming Environment

Purpose-Driven Culture

Work-Life Balance

Commitment to Community Involvement

Employer-Paid Parental Leave

Employer-Paid Short-Term Disability

Remote Work Flexibility

Momentive Software actively embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a meaningful way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) and Embedded Software Development Tools organization within Virtualization & Embedded Software Development Tools (VEST). In this role, you will play a critical part in designing, building, and operating cloud-based CI/CD platforms and pipelines that support GM’s embedded software production and large-scale virtualized test environments.
You will blend deep CI/CD tooling expertise with strong cloud infrastructure skills to enable automated software builds, scalable Bazel-based build and test systems, and headless execution of test cases against co-simulation packages for embedded vehicle software. These capabilities are hosted on modern cloud platforms, providing integrated virtual workspaces, seamless integration with test environments, accelerated build and test workflows, and continuous visibility into software quality for teams across the enterprise.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for embedded software production, enabling automated builds, integration, and testing.
  • Architect, implement, and operate cloud-based platforms that host build, test, and virtualization capabilities as part of an end-to-end CI/CD framework.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (development, test, platform, IT operations, cybersecurity) to define, document, and implement best practices for build, test, and deployment automation.
  • Ensure the scalability, reliability, availability, and security of CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms, optimizing them for efficient and predictable software delivery.
  • Integrate CI/CD pipelines with physical and virtual test environments to enable seamless execution of automated test suites and co-simulation workloads.
  • Develop new and innovative methods to automate provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of the virtualization platform and associated cloud services.
  • Monitor and analyze pipeline and platform performance, reliability, and software quality metrics; identify bottlenecks and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Work closely with software developers, architects, test engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to builds, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and virtualization within the broader organization, providing guidance, documentation, and training as needed.
  • Partner with internal IT operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and supplier teams to ensure platforms comply with corporate policies, standards, and requirements.
  • Prepare and deliver clear updates, technical reviews, and live demonstrations of platform capabilities and roadmap to various levels of leadership and external partners.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in DevOps, cloud-native technologies, and virtualization, and incorporate relevant innovations into the platform.
Your Skills and Abilities (Required Qualifications)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in software tools, platform, or infrastructure development, with a strong focus on DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and/or cloud-based applications.
  • Strong expertise in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions (or comparable technologies).
  • Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (such as Azure or AWS) and relevant services, including containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and at least one of C, C++, or Java.
  • Solid understanding of embedded software development tools, build processes, and workflows.
  • Knowledge of test automation frameworks, tools, and practices for software validation in both virtual and hardware-in-the-loop environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipeline solutions for complex, multi-component systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills across build, pipeline, and infrastructure layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional, Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Proven ability to lead or drive challenging technical projects with high levels of ambiguity to successful completion.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience developing and maintaining large-scale cloud-native platforms supporting build, test, or simulation workloads.
  • Familiarity with GM in-house test automation tools and libraries, or similar automotive/embedded test frameworks.
  • Familiarity with software build systems and tools used for embedded development.
  • Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet, SPI).
  • Experience with automotive development tools such as Vector CANape/CANoe, dSPACE SystemDesk/VEOS, AutoVal, or Intrepid Vehicle Spy.
  • Experience integrating or supporting virtual workspaces and remote development environments.
  • Awareness of corporate cybersecurity standards and best practices and how they apply to cloud and CI/CD platforms.

The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate.
• The salary range for this role is 129,400 and 260,300. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.
• Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.

Benefits:

• Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.

jobs.description:
About Qellus
Qellus is an IT services company focused on simplifying business with process digitalization fueled by OpenText™ solutions.
As our clients grow and change, we are right there with them, developing and deploying enterprise information management (EIM) solutions.
Our exceptionally seamless, integrated EIM solutions range across enterprise and cloud applications including SAP®, Salesforce®, Microsoft®, Oracle®, IBM® and many more. That is how we have built a strong reputation as the IT services company that can handle even the stickiest challenges and do it strategically with full transparency.
We provide solution and system architecture, business process design and digitalization, implementation, training, and application support services for organizations that are ready to redefine what is possible.
Summary/Objective:
Qellus is seeking a Business Process and Data Analyst to support the development, implementation, and ongoing management of internal business systems. This role partners closely with leadership to build and optimize system capabilities, ensuring data is accurately structured, maintained, and aligned with business needs. The ideal candidate will understand data models, establish and document data governance standards, and ensure data quality and integrity over time. They will take a process-oriented approach, connecting data to the underlying business workflows it supports, while leveraging basic prompt engineering techniques to enhance system development, maintenance, and operational efficiency.

Essential Functions

Data Analysis
  • Gather, clean, validate, and load data into internal business systems, with attention to accuracy, structure, and long-term maintainability.
  • Understand and work within existing data models; identify gaps, relationships, and rules needed to support reliable reporting and business processes.
  • Create and maintain data governance standards, definitions, and documentation so data remains consistent, repeatable, and defensible over time.
  • Use reports, dashboards, and analysis to surface trends, anomalies, and process improvement opportunities for leadership and delivery teams.

Business Process Analysis
  • Elicit, document, and prioritize internal business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications that consultants and developers can build against.
  • Map current-state and future-state business processes; identify gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Support testing and validation to confirm delivered solutions meet the agreed requirements.
  • Act as a liaison between clients and delivery teams, keeping communication clear and expectations aligned.

Cross-functional Engagement
  • Contribute to a small‑firm environment by taking initiative beyond defined responsibilities to support client and team success.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and blockers proactively to the engagement lead and client stakeholders.
  • Bring findings and recommendations forward with humble confidence — grounded in the data yet, open to being challenged.

Education and Experience

Required Education and Experience:
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 3+ years in a data analyst, business analyst, or hybrid role
    • Experience working with data models, relational data structures, and data quality rules that support business processes.
